stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Praise to the Lord,
The Almighty,the King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him,
For He is thy health and salvation!
All ye who hear, now to His temple draw near;
Join ye in glad adoration!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Praise to the Lord,
Who o'er all things so wondrously reigneth,
Shieldeth thee under His wings,
Yea, so gently sustaineth!
Hast thou not seen how thy desires e'er have been
Granted in what He ordaineth?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Praise to the Lord,
Who doth prosper thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and mercy
Here daily attend thee.
Ponder anew what the Almighty can do,
If with His love He befriend thee.

title: All Creatures of Our God and King

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
All creatures of our God and King,
Lift up your voice with us and sing:
Alleluia! Allelulia!
O burning sun with golden beam
And silver moon with softer gleam:

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Oh, praise Him! Oh, praise Him!
Alleluia! Alleluia!, Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O rushing wind and breezes soft,
Clouds that ride the winds a loft:
Oh, praise Him! Alleluia!
O rising morn, in praise rejoice
O lights of evening, find a voice.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O flowing waters, pure and clear,
Make music for your Lord to hear.
Oh, Praise Him! Alleluia!
O fire so masterful and bright,
Providing us with warmth and light,

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Let the things their Creators bless,
And worship Him in humbleness,
Oh, praise Him! Alleluia!
Oh, praise the Father, praise the Son,
And praise the Spirit, three in One!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God Himself is with us; Let us all adore Him,
And with awe appear before Him.
God is here within us;
Soul, in silence fear Him, Humbly,
Fervently draw near Him.
Now His own who have known God,
In worship lowly,
Yield their spirit wholly.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Come, abide within me; Let my soul, like Mary,
Be Thine earthly sanctuary.
Come, in dwelling Spirit,
With transfigures splendor;
Love and honor will I render
Where I go here below, Let me bow before Thee,
Know Thee and adore Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Gladly we surrender Earth's deceitful treasures,
Pride of life, and sinful pleasures:
Gladly, Lord, we offer
Thine to be forever,
Soul and life and each endeavor.
Thou alone shalt be known Lord of all our being,
Life's true way decreeing.

title: Praise, My Soul, the King of Heaven Praise, my soul, the King of heaven;  To His feet thy tribute bring.  Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven,  Who like thee His praise should sing?  Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia,  Praise the everlasting King.  2  Praise Him for His grace and favor  To our fathers in distress.  Praise Him, still the same forever,  Slow to chide and swift to bless;  Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia,  Glorious in His faithfulness.  3  Tenderly He shields and spares us;  Well our feeble frame He knows.  In His hands He gently bears us,  Rescues us from all our foes.  Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia,  Widely as His mercy flows.  4  Angels, help us to adore Him:  Ye behold Him face to face;  Sun and moon, bow down before Him:  Dwellers all in time and space.  Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia,  Praise with us the God of grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Praise, my soul, the King of heaven;
To His feet thy tribute bring.
Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven,
Who like thee His praise should sing?
Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia,
Praise the everlasting King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Praise Him for His grace and favor
To our fathers in distress.
Praise Him, still the same forever,
Slow to chide and swift to bless;
Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia,
Glorious in His faithfulness.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Tenderly He shields and spares us;
Well our feeble frame He knows.
In His hands He gently bears us,
Rescues us from all our foes.
Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia,
Widely as His mercy flows.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Angels, help us to adore Him:
Ye behold Him face to face;
Sun and moon, bow down before Him:
Dwellers all in time and space.
Praise Him, praise Him, Alleluia,
Praise with us the God of grace.

title: All My Hope on God Is Founded

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
All my hope on God is founded;
He doth still my trust renew,
Me through change and chance He guideth,
Only good and only true.
God unknown,
He alone calls my heart to be His own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Pride of man and earthly glory,
Sword and crown betray his trust;
What with care and toil be buildeth,
Tower and temple fall to dust.
But God's power, hour by hour,
Is my temple and my tower.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God's great goodness aye endureth,
Deep His wisdom, passing through
Splendor, light, and life attend Him,
Beauty springeth out of naught
Love doth stand at His hand;
Joy doth wait on His command.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Still from man to God eternal
Sacrifice of praise be done,
High above all praises praising
For the gift of Christ His Son
Christ doth call one and all:
Ye who follow shall not fall.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness,
Bow down before Him, His glory proclaim;
With gold of obedience, and incense of lowliness,
Kneel and adore Him: the Lord is His name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Low at His feet lay thy burden of carefulness,
High on His heart He will bear it for thee,
Comfort thy sorrows, and answer thy prayerfulness,
Guiding thy steps as may best for thee be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Fear not to enter His courts in the slenderness
Of the poor wealth thou wouldst reckon as thine;
Truth in its beauty, and love in its tenderness,
These are the offerings to lay on His shrine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
These, though we bring them in trembling and fearfulness,
He will accept for the name that is dear;
Mornings of joy give for evenings of tearfulness,
Trust for our trembling, and hope for our fear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The Lord in Zion reigneth, let all the world rejoice,
And come before His throne of grace
With tuneful heart and voice;
The
Lord in Zion reigneth,
And there His praise shall ring,
To
Him shall princes bend the knee
And kings their glory bring.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord in Zion reigneth, and who so great as He?
The depths of earth are in His hands;
He rules the mighty sea.
O crown His Name with honor,
And let His standard wave,
Till distant isles beyond the deep
Shall own His power to save.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord in Zion reigneth,
These hours to Him belong;
O enter now His temple gates,
And fill His courts with song;
Beneath
His royal banner let every creature fall,
Exalt the King of heaven and earth,
And crown Him Lord of all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
We gather together to ask the Lord's blessing;
He chastens and hastens His will to make known.
The wicked oppressing now cease from distressing.
Sing praises to His Name; He forgets not His own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We all do extol Thee, Thou leader triumphant,
And pray that Thou still our defender wilt be.
Let
Thy congregation escape tribulation;
Thy name be ever praised! O Lord, make us free!

title: Let All the World in Every Corner Sing

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Let all the world in every corner sing,
May God and King!
The heavens are not too high,
His praise may thither fly;
The earth is not too low,
His praises there may grow.
Let all the world in every corner sing,
My God and King!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Let all the world in every corner sing,
My God and King!
The church with psalms must shout,
No door can keep them out;
But, above all, the heart
Must bear the longest part.
Let all the world in every corner sing,
May God and King!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, Christian, join to sing,
Alleluia! Amen!
Loud praise to Christ and King; Alleluia!
Amen!
Let all, with heart and voice,
Before His throne rejoice;
Praise is His gracious choice: Alleluia!
Amen!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Come, lift your hearts on high, Alleluia!
Amen!
Let praises fill the sky; Alleluia!
Amen!
He is our Guide and Friend;
To us He’ll condescend;
His love shall never end: Alleluia!
Amen!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Praise yet our Christ again; Alleluia!
Amen!
Life shall not end the strain; Alleluia!
Amen!
On heaven’s blissful shore
His goodness we’ll adore
Singing forever more, Alleluia! Amen!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God of Abraham praise,
At whose supreme command
From earth I rise, and seek the joys
At
His right hand;
I all on earth forsake,
Its wisdom, fame and power;
And
Him my only portion make,
My shield and tower.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee,
God of glory, Lord of love;
Hearts unfold like flow'rs before Thee,
Hail
Thee as the sun above.
Melt the clouds of sin and sadness,
Drive the dark of doubt away;
Giver of immortal gladness,
Fill us with the light of day!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thy works with joy surround Thee,
Earth and heav'n reflect Thy rays,
Stars and angels sing around Thee,
Center of unbroken praise;
Field and forest, vale and mountain,
Bloss'ming meadow, flashing sea,
Chanting bird and flowing fountain
Call us to rejoice in Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thou art giving and forgiving,
Ever blessing, ever blest,
Wellspring of the joy of living,
Oceandepth of happy rest!
Thou the father, Christ our Brother -
All who live in love are Thine:
Teach us how to love each other,
Lift us to the joy divine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
New songs of celebration render
To Him who has great wonders done
Love sits enthrone in ageless splendor:
Come, and adore the mighty One.
He has made known His great salvation
Which all His friends with joy confess:
He has revealed to every nation
His ever lasting righteousness.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Let every instrument and voice
Peal out the praise of grace abounding
Calling the whole world to rejoice.
Trumpets and organs set in motion
Such sounds as make the heavens ring;
All things that live in earth and ocean,
Make music for your mighty King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Rivers and seas and torrents roaring honor the Lord with wild acclaim;
Mountains and stones look up adoring
And find a voice to praise His name.
Righteous, commanding, ever glorious,
Praises be His that never cease:
Just is our God, whose truth victorious
Establishes the world in peace.

title: Let Us Praise the Name of the Lord

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Let us praise the name of the Lord!
Give Him glory, Amen!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Go ye in to all the world,
Alleluia, Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Amen, Amen,
Amen, Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
My Maker and my King,
To
Thee my all I owe;
Thy sovereign bounty is the spring
Whence all my blessings flow;
Thy sovereign bounty is the spring
Whence all my blessings flow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The creature of Thy hand,
On
Thee alone I live;
My
God, Thy benefits demand
More praise than I can give.
My
God, Thy benefits demand
More praise than I can give.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O! let Thy grace inspire
My soul with strength divine;
Let every word each desire
And all my days be Thine.
Let every word each desire
And all my days be Thine.

title: All People That on Earth Do Well

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
All people that on earth do dwell, sing to the Lord with cheerful voice.
Him serve with mirth, his praise forth tell; come ye before him and rejoice.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text: Know that the Lord is God indeed; without our aid he did us make; we are his folk, he doth us feed, and for his sheep he doth us take.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text: O enter then his gates with praise; approach with joy his courts unto; praise, laud, and bless his name always, for it is seemly so to do.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text: For why! the Lord our God is good; his mercy is forever sure; his truth at all times firmly stood, and shall from age to age endure.

title: Lord of All Being, Throned Afar

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord of all being throned afar,
Thy glory flames from sun and star;
Center and souls of every sphere,
Yet to each loving heart how near!
Yet to each loving heart how near!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Sun of our life, Thy quickening ray
Shades on our path the glow of day;
Star of our hope, Thy softened light
Cheers the long watches of the night,
Cheers the long watches of the night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord of all life, below, above,
Whose light is truth, whose warmth is love,
Before
Thy ever blazing throne
We ask no luster of our own,
We ask no luster of our own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Grant us Thy truth to make us free,
And kindling hearts that burn for Thee;
Till all Thy living altars claim
One holy light, one heavenly flame!
One holy light, one heavenly flame.

title: O Morning Star, How Fair and Bright

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Morning Star, how far and bright!
You shine with God’s own truth and light,
A glow with grace and mercy!
Of
Jacob’s race, King David’s Son
Our
Lord and Master, You have won
Our hearts to serve You only!
Lowly, holy! Great and glorious, all victorious
Rich in blessing! Rule and might o’re all possessing

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord, when You look on us in love,
At once there falls from God above
A ray of purest pleasure.
Your
Word and Spirit, flesh and blood
Refresh our souls with heav’nly food.
You are our dearest treasure!
Let
Your mercy Warm and cheer us!
O draw near us!
For
You teach us God’s own love through
You has reached us!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Father, in Your Son!
You loved us, when not yet begun
Was this old earth’s foundation!
Your
Son has ransomed us in love
To live in Him here and above:
This is Your great salvation.
Alleluia!
Christ the living, to us giving
Life forever, Keeps us Yours and fails us never!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O let the harps break forth in sound!
Our joy be all with music crowned,
Our voices gaily blending!
For
Christ goes with us all the way-
Today, tomorrow, everyday!
His love is never ending!
Sing out! Ring out! Jubilation! exultation!

title: O Sing a New Song to the Lord

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O sing a new song to the Lord
For marvels He has done;
His right hand and His holy arm
The victory have won.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
With harp, and voice of psalms
Unto
Jehovah sing;
Let trumpets and the echoing horn
Acclaim the Lord our King!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Let seas with all their creatures roar,
The world and dwellers there,
And let the rivers clap their hands,
The hills their joy declare.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Before the Lord: because He comes,
To judge the earth come He;
He'll judge the world with righteousness,
His folk with equity.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O praise ye the Lord!
Praise
Him in the height;
Rejoice in His word,
Ye angels of light;
Ye heavens, adore Him
By whom ye were made,
And worship before Him,
In brightness arrayed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O praise ye the Lord!
Praise
Him upon earth,
In tuneful accord:
Ye sons of new birth;
Praise
Him who hath brought you
His grace from above,
Praise
Him who hath taught you
To sing of His love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O praise ye the Lord,
All things that give sound;
Each jubilant chord,
Re-echo around;
Loud organs His glory
Forth tell in deep tone,
And sweet harp, the story
Of what He hath done.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O praise ye the Lord!
Thanksgiving and song
To
Him be outpoured
All ages along:
For love in creation,
For heaven restored.
For grace of salvation,
O praise ye the Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Immortal, invisible, God only wise,
In light inaccessible hid from our eyes,
Most blessed, most glorious, the Ancient of Days,
Almighty, victorious, Thy great Name we praise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Unresting, unhasting, and silent as light,
Nor wanting, nor wasting, Thou rulest in might;
Thy justice, like mountains, high soaring above
Thy clouds, which are fountains of goodness and love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Father of glory, pure Father of light,
Thine angels adore Thee, all veiling their sight;
All praise we would render; O help us to see
'Tis only the splendor of light hideth Thee!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God is our Song, and every singer blest
Who praising Him finds energy and rest.
All who praise God with unaffected joy
Give back to us the wisdom we destroy,
Give back to us the wisdom we destroy

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God is our song,
For
Jesus comes to save;
While praising Him
We offer all we have.
New songs we sing,
In ventures new unite,
When
Jesus leads us upward into light,
When
Jesus leads us upward into light.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
This is the Song
No conflict ever drowns;
Who praises God our human wrath disowns.
Love knows what rich complexities of sound
God builds on a simple common ground,
God builds upon a simple common ground.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
God is our Silence
When no songs are sung,
When ecstacy or sorrow still the tongue.
Glorious the faith which silently obeys
Until we find again the voice of praise,
Until we find again the voice of praise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Now the joyful bells a ringing,
All ye mountains, praise the Lord!
Lift your hearts like birds a winging,
All ye mountains praise the Lord!
Now our festal season bringing
Kinsmen all to bide and board,
Sets uor cheery voices singing:
All ye mountains, praise the Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Dear our home as dear none other;
Where the mountains praise the Lord!
Gladly here our care we smother;
Where the mountains praise the Lord!
Here we know that Christ our brother
Binds us all as by accord:
He was born of Mary mother
Where the mountains praise the Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Cold the year, new whiteness wearing,
All ye mountains, praise the Lord!
Peace, good will to us a bearing,
All ye mountains praise the Lord
Now we all God’s goodness sharing
Break the bread and sheath the sword:
Bright our hearts the signal flaring,
All ye mountains, praise the Lord!

title: Every Star Shall Sing a Carol

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Every star shall sing a carol;
Every creature, high or low,
Some and praise the King of heaven
By whatever name you know

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
When the King of all creation
Had a cradle on the earth,
Holy was the human body,
Holy was the human birth.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Every star and every planet,
Every creature, high or low,
Come and praise the King of heaven
By whatever name you know

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
God above, man below,
Holy is the name I know

title: Praise the Lord, His Glories Show

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Praise the Lord, His glories show, Alleluia!
Saints within His courts below, Alleluia!
Angels
'round His throne above, Alleluia!
All that see and share His love, Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Earth to heaven and heaven to earth, Alleluia!
Tell
His wonders, sing His worth, Alleluia!
Age to age and shore to shore, Alleluia!
Praise
Him, praise Him evermore! Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Praise the Lord, His mercies trace, Alleluia!
Praise
His providence and grace, Alleluia!
All that He for man hath done, Alleluia!
All
He sends us through His Son. Alleluia!

title: Praise the Lord! You Heavens Adore Him

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Praise the Lord! for He is glorious;
Never shall His promise fail.
God has made His saints victorious;
Sin and death shall not prevail.
Praise the God of our salvation!
Hosts on high, His power proclaim.
Heaven and earth and all creation,
Laud and magnify His Name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Worship, honor, glory, blessing,
Lord, we offer as our gift.
Young and old, Your praise expressing,
Our glad songs to You we lift.
All the saints in heaven adore You;
We would join their glad acclaim;
As
Your angels serve before You,
So on earth we praise Your name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Rejoice ye pure in heart!
Rejoice, give thanks, and sing;
Your festal banner wave on high,
The cross of Christ your King.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Rejoice, rejoice,
Rejoice, give thanks and sing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
With voice as full and strong
As ocean's surging praise,
Send forth the sturdy hymns of old,
The psalms of ancient days.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
With all the angel choirs,
With all the saints of earth,
Pour out the strains of joy and bliss,
True rapture, noblest mirth.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Yes, on through life's long path,
Still chanting as ye go;
From youth to age, by night and day,
In gladness and in woe.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Praise Him who reigns on high,
The Lord whom we adore,
The Father, Son and Holy Ghost,
One God forever more.   (Refrain)

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Praise we the Lord,
Who made all beauty
For all our senses to enjoy;
Owe we our humble thanks and duty
That simple pleasure never cloy;
Praise we the Lord,
Who made the beauty
For all our senses to enjoy.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Him
Who loves to see young lovers,
Fresh hearts that swell with youthful pride;
Thank
Him who sends the sunshine above us,
As bridegroom fit to meet his bride;
Praise
Him who loves to see young lovers,
Fresh hearts that swell with youthful pride.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Him who by simple flower
Lifts up our hearts to things above;
Thank
Him who gives to each one power
To find a friend to know and love;
Praise
Him who by a simple flower
Lifts up our hearts to things above.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Sing praise to God who reigns above,
The
God of all creation,
The
God of power, the God of love,
The
God of our salvation.
With healing balm my soul He fills,
And every faithless murmur stills;
To
God all praise and glory!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God's almighty power hath made
His gracious mercy keepeth;
By morning glow or evening shade,
His watchful eye ne'er sleepeth,
Within the kingdom of his might,
Lo! all is just, and all is right:
To
God all praise and glory!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord is never far away,
Throughout all grief distressing,
An ever present help and stay,
Our peace and joy and blessing.
As with a mother's tender hand,
He leads His own, His chosen band:
To
God all praise and glory!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Then all my gladsome way along,
I sing aloud thy praises,
That men may hear the grateful song
My voice unwearied raises:
Be joyful in the Lord, my heart!
Both soul and body bear your part!
To
God all praise and glory.

title: Holy God, We Praise You Name

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Hark! the loud celestial hymn
Angel choirs above are raising;
Cherubim and seraphim,
In unceasing chorus praising
Fill the heavens with sweet accord:
Holy, holy, holy, Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Father, Holy Son,
Holy
Spirit, three we name You;
While in essence only one,
Undivided
God we claim You;
And adoring bend the knee,
While we own the mystery.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Tell out, my soul,
The greatness of His name:
Make known His might,
The deeds His arm has done;
His mercy sure, from age to age the same;
His holy name, the Lord,
The
Mighty One.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Tell out, my soul,
The greatness of His might:
Pow’rs and dominions lay their glory by;
Proud hearts and stubborn wills are put to flight,
The hungry fed, the humble lifted high.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Tell out, my soul,
The glories of His word:
Firm is His promises, and His mercy sure.
Tell out, my soul,
The greatness of the Lord
To children’s children and forever more.

title: When in Our Music God Is Glorifies

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When in our music God is glorified,
And adoration leaves no room for pride,
It is as though the whole creation cried:
Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
How oft, in making music,
We have found
A new dimension in the world of sound,
As worship moved us to a more profound
Alleluia!
Sing always: Alleluia

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And did not Jesus sing a psalm that night
When utmost evil strove against the light?
Then let us sing for whom He won the fight
Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4

title: Sing New Song to the Lord

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Sing a new song to the Lord,
He to whom wonders belong.
Rejoice in His triumph
And tell of His power.
O sing a new song to the Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Now to the end of the earth
See
His salvation is shown.
And still He remenbers
His mercy and truth,
Unchanging in love to His own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Sing a new song and rejoice,
Publish
His praises abroad
Let voices in chorus
With trumpet and horn,
Resound for the joy of the Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Join with the hills and the sea,
Thunders of praise to prolong.
In judgment and justice
He comes to the earth.
O sing a new song to the Lord.

title: Wake the SongWake the song, wake the song,The song of joy and gladness,Wake the song, wake the song,The song of Jubilee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Wake the song of joy and gladness;
Hither bring your noblest lays;
Banish every thought of sadness,
Pouring forth your highest praise.
Sing to Him whose care has brought us
Once again with friends to meet,
And whose loving voice has taught us
Of the way to Jesus’ feet.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Wake the song, wake the song,
The song of joy and gladness,
Wake the song, wake the song,
The song of Jubilee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Joyfully with songs and banners,
We will greet the festal day;
Shout aloud our glad hosannas,
And our grateful homage pay.
We will chant our Savior’s glory
While our thoughts we raise above,
Telling still the old, old, story,
Precious theme- redeeming love!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thanks to Thee, O holy Father,
For the mercies of the year;
May each heart, as here we gather,
Swell with gratitude sincere,
Thanks to Thee, O loving Savior,
For redemption through Thy blood.
Breathe upon us, Holy Spirit,
Sweetly draw us near to God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
With songs and honors sounding loud,
Address the Lord on high;
Over the heavens He spreads His clouds,
And waters veil the sky.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He sends His shower of blessing down
To cheer the plains below;
He makes the grass the mountains crown,
And corn in valleys grow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
His steady counsels change the face
Of the declining year;
He bids the sun cut short his race,
And wintry days appear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He sends His word, the flying cloud,
Obey
His mighty word:
He calls the warmer gales to blow,
And bids the spring return.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
The changing wind, the flying clouds,
Obey
His mighty word:
With songs and honors sounding loud
Praise ye the sovereign Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Thou in whose presence my soul takes delight,
On whom in affliction I call,
My comfort by day and my song in the night,
My hope, my salvation, my all!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
His voice, as the sound of the dulcimer sweet,
Is heard through the shadows of death;
The cedars of Lebanon bow at His feet,
The air is perfumed with His breath.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
His lips, as a fountain of righteousness flow,
To water the gardens of grace;
From which their salvation the Gentiles shall know,
And bask in the smiles of His face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He looks, and ten thousand of angels rejoice,
And myriads wait for His word;
He speaks, and eternity, filled with His voice,
Reechoes the praise of the Lord.

title: O Sing My Soul, Your Maker’s Praise

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O sing my soul, your Maker’s praise
In grateful hymns ascending;
Whose steadfast love has crowned your days
With heav’nly gifts unending,
I sought the Lord, He heard my cry;
His holy angels hover nigh
The tents of those who love Him.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord is good to those who seek
His face in time of sorrow,
Providing comfort to the weak
And grace for each tomorrow.
Though grief may tarry for a night,
The morn shall break in joy and light
With blessings from His presence.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Arise, my soul arise!
Stretch to things eternal
And hasten to the feet of your Redeemer God.
Though hid from mortal eyes,
He dwells in light supernal
Yet worship Him in humbleness and call Him Lord
His banquet of love Awaits you above;
Yet here He grants a foretaste of the feast to come!
Rejoice, my soul, rejoice,
To heav’n lift up your voice:
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Now hear the harp of heav’n!
Oh, hear the song victorious,
The never ending anthem sounding through the sky!
To mortals is not giv’n
To join in strain so glorious;
Yet here on earth we too can sing our praises high!
He bought with His blood The ransomed of God;
To
Him be ever lasting pow’r and victory.
And let the great amen Resound through heav’n again.
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord, in the morning Thou shalt hear
My voice ascending high;
To
Thee will I direct my prayer,
To
Thee lift up mine eye-

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Up to the hills where Christ is gone
To plead for all His saints,
Presenting at His Father's throne
Our songs and our complaints.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O may Thy Spirit guide my feet
In ways of righteousness;
Make every path of duty straight
And plain before my face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
The men that love and fear Thy name
Shall see their hopes fulfilled;
The mighty God will compass them
With favor as a shield.

title: The Dawn of God’s Dear Sabbath

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The dawn of God’s dear Sabbath
Breaks o’er the earth again,
As some sweet summer morning
After a night of pain;
It comes as cooling showers
To some exhausted land,
As shade of clustered palm trees
'Mid weary wastes of sand

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord, we would bring for offering,
Though marred with earthly soil,
A week of earnest labor,
Of steady faithful toil,
Fair fruits of self denial,
Of strong, deep love to Thee,
Fostered by Thine own Spirit,
In true humility.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And we would bring our burden
Of sinful thought and deed,
In
Thy pure presence kneeling,
From bondage to be freed,
Our heart’s most bitter sorrow
For all Thy work undone
So many talents wasted!
So few bright laurels won!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And with that sorrow mingling,
A steadfast faith, and sure
And love so deep and fervent,
For
Thee to make it pure,
In
Thy dear presence finding
The pardon that we need,
And then the peace so lasting
Celestial peace in deed.

title: O Splendor of God’s Glory Bright

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O splendor of God’s glory bright,
From light eternal bright light;
O
Light of life, light’s living spring,
True day, all days illumining.
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thou true Sun, on us Thy glance
Let fall in royal radiance;
The
Spirit’s sanctifying beam
Upon our earthly senses stream.
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O joyful be the passing day
With thoughts as clear as morning’s ray,
With faith like noontide shining bright,
Our souls unshadowed by the night.
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Dawn’s glory gilds the earth and skies;
Let
Him, our perfect morn, arise;
The
Father’s help hid children claim,
And sing the Father’s glorious name.
Amen.

title: Now That Daylight Fills the Sky

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Now that the daylight fills the sky,
We lift our hearts to God on high
That
He, in all we do or say,
Would keep us free from harm today;

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
So we, when this new day is gone
And night in turn is drawing on,
With conscience by the world unstrained
Shall praise His name for vict’ry gained.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
All praise to You, creator Lord!
All praise to You, eternal Word!
All praise to You, O Spirit wise!
We sing as daylight fills the skies.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When morning gilds the skies
My heart awaking cries,
May
Jesus Christ be praised!
Alike at work and prayer,
To
Jesus I repair:
May
Jesus Christ be praised!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Whene'er the sweet church bell
Peals over hill and dell,
May
Jesus Christ praised!
O hark to what it sings,
As joyously it rings,
May
Jesus Christ be praised!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The night becomes as day
When from the heart we say:
May
Jesus Christ be praised!
The powers of darkness fear,
When this sweet chant they hear,
May
Jesus Christ be praised!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Ye nations of mankind,
In this your concord find,
May
Jesus Christ praised!
Let all the earth around
Ring joyous with the sound,
May
Jesus Christ praised!

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
In heaven's eternal bliss
The loveliest strain is this,
May
Jesus Christ praised!
Let earth, and sea and sky
From depth to height reply,
May
Jesus Christ praised!

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
Be this, while life is mine,
My canticle divine:
May
Jesus Christ be praised!
Be this th'eternal song
Through all the ages long,
May
Jesus Christ be praised!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Like the first morning
Black birds has spoken
Like the first bird.
Praise for the singing!
Praise for the morning!
Praise for the springing
Fresh from the Word!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Sweet the rain’s new fall
Sunlit from heaven,
Like the first dew fall
On the first grass.
Praise for the sweetness
Of the wet garden,
Sprung in completeness
Where
His feet pass.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Mine is the sunlight!
Mine is the morning
Born of the one light
Eden saw play!
Praise with elation,
Praise every morning,
God’s recreation
Of the new day!

title: Open Now Thy Gates of Beauty

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Open now Thy gates of beauty,
Zion, let me enter there
Where my soul in joyful duty
Waits for God who answers prayer.
Oh, how blessed is this place,
Filled with solace, light, and grace!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God, I come before Thee;
Come
Thou also unto me;
Where we find Thee and adore Thee,
There a heav’n on earth must be.
To my heart, oh, enter Thou,
Let it be Thy temple now!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thy praise is gladly chanted,
Here
Thy seed is duly sown;
Let my soul, where it is planted,
Bright forth precious sheaves alone.
So that all I hear may be
Fruitful unto life in me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thou my faith increase and quicken,
Let me keep Thy gift divine;
How so e’er temptation thicken
May
Thy Word still o’er me shine
As my guiding star through life,
As my comfort in all strife.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Speak,
O God, and I will hear Thee,
Let
Thy will be done indeed;
May
I, undisturbed, draw near Thee
While
Thou dost people feed
Here of life the fountain flows;
Here is balm for all our woes.

title: Abide With Me, ‘Tis EventideO Saviour, stay this night with me;Behold, ‘tis eventide!O Saviour, stay this night with me;Behold, ‘tis eventide.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Abide with me, ‘tis eventide!
Thy walk today with me
Has made my heart within me burn,
As
I communed with Thee.
Thy earnest words have filled my soul
And kept me near Thy side;

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Abide with me, ‘tis eventide!
And lone will be the night
If
I cannot commune with Thee,
Nor find in Thee my light.
The darkness of the world, I fear,
Would in my home abide;

stanzas.label: Chorus

title: God, Who Made the Earthand Heaven

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God, who made the earth and heaven,
Darkness and light:
You the day for work have given,
For rest the night.
May
Your angel guards defend us,
Slumber sweet Your mercy send us,
Holy dreams and hopes attend us
All through the night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
And when morn again shall call us
To run life’s way,
May we still, whate’er be fall us,
Your will obey.
From the pow’r of evil hide us,
In the narrow pathway guide us,
Never be Your smile denied us
All through the day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Guard us waking, guard us sleeping,
And when we die
May we in Your mighty keeping
All peaceful lie.
When the trumpet call shall wake us,
Then,
O Lord, do not forsake us,
But to reign in glory take us
With
You on high.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Father, throned in heaven,
All holy Son,
Holy
Spirit, freely given,
Blest
Three in One:
Grant us grace, we now implore You,
Till we lay our crowns before You
And in worries strains adore You
While ages run.

title: Softly Now the Light of Day

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Softly now the light of day
Fades upon out sight away:
Free from care, from labor free,
Lord, we would commune with Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thou, whose all pervading eye
Nought escapes, without, within,
Pardon each infirmity,
Open fault, and secret sin.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Soon from us the light of day
Shall forever pass away;
Then, from sin and sorrow free,
Take us, Lord, to dwell with Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Though the night be dark and dreary,
Darkness cannot hide from Thee;
Thou art He who, never weary,
Watches where Thy people be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Though destruction walk around us,
Though the arrow past us fly,
Angel guards from Thee surround us,
We are safe if Thou art nigh

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Should swift death this night o’er take us,
And our couch become our tomb,
May the morn of glory wake us,
Clad in light and deathless bloom.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I need Thy presence every passing hour.
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's power?
Who, like Thyself, my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine,
Lord, abide with me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
I fear no foe, with Thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight,
And tears no bitterness.
Where is death's sting?
Where, grave, thy victory?
I triumph still, if Thou abide with me!

title: Day Is Dying in the WestHoly, holy, holy, Lord God of Hosts!Heaven and earth are full of Thee!Heaven and earth are praising Thee,O Lord most high!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God of Hosts!
Heaven and earth are full of Thee!
Heaven and earth are praising Thee,
O Lord most high!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord of life, beneath the dome
Of the universe, Thy home,
Gather us who seek Thy face
To the fold of Thy embrace,
For
Thou art nigh.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
While the deepening shadows fall,
Heart of love enfolding all,
Through the glory and the grace
Of the stars that veil Thy face,
Our hearts ascend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
When forever from our sight
Pass the stars, the day, the night,
Lord of angels, on our eyes
Let eternal morning rise
And shadows end.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Now the day is over,
Night is drawing nigh,
Shadows of the evening
Steal across the sky.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Father, give the weary
Calm and sweet repose;
With
Thy tenderest blessing
May our eyelids close

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Through the long night watches,
May
Thine angels spread
Their white wings above me,
Watching round my bed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
All praise to thee, my God, this night,
For all the blessings of the light!
Keep me, O keep me, King of kings,
Beneath thine own almighty wings.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Forgive me, Lord, for thy dear Son,
The ill that I this day have done,
That with the world, myself, and thee,
I, ere I sleep, at peace may be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O may my soul on thee repose,
And with sweet sleep mine eyelids close,
Sleep that may me more vigorous make
To serve my God when I awake.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O gladsome light, O grace
Of
God the Father’s face,
The eternal splendor wearing;
Celestial holy blest,
Our
Savior, Jesus Christ,
Joyful in Thine appearing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Now e’er day fadeth quite,
We see the ev’ning light,
Our wonted hymn out pouring;
Father of might unknown,
Thee
His incarnate Son,
And
Holy Spirit adoring.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thee of right belongs
All praises of holy songs,
O
Son of God, life giver;
Thee therefore, O most high
The world doth glorify
And shall exalt for ever.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
We thank Thee that Thy church, unsleeping
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is keeping,
And rests not now by day or night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
As o'er each continent and island
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of prayer is never silent,
Nor die the strains of praise away.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
So be it, Lord; Thy throne shall never,
Like earth's proud empires, pass away.
Thy kingdom stands, and grows forever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

title: 57 Now All the Woods Are Sleeping

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
57 Now All the Woods Are Sleeping
Now all the woods are sleeping,
And night and stillness creeping
O’er city, man, and beast;
But thou, my heart, awake thee,
To pray’r awhile betake thee,
And praise thy Maker ere thou rest

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Jesus Thou by me,
And let no foe comes nigh me,
Safe sheltered by Thy wing;
But would the foe alarm me,
O let him never harm me,
But still Thine angels round me sing!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
My loved ones, rest securely,
From every peril surely
Our
God will guard your heads;
And happy slumbers send you,
And bid His host attend you,
And golden armed watch o’er your beds.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
58 Hark, the Vesper Hymn
Is Stealing
Hark! the vesper hymn is stealing
O’er the waters soft and clear;
Jubilate,
Jubilate, Jubilate, Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Nearer yet, and nearer pealing,
Soft it breaks upon the ear.
Jubilate,
Jubilate, Jubilate, Amen.

title: Great Our Joy as NowWe Gather

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Great our joy as now we gather
Where the Master makes us one:
Where we worship God the Father
Thro’ the Spirit of His Son.
All who search for His church
Find it where His will is done.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Precious is the tie that binds us
To our God when faith grows cold;
Precious all that now reminds us
He is still our safe strong hold.
Faithful love serves to prove
Here the Shepherd has His fold.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
May we learn from Christ’s example
How to use this house of prayer:
He who loved and cleansed His temple
Wants us all to worship there.
God the Son shut out none:
In
His Kingdom all may share.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord, inspire us with Your vision
Of a world which must be won!
Glorious is the church’s mission,
Long endeavored, scarce begun!
Faithful now this is how
God’s eternal will is done.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Blessed Jesus, at Thy word
We are gathered all to hear Thee;
Let our hearts and soul be stirred
Now to seek and love and fear Thee;
By
Thy teachings sweet and holy,
Drawn form earth to love Thee solely.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
All our knowledge, sense, and sight
Lie in deepest darkness shrouded,
Till
Thy Spirit breaks our night
With the beams of truth unclouded.
Thou alone to God canst win us;
Thou must work all good within us.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord, Thy self impart!
Light, from God proceeding,
Open
Thou our ears and heart,
Help us by Thy spirit’s pleading
Hear the cry Thy people raises,
Hear, and bless our prayers and praises.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God is here!  As we His people
Meet to offer praise and prayer,
May we find in fuller measure
What it is in Christ we share
Here as in the worlds around us,
All our varied skill and arts
Wait the coming of the Spirit
Into open minds and hearts.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Here are symbols to remind us
Of our life long need of grace;
Here are table, font, and pulpit;
Here the Word has central place.
Here in honesty of preaching,
Here in silence, as in speech,
Here in newness and renewal,
God the Spirit it comes to each.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Here our children find a welcome
In the Shepherd’s flock and fold,
Here, as bread and wine are taken
Christ sustains us as of old.
Here the servants of the Servants
Seek in worship to explore
What it means in daily living
To believe and to adore.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord of all, of church and kingdom,
In an age of change and doubt
Keep us faithful to the gospel,
Help us work Your purpose out.
Here, in this day’s dedication,
All we have to give, receive,
We who cannot live without You,
We adore You! We believe!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
How lovely is Thy dwelling place,
O
Lord of hosts to me!
The tabernacles of Thy grace
How pleasant, Lord, they be!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
My thirsty soul longs ardently,
Yea, faints Thy courts to see;
My very heart and flesh cry out,
O living God, for Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Behold the sparrow findeth out
A house wherein to rest;
The swallow also, for herself
Provide hath a nest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Ev’n
Thine own altars, where she safe
Her young ones forth may bring,
O
Thou, almighty Lord of host,
Who art my God and King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Blest are they in Thy house that dwell,
They ever give Thee praise.
Blest is the man whose strength
Thou art,
In whose heart are Thy ways.

title: 63 O Come, Let us Sing to the Lord

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
63 O Come, Let us Sing to the Lord
O come, let us sing to the Lord,
Come let us everyone
A joyful noise make to the Rock
Of our salvation.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Let us before His presence come
With glad and thankful voice;
Let us sing psalms of praise to Him
And make a joyful noise

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God, a great God and great King,
Above all gods, He is;
The depths of earth are on His hand,
The strength of hills is His

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Him the ocean worship Him,
And
He the sea did make;
The dry land also from His hand,
Its form at first did take.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
O come, bow down and worship Him,
And kneeling, humbly pray,
Come to our Maker and our God,
And hear His voice today.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thanks we give and adoration
For thy gospel's joyful sound.
May the fruits of thy salvation
In our hearts and lives abound;
Ever faithful, ever faithful
To the truth may we be found.

title: God Be With YouTill we meet, till we meet,Till we meet at Jesus' feet;Till we meet, till we meet,God be with you till we meet again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Till we meet, till we meet,
Till we meet at Jesus' feet;
Till we meet, till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4
Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4

title: O Lord, Now Let Your Servant

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Lord, now let Your servant
Depart in heav’nly peace
For
I have seen the glory
Of
Your redeeming grace
A light to lead the Gentiles
Unto
Your holy hill
The glory of Your people,
Your chosen Israel.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Then grant that I may follow
Your gleam, O glorious Light
Till earthly shadows scatter,
And faith is changed to sight;
Till raptured saints shall gather
Upon that shining shore
Where
Christ, the blessed Day star,
Shall light them evermore.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God the Father
Joyful song we sing,
Unto
God the Savior
Thankful hearts we bring,
Unto
God the Spirit
Bow we and adore,
On our way rejoicing
Now and evermore.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
On our way rejoicing
As we forward move,
Hearken to our praises,
O blest God of love!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4
Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Praise ye the Savior, great is His compassion,
Graciously cares He for His chosen people;
Young men and maidens, ye old men and children,
Praise ye the Savior!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Praise ye the Spirit, comforter of Israel,
Sent of the Father and the Son to bless us;
Praise ye the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit,
Praise the Eternal Three!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, Thou almighty King
Help us Thy name to sing
Help us to praise!
Father all glorious,
O’er all victorious,
Come, and reign holiness,
Ancient of Days!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Come,
Thou incarnate Word,
Gird on Thy mighty sword,
Our prayer attend;
Come, and Thy people bless,
And give Thy Word success;
Spirit of holiness,
On us descend!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Come, holy Comforter,
Thy sacred witness bear,
In this glad hour:
Thou who almighty art,
Now rule in every heart,
And ne’er from us depart,
Spirit of power!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thee, great One in Three,
Eternal praises be,
Hence, evermore:
Thy sovereign majesty
May we in glory see,
And to eternity
Love and adore!

title: Creator of the Star of Night

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Creator of the stars of night,
Thy people’s everlasting light,
O
Christ, Thou Savior of us all,
We pray Thee, hear us when we call
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
At the great name of Jesus, now
All knees must bend, all hearts must bow;
And things celestial Thee shall own,
And things terrestrial, Lord alone.
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God the Father, God the Son,
And
God the Spirit, Three in one,
Laud, honor, and glory be
From age to age eternally.
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee;
Holy, holy, holy, merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Holy, holy, holy! Angels adore Thee,
Casting down their bright crowns around the glassy sea;
Thousands and ten thousands worship low before Thee,
Which wert, and art, and evermore shalt be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Holy, holy, holy! though the darkness hide Thee,
Though the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see;
Only
Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee,
Perfect in power, in love, and purity.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
All
Thy works shall praise Thy name, in earth, and sky, and sea;
Holy, holy, holy; merciful and mighty!
God in three Persons, blessed Trinity!

title: Like a River GloriousTrusting in Jehovah,Hearts are fully blestFinding, as He promised,Perfect peace and rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Like a river glorious,
Is
God's perfect peace,
Over all victorious,
In its bright increase;
Perfect, yet it floweth,
Fuller every day,
Perfect, yet it groweth,
Deeper all the way.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Trusting in Jehovah,
Hearts are fully blest
Finding, as He promised,
Perfect peace and rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Hidden in the hollow
Of
His blessed hand,
Never foe can follow,
Never traitor stand;
Not a surge of worry,
Not a shade of care,
Not a blast of hurry
Touch the spirit there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Every joy or testing
Comes from God above,
Given to His children
As an act of love;
We may trust Him fully
All for us to do.
They who trust Him wholly
Find
Him wholly true.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There’s the wonder of sunset at evening,
The wonder as sunrise I see;
But the wonder of wonders that thrills my soul
Is the wonder that God loves me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There’s the wonder of springtime and harvest,
The sky, the stars, the sun;
But the wonder of wonders that thrills my soul
Is the wonder that’s only begun.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O, the wonder of it all!
The wonder of it all!
Just to think that God loves me.
O, the wonder of it all!
The wonder of it all!
Just to think that God loves me.

title: O Love That Wilt Not Let Me Go

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Love that wilt not let me go,
I rest my weary soul in thee;
I give thee back the life I owe,
That in thine ocean depths its flow
May richer, fuller be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Light that followest all my way,
I yield my flickering torch to thee;
My heart restores its borrowed ray,
That in they sunshine's blaze its day
May brighter, fairer be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Joy that seekest me through pain,
I cannot close my heart to thee;
I trace the rainbow through the rain,
And feel the promise is not vain,
That morn shall tearless be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Cross that liftest up my head,
I dare not ask to fly from thee;
I lay in dust life's glory dead,
And from the ground there blossoms red
Life that shall endless be.

title: O Love of God Most Full

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O love of God most full,
O love of God most free,
Come warm my heart, come fill my soul,
Come lead me unto Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Warm as the glowing sun
So shine Thy love on me,
It wraps me ‘round with kindly care,
It draws me unto Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The wildest sea is calm,
The love of God most free,
The darkest night is full of light,
Because
Thy love is near.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O love of God most full,
O love of God most free,
It warms my heart, it fills my soul,
With might it strengthens me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
For God so loved us,
He sent the Savior:
For
God so loved us, and loves me too.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He sent the Savior, the blest Redeemer;
He sent the Savior to set me free.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
He bade me welcome,
O word of mercy;
He bade me welcome,
O voice divine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Glory and honor,
O
Love eternal,
To
Him be given while life shall last.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Love so unending!
I’ll sing His praises,
God loves His children, loves even me.

title: O Love of God,How Strong and True!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
How Strong and True!
O love of God, how strong and true!
Eternal, and yet ever new;
Uncomprehended and unbought,
Beyond all knowledge and all thought.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O love of God, how deep and great,
Far deeper than man’s deepest hate;
Self fed, self kindled like the night,
Changeless, eternal, infinite.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We read thee best in Him who came
To bear for us the cross of shame;
Sent by the Father from on high,
Our life to live, our death to die.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
We read thy power to bless and save,
E’en in the darkness of the grave
Still more in resurrection light
We read the fullness of thy might.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
O love of God, our shield and stay
Through all the perils of our way!
Eternal love, in thee we rest,
Forever safe, forever blest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O world of God, so vast and strange,
Profound and wonderful and fair,
Beyond the utmost reach of thought,
But not beyond a Father’s care!
We are not strangers on this earth
Whirling amid the suns of space;
We are God’s children, this our home,
With those of every clime and race.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O world of man where life is lived,
So strangely mingling joy and pain,
So full of evil and of good,
So needful that the good shall reign!
We are not world that God has loved,
And goodness was its Maker’s plan,
The promise of God’s triumph
Is His coming in a Son of Man.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O world of time’s far stretching years!
There was a day when time stood still,
A central moment when there rose
A cross upon a cruel hill;
In pain and death love’s power was seen,
The mystery of time revealed,
The wisdom of the ways of God,
The grace through which man’s hurt is healed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
81 Though I Speak With Tongues
Though I speak with tongues of men and angels,
Though
I have the prophet’s gift,
Though
I hold the keys to hidden knowledge,
Though my faith can mountain shift:
Without love I am no better,
Without love it’s all for naught;
Lord,
You spent Your life in loving others:
What this means I would be taught.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Love is patient, knows no envy,
Never gloats when others sin;
Love is never glad to see injustice,
Always wants the truth to win.
There’s no end to love’s endurance,
There’s no test it cannot face;
Lord,
You spent Your life in loving others:
I shall fail without Your grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Though there’ll be an end to hidden knowledge,
Visions, raptures, prophecy :
Faith and hope and love shall last forever,
Love the greatest of the three.
Without love I am no better,
Without love it’s all for naught;
Lord,
You gave Your life in saving others:
What this means I would be taught.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
His sovereign power, without our aid,
Made us of clay, and formed us men;
And when like wandering sheep we strayed,
He brought us to His fold again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We'll crowd His gates with thankful songs,
High as the heavens our voices raise;
And earth, with her ten thousand tongues,
Shall fill His courts with sounding praise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Wide as the world is His command,
Vast as Eternity His love;
Firm as a rock His truth shall stand,
When rolling years shall cease to move.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O worship the King, all glorious above,
O gratefully sing His wonderful love;
Our Shield and Defender,
The Ancient of Days,
Pavilioned in splendor,
And girded with praise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O tell of His might,
O sing of His grace,
Whose robe is the light,
Whose canopy space,
His chariots of wrath the deep thunderclouds form,
And dark is His path on the wings of the storm.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thy bountiful care,
What tongue can recite?
It breathes in the air,
It shines in the light;
It streams from the hills,
It descends to the plain,
And sweetly distills in the dew and the rain.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Frail children of dust, and feeble as frail,
In Thee do we trust, nor find Thee to fail;
Thy mercies how tender,
How firm to the end!
Our Maker, Defender,
Redeemer, and Friend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God the Omnipotent!
King who ordainest
Great winds Thy clarions,
The lightings Thy sword;
Show forth Thy pity on high where Thou reignest
Give to us peace,
O most merciful Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
So shall we render Thee thankful devotion,
For
Thy deliverance from peril and sword,
Singing in chorus from ocean to ocean,
“Thine is the power and the glory,
O
Lord.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Eternal Father, strong to save,
Whose arm hath bound the restless wave,
Who bid'st the mighty ocean deep
Its own appointed limits keep;
Oh hear us when we cry to Thee
For those in peril on the sea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Christ, whose voice the waters heard,
And hushed their raging at Thy word,
Who walkedst on the foaming deep,
And calm amidst its rage didst sleep;
Oh, hear us when we cry to Thee
For those in peril on the sea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Holy Spirit, who didst brood
Upon the waters dark and rude,
And bid their angry tumult cease,
And give, for wild confusion, peace:
Oh, hear us when we cry to Thee
For those in peril on the sea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Lord my God! when I in awesome wonder
Consider all the worlds Thy hands have made,
I see the stars, I hear the rolling thunder,
Thy pow’r thro’out the universe displayed,

stanzas.label: Chorus
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Christ shall come with shout of acclamation
And take me home, what joy shall fill my hear!
Then
I shall bow in humble adoration
And there proclaim, my God, how great Thou art!

title: 87 God Who Spoke in the Beginning

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
87 God Who Spoke in the Beginning
God who spoke in the beginning,
Forming rock and shaping spar,
Set all life and growth in motion,
Earthly world and distant star;
He who calls the earth to order
Is the ground of what we are.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God who spoke thro’ men and nations,
Thro’ events long past and gone,
Showing still today His purpose,
Speaks supremely through His Son;
He who calls the earth to order
Gives
His word and it is done.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God whose speech becomes incarnate–
Christ is servant, Christ is Lord–
Calls us to a life of service,
Heart and will to action stirred;
He who uses man’s obedience
Has the first and final word.

title: I Sing the Migthy Power of God

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I sing the mighty power of God,
That made the mountains rise,
That spread the flowing seas abroad,
And built the lofty skies.
I sing the wisdom that ordained
The sun to rule the day;
The moon shines full at His command,
And all the stars obey.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I sing the goodness of the Lord,
Who filled the earth with food,
He formed the creatures with His Word,
And then pronounced them good.
Lord, how thy wonders are displayed,
Where'er I turn my eye,
If I survey the ground I tread,
Or gaze upon the sky!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
There's not a plant or flower below,
But makes Thy glories known,
And clouds arise, and tempests blow,
By order from Thy throne;
Creatures that borrow life from Thee
Are subject to Thy care;
There's not a place where we can flee,
But God is present there.

title: Let All on EarthTheir Voices Raise

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Let all on earth their voices raise,
To sing the great Jehovah’s praise,
And bless His Holy name:
His glory let the people know,
His wonders to the nations show,
His saving grace proclaim.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Come, the great day, the glorious hour,
When earth shall feel His saving power,
All nations fear His name;
Then shall the race of men confess
The beauty of His holiness,
His saving grace proclaim.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Eternal God, whose power upholds
Both flower and flaming star,
To whom there is no here nor there,
No time, no near nor far,
No alien race, no foreign shore,
No child unsought, unknown:
O send us forth, Your prophets true
To make all lands Your own!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God of truth, whom science seeks
And reverent souls adore,
Illumine every earnest mind
Of every clime and shore:
Dispel the gloom of error’s night,
Of ignorance and fear,
Until true wisdom from above
Shall make life’s pathway clear!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God of beauty, often revealed
In dreams of human art,
In speech that flows to melody,
In holiness of heart:
Teach us to ban all ugliness,
And all dis-harmony,
Till all shall know the loveliness
Of lives made fair and free!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
God of righteousness and grace,
Seen in the Christ, Your Son
Whose life and death reveal Your face,
By whom Your will was done;
Help us to spread Your gracious reign
Till greed and hate shall cease,
And kindness dwell in human hearts,
And all the earth find peace!

title: Ye Watchers and Ye Holy Ones

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Ye watchers and ye holy ones,
Bright seraphs, cherubim and thrones,
Raises the glad strain, Alleluia!
Cry out, dominions, princedoms, powers,
Virtues, archangels, angels’ choirs,
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia,
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O higher than the cherubim,
More glorious than the seraphim,
Lead their praises, Alleluia!
Thou bearer of the eternal Word,
Most gracious, magnify the Lord.
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia,
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O friends, in gladness let us sing,
Supernatural anthems echoing,
Alleluia,
Alleluia!
To
God the Father, God the Son
And
God the Spirit, Three in One.
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia,
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
This is my Father's world,
And to my listening ears
All nature sings, and round me rings
The music of the spheres.
This is my Father's world;
I rest me in the thought
Of rocks and trees, of skies and seas;
His hands the wonders wrought.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
This is my Father's world.
O let me ne'er forget
That though the wrong seems oft so strong,
God is the ruler yet.
This is my Father's world;
Why should my heart be sad?
The
Lord is King; let the heavens ring!
God reigns; let the earth be glad!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful,
The
Lord God made them all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Each little flower that opens,
Each little bird that sings;
He made their glowing colors,
He made their tiny wings.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The purpleheaded mountain,
The river running by
The sunset, and the morning
That brightens up the sky,

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
The cold wind in the winter,
The pleasant summer sun,
The ripe fruits in the garden,
He made them every one.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
He gave us eyes to see them,
And lips that we might tell
How great is God Almighty,
Who has made all things well.
*Stanza
1 to be sung as refrain after stanzas 2 to 5

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Nature with open volume stands,
To spread its maker’s praise abroad;
And every labor of His hands
Show something worthy of our God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
But in the grace that rescued us
His brightest form of glory shines;
'Tis fairest drawn upon the cross
In precious blood and crimson lines

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
His whole name appears complete.
Nor wit can guess nor reason prove,
Which of the letters best is writ,
The pow’r, the wisdom, or the love

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
We would forever speak His name
In sound to mortal ears unknown,
With angels join to praise the Lamb,
And worship at His Father’s throne.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Spring has now unwrapped the flowers,
Day is fast reviving,
Life in all her growing powers
Towards the light is striving:
Gone the iron touch of cold,
Winter time and frost time,
Seedlings working through mould,
Now make up for lost time.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Herb and plant that winter long,
Slumbered at their leisure,
Now be stirring green and strong,
Find in growth their pleasure:
All the world with beauty fills,
Gold the green enhancing;
Flowers make glee among the hills,
Set the meadows dancing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Through each wonder of fair days
God
Himself expresses;
Beauty follows all His ways,
As the world He blesses:
So, as He renews the earth,
Artist without rival,
In
His grace of glad new birth
We must seek revival.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The spacious firmament on high,
With all the blue, ethereal sky,
And spangled heavens, a shining frame,
Their great Original proclaim.
Th'unwearied sun from day to day
Does his Creator's power display,
And publishes to every land
The work of an almighty hand

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Soon as the evening shades prevail,
The moon takes up the wondrous tale;
And nightly to the listening earth
Repeats the story of her birth;
While all the stars that round her burn,
And all the planets in their turn,
Confirm the tidings as they roll,
And spread the truth from pole to pole

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
What though in solemn silence all
Move round the dark terrestrial ball?
What though no real voice nor sound
Amid their radiant orbs be found?
In reason's ear they all rejoice
And utter forth a glorious voice,
Forever singing as they shine,
"The hand that made us is divine."

title: Lord of the Boundless Curvesof Space

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord of the boundless curves of space
And time’s deep mystery,
To
Your creative might we trace
All nature’s energy.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Your mind conceived the galaxy,
Each atom’s secret planned,
And every age of history
Your purpose, Lord, has spanned.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Yours is the image stamped on man,
Though marred by man’s own sin;
And
Yours the liberating plan
Again his soul to win.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Give us to know Your truth; but more,
The strength to do Your will;
Until the love our souls adore
Shall all our being fill.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Can you count the star that brightly
Twinkle in the midnight sky?
Can you count the clouds, so lightly
O’er the meadows floating by?
God, the Lord, doth mark their number
With
His eyes that never slumber;
He hath made them everyone,
He hath made them everyone.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Can you count the wings now flashing
In the sunshine’s golden light?
Can you count the fishes splashing
In the cooling waters bright?
God, the Lord, a name hath given,
To all creatures under heaven;
He hath named them everyone,
He hath named them everyone.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Do you know how many children
Rise each morning blithe and gay?
Can you count their jolly voices,
Singing sweetly day by day?
God hears all the happy voices,
In their merry songs rejoices;
And
He loves them, everyone
And
He loves them, everyone

title: God Will Take Care of YouGod will take care of you,Through every day, o'er all the way;He will take care of you,God will take care of you.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Be not dismayed whate'er betide,
God will take care of you;
Beneath his wings of love abide,
God will take care of you.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
God will take care of you,
Through every day, o'er all the way;
He will take care of you,
God will take care of you.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Through days of toil when heart doth fail,
God will take care of you;
When dangers fierce your path assail,
God will take care of you.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
All you may need he will provide,
God will take care of you;
Nothing you ask will be denied,
God will take care of you.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
No matter what may be the test,
God will take care of you;
Lean, weary one, upon his breast,
God will take care of you.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Great is Thy faithfulness,
O
God my Father,
There is no shadow of turning with Thee;
Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not;
As
Thou hast been Thou forever wilt be.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Morning by morning new mercies I see;
All
I have needed Thy hand hath provided,
Great is Thy faithfulness! Lord unto me!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Summer and winter, and springtime and harvest,
Sun, moon, and stars in their courses above,
Join with all nature in manifold witness
To
Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth,
Thy own dear presence to cheer and to guide;
Strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow,
Blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Children of the heavenly Father
Safely in His bosom gather;
Nestling bird nor star in heaven
Such a refuge e'er was given.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
His own doth tend and nourish,
In
His holy love they flourish;
From all evil things He spares them,
In
His mighty arms He bears them.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Neither life nor death shall ever
From the Lord His children sever;
Unto them His grace He showeth,
And their sorrows all He knoweth.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Praise the Lord in joyful numbers,
Your
Protector never slumbers;
At the will of your Defender
Every foe-man must surrender.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
He giveth or He taketh,
God
His children ne'er forsaketh;
His the loving purpose solely
To preserve them pure and holy.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Unto the hills around
Shall I lift up my longing eyes?
O whence for me shall my salvation come,
From whence arise?
From
God the Lord doth come my certain aid,
From
God the Lord,
Who heav’n and earth hath made.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He will not suffer that thy foot be moved,
Safe shalt Thou be.
No careless slumber shall His eyelids close,
Who keepeth thee.
Behold our God, the Lord,
He slumbereth ne’er,
Who keepeth Israel in His holy care.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jehovah is Himself thy keeper true,
Thy changeless shade.
Jehovah thy defense on thy right
And Himself hath made.
And thee no sun by day shall ever smite,
No moon shall harm thee in the silent night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
From every evil shall He keep thy soul,
From every sin;
Jehovah shall preserve thy going out,
Thy coming in.
Above thee watching,
He whom we adore,
Shall keep thee hence-forth,
Yea forever more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text: Ages Past

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O God, our help in ages past, 
Our hope for years to come, 
Our shelter from the stormy blast, 
And our eternal home!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Under the shadow of thy throne, 
Still may we dwell secure; 
Sufficient is thine arm alone, 
And our defense is sure.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Before the hills in order stood, 
Or earth received her frame, 
From everlasting, thou art God, 
To endless years the same.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
A thousand ages, in thy sight, 
Are like an evening gone; 
Short as the watch that ends the night, 
Before the rising sun.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
O God, our help in ages past, 
Our hope for years to come; 
Be thou our guide while life shall last, 
And our eternal home!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
My Shepherd will supply my need,
Jehovah in His name.
In pastures fresh He makes me feed
Beside the living stream.
He brings my wand’ring spirit back
When
I forsake His eyes,
And lead me, for His mercy’s sake,
In path of truth and grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I walk through shades of death,
Thy presence is my stay;
A word of Thy supporting breath
Drives all my fear away.
Thy hand in sight of all my foes
Doth still my table spread;
My cup with blessings overflows,
Thine oil anoint my head.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The sure provision of my God
Attend me all my day;
O may Thy house be mine above
And all my work be praise.
There would I find a settled rest
While others go and come;
No more a stranger or guest,
But like a child at home.

title: Sing to the Great Jehovah’s Praise

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Sing to the great Jehovah’s praise!
All praise to Him belongs;
Who kindly lengthens out our days,
Inspires our choicest songs,
Inspires our choicest songs.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
His providence hath brought us through
Another various year;
We all, with vows and anthems new,
Before our God appear,
Before our God appear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God, Thy mercies past we own,
And
Thy continued care;
To thee presenting through Thy Son
What e’er we have and are,
What e’er we have and are.

title: Give to Our God Immortal Praise

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Give to our God immortal praise;
Mercy and truth are all His ways:
Wonders of grace to God belong,
Repeat
His mercies in your song.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Give to the Lord of lords renown,
The
King of kings with glory crown:
His mercies ever shall endure
When lord and kings are known no more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
He sent His Son with power to save
From guilt and darkness and the grave:
Wonders of grace to God belong,
Repeat
His mercies in your song.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thro’ this vain world He guides our feet,
And lead us to His heav’nly seat:
His mercies ever shall endure,
When this vain world shall be no more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God moves in mysterious way
His wonders to perform;
He plants His footsteps in the sea,
And ride upon the storm.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Ye fearful saints, fresh courage take;
The clouds ye so much dread
Are big with mercy, and shall break
In blessings on your head.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Judge not the Lord by feeble sense,
But trust Him for His grace;
Behind a frowning providence
He hides a smiling face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
His purpose will ripen fast,
Unfolding every hour;
The bud may have a bitter fast,
But sweet will be the flower.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Blind unbelief is sure to err,
And scan His work in vain;
God is His own interpreter,
And
He will make it plain.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Amazing grace! How sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found;
Was blind, but now I see.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord has promised good to me,
His word my hope secures;
He will my shield and portion be,
As long as life endures.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Through many dangers, toils, and snares,
I have already come;
'Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
When we've been there ten thousand years,
Bright shining as the sun,
We've no less days to sing God's praise
Than when we first begun.

title: Marvelous GraceGrace, grace,God's grace,Grace that will pardon and cleanse withinGrace, grace, God's grace,Grace that is greater than all our sin!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Marvelous grace of our loving Lord.
Grace that exceeds our sin and our guilt!
Yonder on Calvary's mount outpoured
There where the blood of the Lamb was spilt.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Grace, grace,God's grace,
Grace that will pardon and cleanse within
Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that is greater than all our sin!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Sin and despair, like the seawaves cold,
Threaten the soul with infinite loss;
Grace that is greater yes grace untold
