Points to the Refuge, the mighty Cross.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Marvelous, infinite, matchless grace,
Freely bestowed on all who believe!
You that are longing to see His face,
Will you this moment His grace receive?

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
110  God’s Free Mercy Streameth
God’s free mercy streameth
Over all the world,
And
His banner gleameth,
By
His church unfurled;
Broad and deep and glorious,
As the heaven above,
Shine in might victorious
His eternal love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord, upon our blindness
Thy pure radiance pour;
For
Thy loving kindness
We would love Thee more;
And when clouds are drifting
Dark across the sky,
Then, the veil uplifting,
Father, be Thou nigh.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
We will never doubt Thee,
Tho’
Thou veil Thy light;
Life is dark without Thee,
Death with Thee is bright.
Light of light, shine o’er us
On our pilgrim way,
Go
Thou still before us
To the endless day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
My Father is omnipotent,
And that you can’t deny;
A
God of might and miracles–
‘Tis written in the sky.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
It took a miracle to put the stars in place,
It took a miracle to hang the world in space;
But when He saved my soul
Cleansed and made me whole,
It took a miracle of love and grace!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Though here His glory has been shown,
We still can’t fully see
The wonders of His might, His throne–
‘Twill take eternity.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Bible tells us of His power
And
His wisdom all way through,
And every little bird and flower
Are testimonies too.

title: Let Us With a Gladsome Mind

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Let us with a gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, for He is kind:
For
His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He, with all commanding might,
Filled the new made world with light
For
His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
All things living He does feed;
His full hand supplies their need:
For
His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Let us then with gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, for He is kind:
For
His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
As pants the hart for cooling streams
When heated in the chase,
So longs my soul, O God, for Thee,
And
Thy refreshing grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thee, my God, the living God,
My thirsty soul doth pine:
O when shall I behold Thy face,
Thou
Majesty divine?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Why restless, why cast down, my soul?
Hope still, and thou shalt sing
The praise of Him who is Thy God,
Thy health’s eternal spring.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,
Then
God whom we adore,
Be glory, as it was, is now,
And shall be evermore.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There’s a wideness in God’s mercy,
Like the wideness of the sea;
There’s a kindness in His justice,
Which is more than liberty.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
For the love of God is broader
Than the measure of man’s mind;
And the heart of the Eternal
Is most wonderfully kind.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
If our love were but more simple,
We should take Him at His word;
And our lives would be all sunshine
In the sweetness of our Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O come, O come, Immanuel,
And ransom captive Israel
That mourns in lonely exile here
Until the Son of God appear,

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Rejoice!
Rejoice! Immanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O come, Thou Wisdom from on high,
And order all things far and nigh;
To us the path of knowledge show,
And cause us in her ways to go.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Of the Father’s love begotten,
Ere the worlds began to be
He is Alpha and Omega,
He the source, the ending He,
Of the things that are that have been,
And that future years shall see,
Evermore and evermore! Amen

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Christ, to Thee with God the Father
And,
O Holy Ghost, to Thee
Hymn and chant and high thanks giving
And unwearied praises be.
Honor, glory, and dominion,
And eternal victory,
Evermore and evermore! Amen

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The advent of our God
With eager prayers we greet,
And singing haste upon His road
His coming reign to meet.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Was born to make us free;
And
He a servant’s form put on
To gain our liberty.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Judge, on clouds of light,
He soon will come again,
His scattered people to unite
With them in heaven to reign.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Praise to the incarnate Son
Who comes to set us free,
With
Father, Spirit, ever one,
To all eternity.

title: The First NoelNoel, Noel, Noel, Noel,Born is the King of Israel

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The first noel the angel did say
Was to certain poor shepherds in fields where they lay;
In fields where they lay keeping their sheep,
On a cold winter's night that was so deep.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
They looked up and saw a star
Shining in the east, beyond them far,
And to the earth it gave great light,
And so it continued both day and night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And by the light of that same star,
Three wise men came from country far,
To seek for a king was their intent,
And to follow the star wherever it went.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
This star drew nigh to the northwest,
O'er
Bethlehem it took its rest,
And there it did both stop and stay,
Right over the place where Jesus lay.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Then entered in those wise men three,
Full reverently upon the knee,
And offered there, in His presence,
Their gold, and myrrh, and frankincense.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Angels from the realms of glory,
Wing your flight o`er all the earth;
Ye, who sang creation`s story,
Now proclaim Messiah`s birth;
Come and worship, Come and worship,
Worship
Christ, the newborn King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Shepherds, in the field abiding,
Watching o`er your flocks by night,
God with man is now residing;
Yonder shines the Infant Light;
Come and worship, Come and worship,
Worship
Christ, the newborn King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Saints, before the altar bending,
Watching long in hope and fear,
Suddenly the Lord, descending,
In
His temple shall appear;
Come and worship, Come and worship,
Worship
Christ, the newborn King.

title: There's a Song in the Air

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There's a song in the air!
There's a star in the sky!
There's a mother's deep prayer
And a baby's low cry!
And the star rains its fire while the beautiful sing,
For the manger of Bethlehem cradles a King!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There's a tumult of joy
O'er the wonderful birth,
For the virgin's sweet boy
Is the Lord of the earth.
Aye! the star rains its fire while the beautiful sing,
For the manger of Bethlehem cradles a King!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
In the light of that star
Lie the ages impearled;
And that song from afar
Has swept over the world.
Every hearth is aflame and the beautiful sing
In the homes of the nations that Jesus is King!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
We rejoice in the light,
And we echo the song
That comes down through the night
From the heavenly throng.
Aye! we shout to the lovely evangel they bring,
And we greet in His cradle our Savior and King!

title: Go, Tell It in the Mountain

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Go, tell it on the mountain,
Over the hills and everywhere:
Go, tell it on the mountain
That
Jesus Christ is born!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
While shepherd kept their watching
O’er silent flocks by night,
Behold throughout the heavens
There shone a holy light.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The shepherds feared and trembled
When lo! Above the earth
Rang out the angel chorus
That hailed our Savior’s birth.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Down in a lowly manger
The humble Christ was born,
And brought us God’s salvation
That blessed Christmas morn.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Hark! the herald angels sing,
"Glory to the new born King,
Peace on earth, and mercy mild,
God and sinners reconciled!"
Joyful, all ye nations rise,
Join the triumph of the skies;
With th' angelic host proclaim,
"Christ is born in Bethlehem!"
Hark! the herald angels sing,
"Glory to the new born King!"

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Hail the heaven-born Prince of Peace!
Hail the Sun of Righteousness!
Light and life to all he brings,
Risen with healing in his wings.
Mild he lays his glory by,
Born that man no more may die,
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth.
Hark! the herald angels sing,
"Glory to the new born King!"

title: As With Gladness Men of Old

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
As with gladness, men of old
Did the guiding star behold
As with joy they hailed its light
Leading onward, beaming bright
So, most glorious Lord, may we
Evermore be led to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
As with joyful steps they sped
To that lowly manger bed
There to bend the knee before Him Whom heaven and earth adore;
So may we with willing feet
Ever seek Thy mercy seat.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
As they offered gifts most rare
At that manger rude and bare;
So may we with holy joy,
Pure and free from sin's alloy,
All our costliest treasures bring,
Christ, to Thee, our heavenly King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Jesus, every day
Keep us in the narrow way;
And, when earthly things are past,
Bring our ransomed souls at last
Where they need no star to guide,
Where no clouds Thy glory hide.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Away in a manger, no crib for a bed
The little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head.
The stars in the bright sky looked down where He lay,
The little Lord Jesus asleep on the hay.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The cattle are lowing the baby awakes,
But little Lord Jesus no crying He makes.
I love Thee, Lord Jesus! Look down from the sky,
And stay by my side till the morning is nigh

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Be near me, Lord Jesus; I ask Thee to stay
Close by me forever, and love me, I pray.
Bless all the dear children in Thy tender care.
And fit for heaven, to live with Thee there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Joy to the world, the Lord is come!
Let earth receive her King;
Let every heart prepare Him room,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heaven, and heaven and nature sing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Joy to the earth, the Savior reigns!
Let men their songs employ;
While fields and floods, rocks, hills, and plains,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat, repeat the sounding joy.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
No more let sin and sorrow grow,
Nor thorns infest the ground;
He comes to make
His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found,
Far as the curse is found,
Far as, far as the curse is found.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He rules the world with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove
The glories of His righteousness,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders, and wonders of His love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
In the bleak midwinter
Frosty wind made moan;
Earth stood hard as iron,
Water like a stone;
Snow had fallen, snow on snow,
Snow on snow
In the bleak midwinter,
Long ago

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
May have gathered there,
Cherubim and seraphim
Thronged the air:
But
His mother only
In her maiden bliss,
Worshiped the beloved
With a kiss.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
What can I give Him,
Poor as I am?
If
I were a shepherd
I would bring a lamb;
If
I were a wise man
I would do my part;
Yet what can I give Him?
Give my heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Infant holy, infant lowly,
For
His bed a cattle stall;
Oxen lowing little knowing
Christ the babe is Lord of all;
Swift are winging angels singing,
Noels ringing tidings bringing,
Christ the babe is Lord of all,
Christ the babe is Lord of all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Flocks were sleeping, shepherds keeping
Virgil till the morning new;
Saw glory, heard the story,
Tidings of the gospel true;
Thus rejoicing, free from sorrow,
Praises voicing greet the morrow,
Christ the babe was born for you,
Christ the babe was born for you.

title: 128  Break Forth, O Beauteous Heavenly Light

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
128  Break Forth, O Beauteous Heavenly Light
Break forth, O beauteous heavenly light,
And usher in the morning;
Ye shepherds, shrink not with affright,
But hear the angel's warning.
This
Child, now weak in infancy,
Our confidence and joy shall be,
The power of Satan breaking,
Our peace eternal making.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Break forth, O beauteous heavenly light,
To herald our salvation;
He stoops to earth---the God of might,
Our hope and expectation.
He comes in human flesh to dwell,
Our
God with us, Immanuel,
The night of darkness ending,
Our fallen race befriending.

title: As it Fell Upon a Night

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
As it fell upon a night
In the winter weather,
Angels bright in starry height
Began to sing together.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Shepherds sleeping on the plain
Woke to see the glory,
All amazed they stood and gazed
And heard the angels’ story.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Unto you a child is born
In a manger lowly
Humble,
He yet born to be
The
King of Love most holy.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Happy angels from a far,
Cease your singing never!
In excelsis gloria!
Forever and forever.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
It came upon the midnight clear,
That glorious song of old,
From angels bending near the earth
To touch their harps of gold;
"Peace on earth, goodwill to men,
From heav'n's all gracious King!"
The world in solemn stillness lay
To hear the angels sing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And ye, beneath life's crushing load,
Whose forms are bending low,
Who toil along the climbing way
With painful steps and slow
Look now! for glad and golden hours
Come swiftly on the wing;
O rest beside the weary road,
And hear the angels sing.

title: Lo, How a Rose E'er Blooming

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lo, how a rose e're blooming
From tenderstem hath sprung,
Of
Jesse's lineage coming
As men of old have sung.
It came, a floweret bright,
Amid the cold of winter
When half spent was the night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Isaiah
'twas foretold it,
The
Rose I have in mind,
With
Mary we beheld it,
The virgin mother kind.
To show God's love aright
She bore to them a Savior,
When half spent was the night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O come, all ye faithful, joyful and triumphant,
O come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem!
Come and behold Him, born the King of angels!
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ, the Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Sing, choirs of angels, sing in exultation,
O sing all ye citizens of heaven above!
Glory to God, all glory in the highest!
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ, the Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Yea,
Lord, we greet Thee, born this happy morning,
Jesus, to Thee be all glory given;
Word of the Father, now in flesh appearing!
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ, the Lord!

title: Now Is Born the DivineChrist Child

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text: Christ Child

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Now is born the divine Christ child,
Play the musette, play the tuneful oboe,
Now is born the divine Christ child,
Sing we all and rejoice this day.
He was born in a stable bare,
On bed of straw how he sleep so soundly,
He was born in a stable bare,
Let us worship and to Him bow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Ages long since are past and gone,
When the wise men foretold His coming,
Ages long since are past and gone,
When the wise man foretold His coming.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild,
Thy
Father’s will hast Thou fulfilled;
For
Thou hast left Thy heavenly throne
Our lowly state to make Thine own.
O
Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild,
With joy hast Thou the whole world filled;
Thou comest down from heaven’s hall
To comfort us whom tears enthrall.
O
Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild,
Thou art love’s image undefiled.
In flame our hearts with love’s pure fire,
That we may share Thy heart’s desire.
O
Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild,
Help us to do as thou hast willed.
What e’er we have belongs to Thee:
O may we ever faithful be
O
Jesus sweet, O Jesus mild.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O little town of Bethlehem
How still we see thee lie!
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep
The silent stars go by;
Yet in thy dark streets shineth
The everlasting light;
The hopes and fears of all the years
Are met in thee tonight.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Christ is born of Mary;
And gathered all above,
While mortals sleep,the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.
O morning stars, together
Proclaim the holy birth!
And praises sing to God the King,
And peace to men on earth.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
How silently, how silently
The wondrous gift is given!
So
God imparts to human hearts
The blessings of His heaven.
No ear may hear His coming;
But in this world of sin,
Where meek souls will receive Him still,
The dear Christ enters in.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O holy Child of Bethlehem,
Descend to us, we pray;
Cast out our sin and enter in
Be born in us today.
We hear the Christmas angels
The great glad tidings tell--
Oh, come to us, abide with us,
Our
Lord Immanuel!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Good Christians, now rejoice,
With heart, and soul and voice;
Give ye heed to what we say:
Jesus
Christ is born today;
Ox and ass before Him bow,
And
He is in the manger now.
Christ is born today!
Christ is born today!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Christians, now rejoice,
With heart, and soul and voice;
Now ye hear of endless bliss:
Jesus
Christ was born for this!
He hath ope’d the heav’nly door,
And we are blessed evermore.
Christ was born for this day!
Christ was born for this day!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Christians, now rejoice,
With heart, and soul and voice;
Now ye need not fear the grave:
Jesus
Christ was born to save!
Calls you one and calls you all
To gain His everlasting hall.
Christ was born to save!
Christ was born to save!

title: We Three KingsO star of wonder, star of night,Star with royal beauty bright,Westward leading, still proceeding,Guide us to Thy perfect light.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
We three kings of Orient are;
Bearing gifts we traverse afar
Field and fountain, moor and mountain,
Following yonder star.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O star of wonder, star of night,
Star with royal beauty bright,
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to Thy perfect light.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Born a King on Bethlehem's plain,
Gold
I bring to crown Him again,
King forever, ceasing never
Over us all to reign.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Myrrh is mine; its bitter perfume
Breathes a life of gathering gloom:
Sorrowing, sighing, bleeding, dying,
Sealed in the stonecold tomb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Glorious now behold Him arise,
King and God and sacrifice;
Alleluia,
Alleluia!
Sounds through the earth and skies.

title: Rise Up, Shepherd, and FollowLeave your sheep and leave your lambs,Rise up, shepherd, and follow.Leave your ewes and leave your rams,Rise up shepherd, and follow.Follow, follow, Rise up, shepherd and follow.Follow the star of Behlehem, Rise up, shepherd, and follow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There's a star in the east on Christmas morn.
Rise up shepherd, and follow.
It will lead to the place where the Savior's born,
Rise up shepherd, and follow.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Leave your sheep and leave your lambs,
Rise up, shepherd, and follow.
Leave your ewes and leave your rams,
Rise up shepherd, and follow.
Follow, follow, Rise up, shepherd and follow.
Follow the star of Behlehem, Rise up, shepherd, and follow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
If you take good heed to the angel's words,
Rise up, shepherd, and follow.
You'll forget your flocks, you'll forget your herds,
Rise up, shepherd, and follow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
All seated on the ground,
The angel of the Lord came down,
And glory shone around.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
“Fear not!” said he– for mighty dread
Had seized their troubled mind–
“Glad tidings of great joy I bring,
To you and all mankind.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
“To you in David’s town this day,
Is born of David’s line,
The
Savior who is Christ the Lord;
And this shall be the sign:

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
“The heavenly Babe you there shall find
To human view displayed,
All meanly wrapped in swathing bands,
And in a manger laid.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Thus spake the seraph; and forth-with
Appeared a shining throng
Of angels praising God on high,
Who thus addressed their song:

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
“All glory be to God on high,
And to the earth be peace;
Good will henceforth from heaven to men,
Begin and never cease!”

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Thou dist leave Thy throne
And
Thy kingly crown
When
Thou camest to earth for me;
But in Bethlehem’s home
Was there found no room
For
Thy holy nativity.
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus,
There is room in my heart for Thee

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Heaven’s arches rang
When the angels sang
Proclaiming
Thy royal degree;
But of lowly birth
Didst
Thou come to earth,
And in greatest humility
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus,
There is room in my heart for Thee

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The foxes found rest,
And the birds their nest
In the shade of the forest tree;
But
Thy couch was the sod,
O
Thou Son of God,
In the deserts of Galilee.
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus,
There is room in my heart for Thee

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thou camest, O Lord,
With the living word
That should set Thy people free;
But with mocking scorn,
And with crown of thorn,
They bore Thee to Calvary.
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus,
There is room in my heart for Thee

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
When the heavens shall ring,
And the angels sing,
At
Thy coming to victory,
Let
Thy voice call me home,
Saying,
“Yet there is room,
There is room at My side for thee.”
My heart shall rejoice, Lord Jesus,
When
Thou comest and callest for me.

title: What Child Is This?This, this is Christ the King,Whom shepherds guard and angels sing:Haste, haste to bring Him laud,The babe, the son of Mary.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
What child is this, who, laid to rest,
On
Mary`s lap is sleeping?
Whom angels greet with anthems sweet,
While shepherds watch are keeping?

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
This, this is Christ the King,
Whom shepherds guard and angels sing:
Haste, haste to bring Him laud,
The babe, the son of Mary.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Why lies He in such mean estate
Where ox and ass are feeding?
Good
Christian, fear: for sinners here
The silent Word is pleading.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
So bring Him incense, gold, and myrrh,
Come, peasant, king, to own Him,
The
King of kings salvation brings,
Let loving hearts enthrone Him.

title: Angels We Have Heard on HighGlo-----------ria, in excelsis Deo,Glo----------ria in excelsis Deo.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Angels we have heard on high,
Singing sweetly through the night,
And the mountains, in reply,
Echoing their brave delight.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Glo-----------ria, in excelsis Deo,
Glo----------ria in excelsis Deo.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Shepherds, why this jubilee?
Why this songs of happy cheer?
What great brightness did you see?
What glad tidings did you hear?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Come to Bethlehem and see
Him whose birth the angels sing;
Come adore, on bended knee,
Christ the Lord, the newborn King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Him in a manger laid,
Whom the angels praise above;
Mary,
Joseph, lend your aid,
While we raise our hearts in love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Silent night! holy night!
All is calm, all is bright
Round yon virgin mother and Child,
Holy
Infant so tender and mild,
Sleep in heavenly peace,
Sleep in heavenly peace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Silent night! holy night!
Darkness flies, all is light;
Shepherds hear the angels sing,
"Alleluia! hail the King!
Christ, the Savior is born,
Christ, the Savior is born.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Silent night! holy night!
Son of God, love's pure light,
Radiant beams from Thy holy face,
With the dawn of redeeming grace,
Jesus,
Lord, at Thy birth,
Jesus,
Lord, at Thy birth.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4

title: O Sing a Song of Bethlehem

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O sing a song of Bethlehem,
Of shepherds watching there,
And of the news that came to them
From angels in the air:
The light that shone on Bethlehem
Fills all the world today;
Of
Jesus’ birth and peace on earth
The angels sing always.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O sing a song of Nazareth,
Of sunny days of joys,
O sing of fragrant flowers breath,
And of the sinless Boy:
For now the flowers of Nazareth
In every heart may grow;
Now spread the fame of His dear name
On all the winds that blow

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O sing a song of Calvary,
Its glory and dismay;
Of
Him who hung upon the tree,
And took our sins away:
For
He who died on Calvary
Is risen from the grave;
And
Christ, our Lord, by heaven adored,
Is mighty now to save.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Songs of thankfulness and praise,
Jesus,
Lord, to You we raise,
Manifested by the star
To the sages from afar;
Branch of royal David’s stem
In
Your birth at Bethlehem;
Anthem be to You addressed,
God in man made manifest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Grant us grace to see You, Lord,
Mirrored in Your holy Word;
May we imitate Your way,
And be pure, as pure we may,
That we like to You may be
At
Your great epiphany;
Let us praise You, ever blest,
God in man made manifest.

title: I Think When I Read That Sweet Story

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I think when I read that sweet story of old,
When
Jesus was here among men,
How
He called little children as lambs to His fold,
I should like to have been with Him then.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I wish that His hands had been placed on my head,
That
His arm had been thrown around me,
And that I might have seen His kind look when He said,
"Let the little ones come unto Me."

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I long for the joy of that glorious time,
The sweetest and brightest and best,
When the dear little children of every clime
Shall crowd to His arms and be blest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ upon the mountain peak
Stands alone in glory blazing;
Let us, if we dare to speak,
With the saints and angels praise Him:
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Trembling at His feet we saw
Moses and Elijah speaking
All the prophets and the law
Shout thro’ them their joyful greeting:
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Swift the cloud of glory came,
God proclaiming in the thunder
Jesus as His Son by name;
Nations cry aloud in wonder
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
This is God’s beloved Son:
Law and prophets fade before Him;
First and last, the only One,
Let creation now adore Him.
Alleluia,
Alleluia, Alleluia

title: O Love, How Deep, How Broad

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O love, how deep how broad, how high,
Beyond all thought and fantasy,
That
God, the Son of God, should take
Our mortal form for mortal’s sake!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
For us by wickedness betrayed,
For us, in crown of thorns arrayed,
He bore the shameful cross and death;
For us He gave His dying breath.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
For us He rose from death again,
For us He went on high to reign;
For us He sent His Spirit here
To guide, to strengthen, and to cheer.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
All glory to Lord and God
For love so deep, so high, so broad;
The
Trinity whom we adore
Forever and forevermore

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Once in royal David’s city
Stood a lowly cattle shed,
Where a mother laid her Baby
In a manger for His bed;
Mary was that mother mild,
Jesus
Christ her little Child.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He came down to earth from heaven,
Who is God and Lord of all,
And
His shelter was a stable,
And
His cradle was a stall;
With the poor, and mean, and lowly,
Lived on earth our Savior holy.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And through all His wondrous childhood
He would honor and obey,
Love and watch the lowly mother
In whose gentle arms He lay.
Christian children all  must be
Mild, obedient, good as He.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And our eyes at last shall see Him,
Through
His own redeeming love;
For that Child so dear and gentle
Is our Lord in heaven above;
And
He leads His children on
To the place where He is gone.

title: Who Is He in Yonder Stall?

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Who is He in yonder stall
At whose feet the shepherds fall?

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
’Tis the Lord, O wondrous story!
’Tis the Lord, the King of glory;
At
His feet, we humbly fall,
Crown
Him, crown Him Lord of all!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Who is He, in deep distress,
Fasting in the wilderness?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Who is He, the gathering throng
Greet with loud triumphant song

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lo, at midnight who is He
Prays in dark Gethsemane?

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Who is He on yonder tree
Dies in shame and agony
Words & Music: Benjamin Russell
Hanby, 1866 (MIDI).

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus walked this lonesome valley;
He had to walk it by Himself.
O nobody else could walk it for Him
He had to walk it by Himself

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I must go and stand my trial.
I have to stand it by myself.
O nobody else could stand it for me.
I have to stand it by myself

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jesus walked this lonesome valley;
He had to walk it by Himself.
O nobody else could walk it for Him.
He had to walk it by Himself.
American White Spiritual
Arr. By Allen W. Foster, 1984 (1940- )

title: Tell Me the Story of JesusTell me the story of Jesus,Write on my heart every word,Tell me the story most precious,Sweetest that ever was heard.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Tell me the story of Jesus,
Write on my heart every word,
Tell me the story most precious
Sweetest that ever was heard;
Tell how the angels, in chorus,
Sang as they welcomed His birth,
Glory to God in the highest,
Peace and good tidings to earth.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Tell me the story of Jesus,
Write on my heart every word,
Tell me the story most precious,
Sweetest that ever was heard.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Fasting, alone in the desert,
Tell of the days that He passed,
How for our sins He was tempted,
Yet was triumphant at last;
Tell of the years of His labor,
Tell of the sorrow He bore,
He was despised and afflicted,
Homeless, rejected, and poor.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Prince of Peace, control my will,
Bid this struggling heart be still;
Bid my fears and doubtings cease,
Hush my spirit into peace

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thou hast bought me with Thy blood,
Opened wide the gate to God
Peace,
I ask, but peace must be,
Lord, in being one with Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thy will, not mine, be done,
May
Thy will and mine be one;
Chase these doubtings from my heart,
Now
Thy perfect peace impart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of Glory died;
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,
Save in the death of Christ, my God;
All the vain things that charm me most,
I sacrifice them to his blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
See, from his head, his hands, his feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down.
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose so rich a crown.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Were the whole realm of nature mine,
That were an offering far too small;
Love so amazing, so divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of glory died,
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
See from His head, His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down!
Did e’er such love and sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I, who was undone and lost,
Have pardon through His name and word;
Forbid it, then, that I should boast,
Save in the cross of Christ my Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Were the whole realm of nature mine,
That were a present far too small:
Love so amazing, so divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O sacred Head, now wounded,
With grief and shame weighed down,
Now scornfully surounded
With thorns, thine only crown:
O sacred head, what glory,
What bliss till now was Thine!
Yet, though despised and gorry,
I joy to call Thee mine!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
What thou, my Lord, has suffered
Was all for sinners' gain;
Mine, mine was the transgression,
But thine the deadly pain.
Lo, here I fall, my Savior!
'Tis
I deserve thy place;
Look on me with thy favor,
Vouch safe to me thy grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
What language shall I borrow
To thank thee, dearest friend,
For this thy dying sorrow,
Thy pity without end?
O make me thine forever;
And should I fainting be,
Lord, let me never, never
Outlive my love for thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Go to dark Gethsemane,
Ye that feel the tempter's power;
Your
Redeemer's conflict see,
Watch with him one bitter hour.
Turn not from his griefs away;
Learn of Jesus Christ to pray.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Oh!
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?
Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?
Oh!
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Were you there when they pierced Him in the side?
Were you there when they pierced Him in the side?
Oh!
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they pierced Him in the side?

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Were you there when the sun refused to shine?
Were you there when the sun refused to shine?
Oh!
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when the sun refused to shine?

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb?
Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb?
Oh!
Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb?
American Negro Spiritual

title: The Old Rugged CrossSo I'll cherish the old rugged cross,Till my trophies at last I lay down;I will cling to the old rugged cross,And exchange it some day for a crown.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
On a hill far away stood an old rugged cross,
The emblem of suffering and shame;
And
I love that old cross where the dearest and best
For a world of lost sinners was slain.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
So I'll cherish the old rugged cross,
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O that old rugged cross, so despised by the world,
Has a wondrous attraction for me;
For the dear Lamb of God left his glory above
To bear it to dark Calvary.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
To that old rugged cross I will ever be true,
Its shame and reproach gladly bear;
Then he'll call me some day to my home far away,
Where his glory forever I'll share.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Ride on, ride on, in majesty!
Hark! all the tribes Hosanna cry;
O
Savior meek, pursue Thy road
With palms and scattered garments strowed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Ride on, ride on, in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die!
O
Christ! Thy triumph now begin
Over captive death and conquered sin.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Ride on, ride on, in majesty!
The winged squadrons of the sky
Look down with sad and wondering eyes
To see the approaching sacrifice.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Ride on, ride on, in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die!
Bow
Thy meek head to mortal pain,
Then take, O God! Thy power and reign.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Throned upon the awful tree,
Lamb of God, Your grief I see.
Darkness veils Your anguished face;
None its lines of woe can trace.
None can tell what pangs unknown
Hold
You silent and alone.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Silent through those three dread hours,
Wrestling with the evil powers,
Left alone with human sin,
Gloom around You and within,
Till the appointed time is nigh,
Til the Lamb of God may die.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Hark, that cry that peals aloud
Upward through the whelming cloud!
You, the Father’s only Son,
You,
His own anointed One,
You are asking—can it be—
“Why have You forsaken Me?”

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord, should fear and anguish roll,
Darkly o’er my sinful soul,
You,
Who once were thus bereft
That
Your own might ne’er be left,
Teach me by that bitter cry
In the gloom to know You nigh.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
What wondrous love is this,
O my soul, O my soul!
What wondrous love is this,
O my soul!
What wondrous love is this
That caused the Lord of bliss
To bear the dreadful curse for my soul, for my soul,
To bear the dreadful curse for my soul.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God and to the Lamb,
I will sing, I will sing;
To
God and to the Lamb,
I will sing.
To
God and to the Lamb
Who is the great I Am;
While millions join the theme,
I will sing, I will sing;
While millions join the theme,
I will sing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3

title: At the CrossAt the cross, at the cross,Where I first saw the light,And the burden of my heart rolled away;It was there by faith I received my sight,And now I am happy all the day!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Alas! and did my Savior bleed,
And did my Sovereign die?
Would he devote that sacred head
For sinners such as I?

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
At the cross, at the cross,
Where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away;
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Was it for crimes that I have done,
He suffered on the tree?
Amazing pity! Grace unknown!
And love beyond degree!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
But drops of grief can ne'er repay
The debt of love I owe:
Here,
Lord, I give myself away;
'Tis all that I can do!

title: There Is a Green Hill Far Away

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There is a green hill far away,
Outside a city wall,
Where the dear Lord was crucified,
Who died to save us all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
We may not know, we cannot tell,
What pains He had to bear;
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffered there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
He died that we might be forgiven,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heaven,
Saved by His precious blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin;
He only could unlock the gate
Of heaven and let us in.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
O dearly, dearly has He loved,
And we must love Him, too,
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His works to do.

title: Look, You Saints! The SightIs Glorious

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Look, ye saints! the sight is glorious:
See the Man of Sorrows now;
From the fight returned victorious,
Every knee to Him shall bow;
Crown
Him, crown Him,
Crown
Him, crown Him,
Crowns become the Victor’s brow,
Crowns become the Victor’s brow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Sinners in derision scorned Him,
Mocking thus the Savior’s claim;
Saints and angels crowd around Him,
Own
His title, praise His name;
Crown
Him, crown Him,
Crown
Him, crown Him,
Spread abroad the Victor’s fame,
Spread abroad the Victor’s fame.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Hark, those bursts of acclamation!
Hark, those loud triumphant chords!
Jesus takes the highest station;
O what joy the sight affords!
Crown
Him, crown Him,
Crown
Him, crown Him,
King of kings and Lord of lords!
King of kings and Lord of lords!

title: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ the Lord is risen today,
Alleluia!
Sons of man and angels say,
Alleluia!
Raise your joys and triumphs high,
Alleluia!
Sing, ye heavens, and earth reply,
Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lives again our glorious King,
Alleluia!
Where,
O death, is now thy sting?
Alleluia!
Once
He died our souls to save,
Alleluia!
Where's thy victory, boasting grave?
Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Love's redeeming work is done,
Alleluia!
Fought the fight, the battle won,
Alleluia!
Death in vain forbids Him rise,
Alleluia!
Christ has opened paradise,
Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Soar we now where Christ has led,
Alleluia!
Following our exalted Head,
Alleluia!
Made like Him, like Him we rise,
Alleluia!
Ours the cross, the grave, the skies,
Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Alleluia! sing to Jesus!
His the scepter, His the throne.
Alleluia!
His the triumph,
His the victory alone.
Hark! the songs of peaceful Zion
Thunder like a mighty flood.
Jesus out of every nation
Hath redeemed us by His blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Alleluia! not as orphans
Are we left in sorrow now;
Alleluia!
He is near us,
Faith believes, nor questions how;
Though the cloud from sight received Him
When the forty days were o’er
Shall our hearts forget His promise,
“I am with you evermore”?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Alleluia!
Bread of heaven,
Thou on earth our food and stay!
Alleluia! here the sinful
Flee to Thee from day to day:
Intercessor,
Friend of sinners, Earth’s Redeemer plead for me,
Where the songs of all the sinless
Sweep across the crystal sea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
And have the bright immensities
Received our risen Lord,
Where light years frame the Pleiades
And point Orion’s sword?
Do flaming suns His footsteps trace
Thro’ corridors sublime
The lord of interstellar space
And conquer of time?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The heav’n that hides Him from our sight
Knows neither nor far;
A little candle sheds its light
As surely as a star.
And where His loving people meet
To share the gift divine,
There stands He with un-hurrying feet;
There heav’nly splendors shine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, ye faithful, raise the strain
Of triumphant gladness;
God hath brought forth Israel
Onto joy from sadness;
Now rejoice, Jerusalem,
And with true affection
Welcome in unworried strains
Jesus’ resurrection.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
’Tis the spring of souls today;
Christ has burst His prison,
From the frost and gloom of death
Light and life have risen.
All the winter of our sins,
Long and dark, is flying
From His light, to whom we give
Thanks and praise undying.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
“Alleluia!” now we cry
To our King immortal,
Who, triumphant, burst the bars
Of the tomb’s dark portal;
“Alleluia!” with the Son,
God the Father praising,
“Alleluia!” yet again
To the Spirit raising.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, ye faithful, raise the strain
Of triumphant gladness;
God hath brought forth Israel
Into joy from sadness;
Loosed from Pharaoh’s bitter yoke
Jacob’s sons and daughters,
Led them with unmoistened foot
Through the Red Sea waters.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
’Tis the spring of souls today;
Christ has burst His prison,
And from three days’ sleep in death
As a sun hath risen;
All the winter of our sins,
Long and dark, is flying
From
His light, to whom is giv'n
Laud and praise undying.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Now the queen of seasons, bright
With the day of splendor,
With the royal feast of feasts,
Comes its joy to render;
Comes to gladden faithful hearts,
Which with true affection
Welcome in unwearied strains
Jesus’ resurrection.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
For today among the twelve
Christ appeared, bestowing
His deep peace, which evermore
Passes human knowing.
Neither could be the gates of death,
Nor the tomb’s dark portal,
Nor the watchers, nor the seal,
Hold
Him as mortal.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
“Alleluia!” now we cry
To our King immortal,
Who, triumphant, burst the bars
Of the tomb’s dark portal;
“Alleluia!” with the Son,
God the Father praising,
“Alleluia!” yet again
To the Spirit raising.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Thine is the glory,
Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the victory
Thou o'er death hast won.
Angels in bright raiment
Rolled the stone away,
Kept the folded grave-clothes
Where Thy body lay.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Thine is the glory,
Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the victory
Thou o'er death hast won.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lo! Jesus meets us.
Risen from the tomb,
Lovingly
He greets us,
Scatters fear and gloom;
Let His
Church with gladness
Hymns of triumph sing,
For her
Lord now liveth;
Death has lost its sting.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Alleluia!
Alleluia! Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord, by the stripes which wounded You,
From death’s sting free Your servants too,
That we may live, and sing to You: Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Good Christian friends, rejoice and sing!
Now is the triumph of our King!
To all the world glad news we bring:
Alleluia!
Alleluia! Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Praise we in songs of victory
That love, that life which cannot die,
And sing with hearts uplifted high:
Alleluia!
Alleluia! Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thy name we bless, O risen Lord.
And sing today with one accord
The life laid down, the life restored:
Alleluia!
Alleluia! Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Star of our hope! He’ll soon appear,
The last trumpet speaks Him near;
Hail Him all saints, from pole to pole
How welcome to the faithful soul!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
From heaven angelic voices sound:
Behold the Lord of glory crowned,
Arrayed in majesty divine,
And in His highest glories shine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The grave yields up its precious trust,
Which long has slumbered in the dust,
Resplendent forms ascending, fair,
Now meet the Savior in the air.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Descending with His azure throne,
He clailms the kingdom for His own;
The saints rejoice, they shout, they sing,
And hail him their triumphant King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
In the grave they laid Him, love by hatred slain,
Thinking that He would never wake again,
Laid in the earth like grain that sleeps unseen;
Love is come again like wheat a rising green.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
He came in triumph, like the risen grain,
He that for three days in the grave had lain,
Raised from the dead, my living Lord is seen;
Love is come again like wheat a rising green.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
When our hearts are wintry, grieving, or in pain,
Your touch can call us back to life again,
Fields of our heart that dead and bare have been;
Love is come again like wheat a rising green.

title: Hail the Day ThatSees Him Rise

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Hail the day that sees Him rise, Alleluia!
Glorious to His native skies, Alleluia!
Christ, awhile to mortals given, Alleluia!
Enters now the highest heav’n, Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There the glorious triumph waits, Alleluia!
Lift your heads, eternal gates, Alleluia!
Wide unfold the radiant scene; Alleluia!
Take the King of glory in, Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
See!
He lifts His hands above, Alleluia!
See!
He shows the prints of love, Alleluia!
Hark!
His gracious lips bestow, Alleluia!
Blessings on His church below, Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord, beyond our mortal sight, Alleluia!
Raise our hearts to reach Thy height, Alleluia!
There
Thy face unclouded see, Alleluia!
Find our heav’n of heav’n in Thee. Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus, Your blood and righteousness
My beauty are, my glorious dress;
Mid flaming worlds, in these arrayed,
With joy shall I lift up my head.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Bold shall I stand in that great day;
Cleansed and redeemed, no debt to pay?
For by Your cross absolved I am
From sin and guilt, from fear and shame.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord,
I believe Your precious blood,
Which at the mercy seat of God
Pleads for the captives’ liberty,
Was also shed in love for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
When from the dust of death I rise
To claim my mansion in the skies,
This then this shall be all my only plea,
Christ
Jesus lived and died for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Once our blessed Christ of beauty
Was veiled off from human view;
But through suffering, death and sorrow
He has rent the veil in two.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O behold the Man of Sorrows,
O behold Him in plain view;
Lo!
He is the mighty Conqueror,
Since
He rent the veil in two.
Lo!
He is the mighty Conqueror,
Since
He rent the veil in two.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Yes,
He is with God the Father,
Interceding there for you;
For
He is the Well beloved
Since
He rent the veil in two.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Holy angels bow before Him,
Men of earth give praises due;
For
He is the mighty Conqueror
Since
He rent the veil in two.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The wonders of redeeming love
Our highest thought exceed;
The
Son of God comes from above
For sinful man to bleed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He gives Himself, His life, His all,
A sinless sacrifice.
For man He drains the cup of gall,
For man the victim dies.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And now before His Father’s face
His precious blood He pleads;
For those who seek the throne of grace
His love still intercedes.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He knows the frailties of our frame,
For
He has borne our grief;
Our great High Priest once felt the same,
And
He can send relief.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
His love will not be satisfied,
Till
He in glory sees
The faithful ones for whom He died
From sin forever free.

title: O Listen to Our Wondrous Story

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O listen to our wondrous story,
Counted once among the lost;
Yet
One came down from heaven’s glory,
Saving us at awful cost!

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Who saved us from eternal loss?
Who but God's Son upon the cross?
What did He do?
He died for you!
Where is He now?
In heaven interceding !

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
No angel could His place have taken,
Highest of the high tho’ he;
The loved One on the cross forsaken
Was
One of the Godhead three!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Will you surrender to this Savior?
To
His scepter humbly bow?
You, too, shall come to know His favor,
He will save you, save you now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus care when my heart is pained
Too deeply for mirth and song;
As the burdens press, and the cares distress,
And the way grows weary and long?

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O yes,
He cares--- I know He cares!
His heart is touched with my grief;
When the days are weary,
The long nights dreary,
I know my Savior cares. (He cares.)

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Does Jesus care when my way is dark
With a nameless dread and fear?
As the daylight fades into deep night shades,
Does He care enough to be near?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Does Jesus care when I’ve said goodbye
To the dearest on earth to me,
And my sad heart aches till it nearly breaks ­
Is it aught to Him? Does He see?

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ is alive!
Let
Christians sing.
His cross stands empty to the sky.
Let streets and homes with praises ring.
His love in death shall never die.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Christ is alive!
No longer bound
To distant years in Palestine,
He comes to claim the here and now
And conquer every place and time.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
In every insult, rift, and war
Where color, scorn or wealth divide,
He suffers still, yet loves the more,
And lives, though ever crucified.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Christ is alive!
Ascended
Lord
He rules the world His Father made,
Till, in the end, His love adored
Shall be to all on earth displayed.

title: I Will Sing of Jesus' LoveI will sing of Jesus loveEndless praise my heart shall give;He has died that I might liveI will sing His love to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I Will sing of Jesus love,
Sing of Him,who first loved me; for He left bright worlds above,
And died on Calvary.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I will sing of Jesus love
Endless praise my heart shall give;
He has died that I might live
I will sing His love to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O the depths of love divine!
Earth or heaven can never know
How that sin as dark as mine
Can be made as white as snow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Nothing good for Him I've done;
How could He such love bestow?
Lord, I own my heart is won,
Help me now my love to show.

title: Jesus Paid It AllJesus paid it all,All to Him I owe;Sin had left a crimson stain;He washed it white as snow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I hear the Savior say,
"Thy strength indeed is small;
Child of weakness, watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all."

stanzas.label: Chorus
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord, now indeed I find
Thy power, and Thine alone,
Can change the leper's spots,
And melt the heart of stone.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Since nothing good have I
Whereby
Thy grace to claim,
I'll wash my garment white
In the blood of Calvary's Lamb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And when before the throne
I stand in Him complete,
I'll lay my trophies down,
All down at Jesus' feet.

title: Jesus Is All the World to Me

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus is all the world to me,
My life, my joy, my all;
He is my strength from day to day,
Without him I would fall.
When
I am sad, to Him I go,
No other one can cheer me so;
When
I am sad, He makes me glad,
He's my friend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Jesus is all the world to me,
My friend in trials sore;
I go to Him for blessings, and
He gives them o'er and o'er.
He sends the sunshine and the rain,
He sends the harvest's golden grain;
Sunshine and rain, harvest of grain,
He's my friend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jesus is all the world to me,
And true to Him I'll be;
O how could I this friend deny,
When he's so true to me?
Following
Him I know I'm right,
He watches o'er me day and night;
Following him by day and night,
He's my friend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Jesus is all the world to me,
I want no better friend;
I trust Him now, I'll trust Him when
Life's fleeting days shall end.
Beautiful life with such a friend,
Beautiful life that has no end;
Eternal life, eternal joy,
He's my friend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
He loved me ere I knew Him;
He drew me with the cords of love,
And thus He bound me to Him.
And
'round my heart still closely twine
Those ties which nought can sever,
For
I am His, and He is mine,
Forever and forever.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
He bled, He died to save me;
And not alone the gift of life,
But
His own self He gave me.
Nought that I have my own I call,
I hold it for the Giver;
My heart, my strength, my life my all,
Are
His, and His forever.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
All power to Him is given;
To guard me on my upward course,
And bring me safe to heaven.
The eternal glories gleam afar,
To nerve my faint endeavor;
So now to watch, to work, to war,
And then to rest forever.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!
So kind, and true, and tender,
So wise a counselor and guide,
So mighty a defender.
From
Him, who loveth me so well,
What power my soul can sever?
Shall life or death, or earth, or hell?
No;
I am His forever.

title: Jesus, What a Friend for Sinners

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus! what a Friend for sinners!
Jesus!
Lover of my soul;
Friends may fail me, foes assail me,
He, my Savior, makes me whole.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Hallelujah! what a Savior!
Hallelujah! what a Friend!
Saving, helping, keeping, loving,
He is with me to the end.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Jesus! what a Strength in weakness!
Let me hide myself in Him.
Tempted, tried, and sometimes failing,
He, my Strength, my victory wins.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jesus! what a Help in sorrow!
While the billows o’er me roll,
Even when my heart is breaking,
He, my Comfort, helps my soul.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Jesus!
I do now receive Him,
More than all in Him I find.
He hath granted me forgiveness,
I am His, and He is mine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
My song is love unknown,
My
Savior’s love to me;
Love to the loveless shown,
That they might lovely be.
O who am I, that for my sake
My
Lord should take frail flesh and die?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He came from His blest throne
Salvation to bestow;
But men made strange, and none
The longed for Christ would know:
But
O! my Friend, my Friend indeed,
Who at my need His life did spend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Sometimes they strew His way,
And
His sweet praises sing;
Resounding all the day
Hosannas to their King:
Then
“Crucify!” is all their breath,
And for His death they thirst and cry.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Why, what hath my Lord done?
What makes this rage and spite?
He made the lame to run,
He gave the blind their sight,
Sweet injuries! Yet they at these
Themselves displease, and ’gainst Him rise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
They rise and needs will have
My dear Lord made away;
A murderer they saved,
The
Prince of life they slay,
Yet cheerful He to suffering goes,
That
He His foes from thence might free.

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
Here might I stay and sing,
No story so divine;
Never was love, dear King!
Never was grief like Thine.
This is my Friend, in Whose sweet praise
I all my days could gladly spend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Who can cheer the heart like Jesus,
By
His presence all divine?
True and tender, pure and precious,
Oh, how blest to call Him mine!

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
All that thrills my soul is Jesus;
He is more than like to me; (to me;)
And the fairest of ten thousand,
In my blessed Lord I see.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Love of Christ so freely given,
Grace of God beyond degree,
Mercy higher than the heaven,
Deeper than the deepest sea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Every need His hand supplying,
Every good in Him I see;
On
His strength divine relying,
He is All in All to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
By the crystal flowing river
With the ransomed I will sing,
And for ever and forever
Praise and glorify the King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus loves me! this I know,
For the Bible tells me so.
Little ones to Him belong;
They are weak, but He is strong.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Yes,
Jesus loves me!
Yes,
Jesus loves me!
Yes,
Jesus loves me!
The
Bible tells me so.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Jesus loves me! He who died
Heaven’s gate to open wide;
He will wash away my sin,
Let
His little child come in.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jesus, take this heart of mine,
Make it pure and wholly Thine;
On the cross You died for me,
I will love and live for Thee

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Come, Almighty to deliver,
Let us all Thy grace receive;
Suddenly return and never,
Nevermore thy temples leave.
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve thee as thy hosts above,
Pray and praise thee without ceasing,
Glory in thy perfect love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Finish, then, thy new creation;
Pure and spotless let us be.
Let us see thy great salvation
Perfectly restored in thee;
Changed from glory into glory,
Till in heaven we take our place, till we cast our crowns before thee,
Lost in wonder, love, and praise.
Thai # 2

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Shepherd divine, I know Thou art mine;
Thy search in the night was for me.
This bleak world is cold, but warm is Thy fold;
My
Shepherd, I follow Thee.
Thy beautiful lamp shineth bright o’er my way,
Thy glorious light unto Thy perfect day.
Thro’ pastures serene,
Thro’ valleys of green,
My
Shepherd, I follow Thee

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Shepherd divine, I know Thou art mine;
Thy grace heart was broken for me.
Thy grace and Thy law I picture in awe;
They kissed upon Calvary.
Ah! life that was given to ransom my soul,
Ah! heart that was broken to make sinner whole,
This world is but loss
In view of Thy cross,
My
Shepherd, I follow Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Shepherd divine, I know Thou art mine;
I hear Thee say, “Follow thou Me.”
Thy message today illumines my way;
The
Spirit of Prophecy.
I thrill at Thy marvelous love to Thy sheep,
The way Thou dost lead to the still waters deep,
One staff and one rod,
One fold and one God,
My
Shepherd, I follow Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Savior, teach me day by day
Love’s sweet lesson to obey,
Sweeter lesson cannot be,
Loving
Him Who first loved me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
With a child’s glad heart of love
At
Thy bidding may I move,
Prompt to serve and follow Thee,
Loving
Him Who first loved me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Teach me I am not my own,
I am Thine, and Thine alone;
Thine to keep, to rule, to save
From all sin that would enslave

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Love in loving finds employ,
In obedience all her joy;
Ever new that joy will be,
Loving
Him Who first loved me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Teach me thus Thy steps to trace,
Strong to follow in Thy grace,
Learning how to love from Thee,
Loving
Him Who first loved me.

title: Sing We of the Modern City

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Sing we of the modern city,
Scene alike of joy and stress;
Sing we of its nameless people
In their urban wilderness.
Into endless rows of houses
Life is set a million fold,
Life expressed in human beings
Daily born and growing old.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
In the city full of people,
World of speed and hectic days,
In the ever charging setting
Of the latest trend and craze,
Christ is present, and among us;
In the crowd we see Him stand.
In the bustle of the city
Jesus
Christ is every man.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God is not remote in heaven,
But on earth to share our shame,
Changing graph and mass and number
Into persons with a name.
Christ has shown, beyond statistics,
Human life with glory crowned,
By
His timeless presence providing
People matter, people count!

title: Showers of BlessingShowers of blessing,Showers of blessing we need;Mercy drops round us are falling,But for the showers we plead.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
"There shall be showers of blessing;"
This is the promise of love;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
Sent from the Savior above.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need;
Mercy drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
"There shall be showers of blessing;"
Precious reviving again;
Over the hills and the valleys,
Sound of abundance of rain.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
"There shall be showers of blessing;"
O that today they might fall,
Now as to God were confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call!

title: Tell Me the Old, Old Story

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Tell me the old, old story,
Of unseen things above,
Of
Jesus and His glory,
Of
Jesus and His love;
Tell me the story simply,
As to a little child,
For
I am weak and weary,
And helpless and defiled.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Tell me the story softly,
With earnest tones and grave;
Remember
I'm the sinner
Whom
Jesus came to save;
Tell me the story always,
If you would really be,
In any time of trouble,
A comforter to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Tell me the same old story,
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Is costing me too dear;
Yes, and when that world's glory Is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the old, old story:
"Christ
Jesus makes thee whole."

title: The King of LoveMy Shepherd Is

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The King of love my Shepherd is,
Whose goodness faileth never,
I nothing lack if I am His
And
He is mine forever.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Where streams of living water flow
My ransomed soul He leadeth,
And, where the verdant pastures grow,
With food celestial feedeth.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Perverse and foolish oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me,
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And home, rejoicing, brought me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And so through all the length of days
Thy goodness faileth never;
Good
Shepherd! I would sing Thy praise
Within
Thy house forever.

title: And Can It Be?Amazing love!Amazing love!How can it beHow can it beThat thou, my God, shouldst diefor me?

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
And can it be that I should gain
An interest in the Savior's blood!
Died he for me? who caused His pain!
For me? who him to death pursued?
Amazing love! How can it be
That thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Amazing love!
Amazing love!
How can it be
How can it be
That thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He left his Father's throne above
So free, so infinite his grace;
Emptied himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race.
'Tis mercy all, immense and free,
For
O my God, it found out me!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
No condemnation now I dread;
Jesus, and all in Him, is mine;
Alive in him, my living Head,
And clothed in righteousnes divine,
Bold
I approach th' eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through Christ my own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The head that once was crowned with thorns
Is crowned with glory now;
A royal diadem adorns
The mighty victor’s brow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The highest place that heaven affords
Is
His, is His by right;
The
King of kings and Lord of lords,
And heaven’s eternal light.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The joy of all who dwell above,
The joy of all below,
To whom He manifests His love,
And grants His Name to know.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
To them the cross with all its shame,
With all its grace, is given;
Their name an everlasting name,
Their joy the joy of heaven.
Thomas Kelly (1769-1855)
Jeremiah Clark (1669-1707)
Arr.
By Melvin West, 1984 (1930-   )

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The Lord is coming, let this be
The herald note of jubilee;
And when we meet and when we part
The salutation from the heart.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Lord is coming, let this be
The herald note of jubilee,
The herald note of jubilee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord is coming! sound it forth
From east to west, from south to north;
Speed on! speed on the tidings glad,
That none who love Him may be sad.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord is coming, swift and sure
And all His judgments shall endure;
And none can hope to escape His wrath,
Who walk not in the narrow path.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
The earth, with her ten thousand wrongs
Will soon be tuned in nobler songs;
Our praise shall then, in realms of light,
With all His universe unite.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ is coming! let creation
Bid her groans and travail cease;
Let the glorious proclamation
Hope restore and faith increase;
Christ is coming! Christ is coming!
Come,
Thou blessed Prince of Peace!
(Prince of Peace!)
Come,
Thou blessed Prince of Peace!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Earth can now but tell the story
Of
Thy bitter cross and pain;
She shall yet behold Thy glory
When
Thou comest back to reign;
Christ is coming! Christ is coming!
Let each heart repeat the strain.
(repeat the strain)
Let each heart repeat the strain.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
With that "blessed hope" before us,
Let no harp remain unstrung;
Let the mighty advent chorus
Onward roll from tongue to tongue:
Christ is coming! Christ is soling!
Come,
Lord Jesus, quickly come!
(quickly come!)
Come,
Lord Jesus, quickly come!

title: Hail Him the King of GloryHail Him the king of glory,Once the Lamb for sinners slain;Tell, tell the wondrous story,"Jesus comes to reign."

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Tell it to every kindred and nation,
Tell it far and near;
Earth's darkest night will fade with the dawning,
Jesus will soon appear.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Hail Him the king of glory,
Once the Lamb for sinners slain;
Tell, tell the wondrous story,
"Jesus comes to reign."

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Nations again in strife and commotion,
Warnings by the way;
Signs in the heavens, unerring omens,
Herald the glorious day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Christ has died!
Christ is risen!
Christ will come again!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
By this we are upheld
When doubt and grief assails
Our
Christian fortitude,
And only grace avails.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
This is the threefold truth
Which, if we hold it fast,
Changes the world and us
And brings us home at last.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, thou long expected Jesus!
Born to set thy people free; from our fears and sins release us,
Let us find our rest in thee.
Israel's strength and consolation,
Hope of all the earth thou art;
Dear
Desire of every nation,
Joy of every longing heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Born thy people to deliver,
Born a child and yet a King,
Born to reign in us forever,
Now thy gracious kingdom bring.
By thine own eternal spirit
Rule in all our hearts alone;
By
Thy all sufficient merit,
Raise us to thy glorious throne.

title: Gleams of the Golden MorningO, we see the gleams of the golden morningPiercing thro' this night of gloom!O, see the gleams of the golden morningThat will burst the tomb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The golden morning is fast approaching;
Jesus soon will come
To take his faithful and happy children
To their promised home.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O, we see the gleams of the golden morning
Piercing thro' this night of gloom!
O, see the gleams of the golden morning
That will burst the tomb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The gospel summons will soon be carried
To the nations round;
The
Bridegroom then will cease to tarry
And the trumpet sound.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Attended by all the shining angels,
Down the flaming sky
The
Judge will come, and will take his people
Where they will not die.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
There those loved ones who have long parted,
Will all meet that day;
The tears of those who are broken-hearted
Will be wiped away.

title: Face to FaceFace to face shall I behold Him,Far beyond the starry sky;Face to face in all His gloryI shall see Him by and by!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Face to face with Christ my Savior,
Face to face, what will it be,
When with rapture I behold Him,
Jesus
Christ, who died for me?

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Face to face shall I behold Him,
Far beyond the starry sky;
Face to face in all His glory
I shall see Him by and by!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Only faintly now I see Him,
With the darkening veil between,
But a blessed day is coming,
When
His glory shall be seen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
What rejoicing in His presence,
When are banished grief and pain;
When the crooked ways are straightened,
And the dark things shall be plain!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Face to face! oh, blissful moment!
Face to face to see and know;
Face to face with my Redeemer,
Jesus
Christ, who loves me so.

title: It May Be at MornO Lord Jesus, how long, how longEre we shout the glad song?Christ returneth, Hallelujah!Hallelujah! Amen, Hallelujah! Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
It may be at morn, when the day is awaking,
When sunlight through darkness and shadow is breaking,
That
Jesus will come in the fullness of glory
To receive from the world His own.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O Lord Jesus, how long, how long
Ere we shout the glad song?
Christ returneth, Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Amen, Hallelujah! Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
It may be at midday, it may be at twilight,
It may be, perchance, that the blackness of midnight
Will burst into light in the blaze of
His glory,
When
Jesus receives His own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O joy! O delight! should we go without dying,
No sickness, no sadness, no dread, and no crying,
Caught up through the clouds with our Lord into glory,
When
Jesus receives His own.

title: There'll Be No Dark ValleyTo gather His loved ones home,To gather His loved ones home.There'll be no dark valleys when Jesus comes,To gather His loved ones home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There'll be no dark valley when
Jesus comes,
There'll be no dark valley when
Jesus comes,
There'll be no dark valley when
Jesus comes,
To gather His loved ones home.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
To gather His loved ones home,
To gather His loved ones home.
There'll be no dark valleys when Jesus comes,
To gather His loved ones home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There'll be no more sorrow when
Jesus comes,
There'll be no more sorrow when
Jesus comes,
But a glorious morrow when
Jesus comes
To gather His loved ones home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
There'll be songs of greeting when
Jesus comes,
There'll be songs of greeting when
Jesus comes,
And a joyful meeting when
Jesus comes,
To gather His loved ones home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
That glorious day is coming,
The hour is hastening on;
Its radiant light is nearing,
Far brighter than the sun;
In yonder clouds of heaven,
The
Savior will appear,
And gather all His chosen,
To meet Him in the air.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Christian, keep from sleeping,
And let your love abound;
Be watchful, prayerful, faithful,
The trumpet soon will sound!
O sinner, hear the warning!
To
Jesus quickly fly!
Then you, in that blest morning,
May meet Him in the sky!

title: Wake, Awake, for the NightIs Flying

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Wake, awake, for night is flying,
The watchmen on the heights are crying,
Awake,
Jerusalem, arise!
Midnight's solemn hour is tolling,
His chariot wheels are nearer rolling,
He comes; prepare, ye virgins wise.
Rise up with willing feet
Go forth, the Bridegroom meet; Alleluia!
Bear through the night your well-trimmed light,
Speed forth to join the marriage rite.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Zion hears the watchmen singing,
Her heart with deep delight is springing,
She wakes, she rises from her gloom;
Forth her Bridegroom comes, all-glorious,
In grace arrayed, by truth victorious;
Her
Star is risen, her Light is come!
All hail, incarnate Lord,
Our crown, and our reward! Alleluia!
We haste along, in pomp and song,
And gladsome join the marriage throng.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lamb of God, the heavens adore Thee,
And men and angels sing before Thee,
With harp and cymbal's clearest tone.
By the pearly gates in wonder
We stand, and swell the voice of thunder,
That echoes round Thy dazzling throne.
No vision ever brought,
No ear hath ever caught,
Such bliss and joy;
We raise the song, we swell the throng,
To praise Thee ages all along.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lo! He comes with clouds descending,
Once for favored sinners slain;
Countless angels, Him attending,
Swell the triumph of His train:
Hallelujah!
Hallelujah!
Jesus comes, and comes to reign

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Every eye shall now behold Him
Robed in dreadful majesty;
Those who set at naught and sold Him,
Pierced and nailed Him to the tree,
Deeply wailing, deeply wailing,
Shall the true Messiah see.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
When the solemn trump has sounded,
Heaven and earth shall flee away;
All who hate Him, must, confounded,
Hear the summons of that day–
“Come to judgment! Come to judgment!
Come to judgment! Come away!”

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Yea, amen! let all adore Thee,
High on Thy eternal throne;
Savior, take the power and glory,
Make
Thy righteous sentence known;
O come quickly! O come quickly!
Claim the kingdom for Thine own!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come
’Tis almost time for the Lord to come,
I hear the people say;
The stars of heaven are growing dim,
It must be the breaking of the day.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!
The night is almost gone,
The day is coming on;
O it must be the breaking of the day!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The signs foretold in the sun and moon,
In earth and sea and sky,
Aloud proclaim to all mankind,
The coming of the Master draweth nigh.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
It must be time for the waiting church
