To cast her pride away,
With girded loins and burning lamps,
To look for the breaking of the day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Go quickly out in the streets and lanes
And in the broad highway,
And call the maimed, the halt, and blind,
To be ready for the breaking of the day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lift up the trumpet, and loud let it ring:
Jesus is coming again!
Cheer up, ye pilgrims, be joyful and sing:
Jesus is coming again!

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Coming again, coming again,
Jesus is coming again!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Echo it, hilltops; proclaim it, ye plains:
Jesus is coming again!
Coming in glory, the Lamb that was slain;
Jesus is coming again!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Heavings of earth, tell the vast, wondering throng:
Jesus is coming again!
Tempests and whirlwinds, the anthem prolong;
Jesus is coming again!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Nations are angry—by this we do know
Jesus is coming again!
Knowledge increases; men run to and fro;
Jesus is coming again!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
We have this hope that burns within our hearts,
Hope in the coming of the Lord
We have this faith that Christ alone imparts,
Faith in the promise of His Word.
We believe that time is here,
When the nations far and near
Shall awake and shout and sing
Hallelujah!
Christ is King!
We have this hope that burns within our hearts
Hope in the coming of the Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The King shall come when morning dawns,
And light triumphant breaks;
When beauty gilds the eastern hills,
And life to joy awakes.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Not as of old a little child
To bear, and fight, and die,
But crowned with glory like the sun
That lights the morning sky.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O brighter than the rising morn
When
He, victorious, rose,
And left the lonesome place of death,
Despite the rage of foes.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O brighter than that glorious morn
Shall dawn upon our race,
The day when Christ in splendor comes,
And we His face shall see.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
King shall come when morning dawns,
And light and beauty brings.
Hail,
Christ the Lord! Thy people pray,
Come quickly, King of kings.

title: When the Roll Is Called Up YonderWhen the roll is called up yonder,When the roll is called up yonder,When the roll is called up yonder,When the roll is called up yonder,I'll be there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound,
And time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks, eternal, bright and fair;
When the saved of earth shall gather
Over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
On that bright and cloudless morning, when the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His resurection share;
When
His chosen ones shall gather to their home beyond the skies,
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Let us labor for the Master from the dawn till setting sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous love and care,
Then, when all of life is over, and our work on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder
I'll be there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The church has waited long
Her absent Lord to see;
And still in loneliness she waits,
A friendless stranger she.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
How long, O Lord our God,
Holy and true and good,
Wilt
Thou not judge Thy suffering church,
Her sighs and tears and blood?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We long to hear Thy voice,
To see Thee face to face,
To share Thy crown and glory then,
As now we share Thy grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Come,
Lord, and wipe away
The curse, the sin, the stain,
And make this blighted world of ours
Thine own fair world again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When He cometh, when He cometh
To make up His jewels,
All
His jewels, precious jewels,
His loved and His own.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Like the stars of the morning,
His bright crown adorning,
They shall shine in their beauty,
Bright gems for His crown.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He will gather, He will gather
The gems for His kingdom;
All the pure ones, all the bright ones,
His loved and His own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Little children, little children,
Who love their Redeemer,
Are the jewels, precious jewels,
His loved and His own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When Jesus comes in glory,
As
Lord and King of kings,
O what a wondrous story
The blessed Bible brings;
His face will shine like sunlight,
His head be white as snow,
His eyes like flaming firelight,
His feet like brass aglow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
His voice like rushing waters
Will reach with mighty sound
Into the deepest quarters
Of all creation round;
And at this wondrous greeting
The dead in Christ shall rise,
Their
Lord and Savior meeting,
In glory in the skies.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And we who are believing,
And
His appearing love,
Shall know we are receiving
His glory from above;
His resurrection power
Will raise us to the place
Where we that wondrous hour
Shall see Him face to face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O hasten Thine appearing,
Thou bright and Morning Star!
Lord, may we soon be hearing
The trumpet sound afar;
Thy people are all yearning
To be Thy raptured bride,
And at Thine own returning
Be caught up at Thy side.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When He comes, (when He comes)
When
He comes, (when He comes)
We shall see the Lord in glory
When
He comes! (when He comes)
As
I read the gospel story,
We shall see the Lord in glory
We shall see the Lord in glory
When
He comes! (when He comes)

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
With the alleluias ringing to the sky, (to the sky)
With the alleluias ringing to the sky, (to the sky)
As
I read the gospel story,
We shall see the Lord in glory
With the alleluias ringing to the sky, (to the sky)

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He comes, (when He comes)
When
He comes, (when He comes)
We shall hear the trumpet sounded
When
He comes! (when He comes)
We shall hear the trumpet sounded
See the Lord by saints surrounded,
We shall hear the trumpet sounded
When
He comes! (when He comes)

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
With the alleluias ringing to the sky, (to the sky)
With the alleluias ringing to the sky, (to the sky)
We shall hear the trumpet sounded
See the Lord by saints surrounded,
With the alleluias ringing to the sky, (to the sky)

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
He comes, (when He comes)
When
He comes, (when He comes)
We shall all rise up to meet Him
When
He comes, (when He comes)
We shall all rise up to meet
When
He calls His own to greet Him
We shall all rise up to meet Him
When
He comes, (when He comes)

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
With the alleluias ringing to the sky, (to the sky)
With the alleluias ringing to the sky, (to the sky)
We shall all rise up to meet
When
He calls His own to greet Him
With the alleluias ringing to the sky, (to the sky)

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Rejoice, the Lord is King!
Your
Lord and King adore!
Rejoice, give thanks, and sing
And triumph evermore:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice!
Rejoice, again
I say, rejoice!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Jesus, the Savior, reigns,
The
God of truth and love;
When
He had purged our stains,
He took His seat above:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice!
Rejoice, again
I say, rejoice!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
His kingdom cannot fail,
He rules o'er earth and heaven;
The keys of death and grave
Are to our Jesus given:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice!
Rejoice, again
I say, rejoice!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Rejoice in glorious hope!
Our
Lord the judge shall come,
And take His servants up
To their eternal home:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice!
Rejoice, again
I say, rejoice!

title: Hark! Ten Thousand Harps and Voices

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Hark! ten thousand harps and voices
Sound the note of praise above;
Jesus reigns, and heaven rejoices,
Jesus reigns, the God of love:
See,
He sits on yonder throne;
Jesus rules the world alone.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
King of glory, reign forever,
Thine an everlasting crown;
Nothing from Thy love shall sever
Those whom Thou hast made Thine own;
Happy objects of Thy grace,
Destined to behold Thy face.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Savior, hasten Thine appearing;
Bring,
O bring the glorious day,
When, the awful summons hearing,
Heaven and earth shall pass away:;
Then, with golden harps we'll sing,
"Glory, glory to our King!"
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Crown him with many crowns,
The Lamb upon his throne,
Hark! how the heavenly anthem drowns
All music but its own.
Awake, my soul, and sing
Of him who died for thee,
And hail him as thy matchless King
Through all eternity.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Crown him the Lord of love!
Behold his hands and side,
Those wounds, yet visible above,
In beauty glorified;
No angel in the sky
Can fully bear that sight,
But downward bend his wondering eye
At mysteries so great.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Crown him the Lord of peace!
Whose had a scepter sways
From pole to pole, that wars may cease,
And all be prayer and praise.
His reign shall know no end,
And round his pierced feet
Fair flowers of paradise extend
Their fragrance ever sweet.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Crown him the Lord of years;
The potentate of time,
Creator of the rolling spheres,
Ineffably sublime!
All hail, Redeemer, hail!
For thou hast died for me;
Thy praise shall never, never fail
Throughout eternity.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Seek ye first the kingdom,
‘Tis your Father’s will
So the voice of Jesus bids us follow still.
Savior, we would hear Thee,
Follow, find, and see;
And in life’s adventure
Thy disciples be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
As for hidden treasure,
Or for matchless pearl,
When at last discovered, some will sell their all:
So, when breaks the vision of that kingdom fair,
Ours shall be its riches
And its beauty rare.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
As the silent leaven works its secret way,
Or as grows the seed grain through the night and day;
Lord, so be the increase, peaceable but sure,
Of
Thy word within us,
And
Thy kingdom’s power

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
As the tender seedling grows up tall and strong,
And the birds of heaven to its branches throng;
So shall all God’s children, from the east and west,
Gather to His kingdom, In its shadow rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God is working His purpose out
As year succeeds to year;
God is working his purpose out,
And the time is drawing near;
Nearer and nearer draws the time,
The time that shall surely be,
When the earth shall be filled
With the glory of God
As the waters cover the sea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
From utmost east to utmost west,
Where'er man's foot hath trod,
By the mouth of many messengers
Goes forth the voice of God:
Give ear to Me, ye continents,
Ye isles, give ear to Me,”
That the earth may be filled
With the glory of God
As the waters cover the sea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
March we forth in the strength of God,
With the banner of Christ unfurled,
That the light of the glorious gospel of truth
May shine throughout the world;
Fight we the fight with sorrow and sin
To set their captives free,
That the earth may be filled
With the glory of God
As the waters cover the sea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
All we can do is nothing worth
Unless
God blesses the deed;
Vainly we hope for the harvest-tide
Till
God gives life to the seed;
Yet near and nearer draws the time,
The time that shall surely be,
When the earth shall be filled
With the glory of God
As the waters cover the sea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord is just, a helper tried
Mercy is ever at His side;
His kingly crown is holiness,
His scepter, pity in distress.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O blest the land, the city blest,
Where
Christ the Ruler is confessed!
O happy hearts and happy homes
To whom this King in triumph comes!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Fling wide the portals of your heart;
Make it a temple, set apart
From earthly use for happy homes,
To whom this King in triumph comes!

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Redeemer, come, I open wide
My hearts to Thee here, Lord abide.
Let us Thy inner presence feel;
Thy grace and love in me reveal.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus shall reign wherever the sun
Does its successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
Till moons shall wax and wane no more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song;
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their early blessings on His Name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Let every creature rise and bring
Honors peculiar to our King;
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth repeat the loud amen!

title: A Hymn of Glory Let Us Sing

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
A hymn of glory let us sing;
New hymns thro'out the world shall ring
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Christ, by a road before untrod,
Ascends unto the throne of God.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord, our homeward pathway bend,
That our unwearied hearts ascend.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Where, seated on Your Father's throne,
You reign as King of kings alone.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Give us Your joy on earth, O Lord,
In heav'n to be our great reward.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
When throned with You forever, we
Shall praise Your name eternally.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O risen Christ, ascended Lord,
All praise to you let earth accord:
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
You are, while endless ages run,
With
Father and with Spirit one.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

title: All Hail the Power ofJesus' Name

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
All hail the power of Jesus' name!
Let angels prostrate fall;
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him Lord of all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Ye seed of Israel's chosen race,
Ye ransomed of the fall,
Hail
Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Hail
Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Let every kindred, every tribe
On this terrestrial ball
To
Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all.
To
Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall!
Join in the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Join in the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
All glory, laud, and honor,
To thee, Redeemer, King,
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet hosannas ring.
Thou art the King of Israel,
Thou
David's royal Son,
Who in the Lord's name comest,
The
King and Blessed One.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The company of angels
Are praising thee on high,
And we with all creation
In chorus make reply.
The people of the Hebrews
With psalms before thee went;
Our prayer and praise and anthems
Before thee we present.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
To thee, before thy passion,
They sang their hymns of praise;
To thee, now high exalted,
Our melody we raise.
Thou didst accept their praises;
Accept the prayers we bring,
Who in all good delightest,
Thou good and gracious King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Blest be the King whose coming
Is in the name of God!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Him let doors be opened,
No hearts against Him barred!
Not robbed in royal splendor,
In power and pomp comes He;
But clad as are the poorest,
Such
His humility.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
By those who truly listen
His voice is truly heard;
Pity the proud and haughty,
Who have not learned to heed
The
Christ who is the promise,
Who has atonement made.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
He only to the humble
Reveals the face of God.
All power is His, all glory!
All things are in His hand,
All ages and all peoples,
Till time itself shall end.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He offers to the burdened
The rest and grace they need,
Gentle is He and humble!
And light His yoke shall be,
For
He would have us bear it,
So
He can make us free!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
At the Name of Jesus,
Every knee shall bow,
Every tongue confess Him
King of glory now;
’Tis the Father’s pleasure
We should call Him Lord,
Who from the beginning
Was the mighty Word.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
His voice creation
Sprang at once to sight,
All the angel faces,
All the hosts of light,
Thrones and dominations,
Stars upon their way,
All the heavenly orders,
In their great array.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Humbled for a season,
To receive a name
From the lips of sinners
Unto whom He came,
He is God the Savior,
He is Christ the Lord,
Ever to be worshipped,
Trusted and adored.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Surely, this Lord Jesus
Shall return again,
With
His Father’s glory
With
His angel train;
For all wreaths of empire
Meet upon His brow,
And our hearts confess Him
King of glory now

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ is the world’s Light,
He and none other; born in our darkness,
He became our brother.
If we have seen Him, we have seen the Father:
Glory to God on high!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Christ is the world’s Peace
He and none other; no one can serve Him
And despise another
Who else unites us one in God the Father?
Glory to God on high!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Christ is the world’s Life,
He and none other; sold once for silver, murdered here, our brother,
He who redeems us reigns with God the Father.
Glory to God on high!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
God the glory,
God and none other; give God the glory,
Spirit,
Son, and Father;
Give
God the glory, God in Man my brother;
Glory to God on high!

title: Christ Is Made the Sure Foundation

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ is made the sure foundation,
Christ our head and corner stone,
Chosen of the Lord and precious,
Binding all the Church in one;
Holy
Zion’s help forever,
And our confidence alone.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
To this temple, where we call You,
Come,
O Lord of hosts, and stay!
Come with all Your lovingkindness
Hear
Your people as they pray.
And
Your fullest benediction
Shed within these walls today.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Praise and honor to the Father,
Praise and honor to the Son,
Praise and honor to the Spirit,
Ever
Three and ever one;
One in might and one in glory
While unending ages run.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I love Thee, I love Thee,
I love Thee, my Lord;
I love Thee, my Savior,
I love Thee, my God.
I love Thee, I love Thee,
And that Thou dost know;
But how much I love Thee
My actions will show.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I'm happy, I'm happy,
O, wondrous account!
My joys are immortal,
I stand on the mount!
I gaze on my treasure and long to be there,
With
Jesus and angels, and kindred so dear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jesus, my Savior, with Thee I am blest,
My life and salvation,my joy and my rest:
Thy name be my theme, and Thy love be my song;
Thy grace shall inspire both my heart and my tongue.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O, who's like my Savior?
He's
Salem's bright King;
He smiles, and He loves me, and helps me to sing.
I'll praise Him, I'll praise Him, with notes loud and clear,
While rivers of pleasure my spirit do cheer.

title: In the Cross of Christ I Glory

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
In the cross of Christ I glory,
Towering o'er the wrecks of time;
All the light of sacred story
Gathers round its head sublime.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
When the woes of life o'ertake me,
Hopes deceive, and fears annoy,
Never shall the cross forsake me.
Lo! it glows with peace and joy.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
When the sun of bliss is beaming
Light and love upon my way,
From the cross the radiance streaming
Adds more luster to the day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Bane and blessing, pain and pleasure,
By the cross are sanctified;
Peace is there that knows no measure,
Joys that through all time abide.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
How sweet the Name of Jesus sounds
In a believer’s ear!
It soothes his sorrows, heals his wounds,
And drives away his fear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
It makes the wounded spirit whole,
And calms the troubled breast;
’Tis manna to the hungry soul,
And to the weary, rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Name, the Rock on which I build,
My
Shield and Hiding Place,
My never failing treasury, filled
With boundless stores of grace!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Jesus! my Shepherd, Husband, Friend,
My
Prophet, Priest and King,
My
Lord, my life, my way, my end,
Accept the praise I bring.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Weak is the effort of my heart,
And cold my warmest thought;
But when I see Thee as Thou art,
I’ll praise Thee as I ought.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus, priceless treasure,
Source of purest pleasure,
Truest friend to me:
Ah! how long I've panted,
And my heart has fainted,
Thirsting
Lord, for Thee.
Thine
I am, O spotless Lamb,
I will suffer naught to hide Thee,
Nought
I ask beside thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Hence, all thoughts of sadness!
For the Lord of gladness,
Jesus, enters in.
Those who love the Father,
Tho' the storms may gather,
Still have peace within;
Yea, whate'er I here must bear,
Still in Thee lies purest pleasure,
Jesus, priceless treasure!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Fairest Lord Jesus,
Ruler of all nature,
O thou of God and man the Son!
Thee will I cherish,
Thee will I honor,
Thou art my glory, joy, and crown.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Fair are the meadows,
Fairer still the woodlands,
Robed in the blooming garb of spring:
Jesus is fairer,
Jesus is purer
Who makes the woeful heart to sing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Fair is the sunshine,
Fairer still the moonlight,
And all the twinkling starry host:
Jesus shines brighter,
Jesus shines purer
Than all the angels heaven can boast.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Savior!
Lord of the nations,
Son of God and Son of Man!
Glory and honor,
Praise, adoration,
Now and forevermore be Thine!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus, the very thought of thee
With sweetness fills my breast;
But sweeter far Thy face to see,
And in thy presence rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
No voice can sing, no heart can frame,
Nor can the memory find
A sweeter sound than Jesus' name,
The
Savior of mankind.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O hope of every contrite heart!
O joy of all the meek,
To those who fall, how kind thou art!
How good to those who seek!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
But what to those who find? Ah, this
Nor tongue nor pen can show;
The love of Jesus, what it is,
None but his loved ones know.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Jesus, our only joy be Thou,
As thou our prize wilt be;
In
Thee be all glory now,
And through eternity.

title: Jesus, Thou Joy of Loving Hearts

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus, Thou Joy of loving hearts,
Thou fount of life, Thou light of men,
From the best bliss that earth imparts,
We turn unfilled to Thee again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We taste Thee, O Thou living Bread,
And long to feast upon Thee still;
We drink of Thee, the Fountain head,
And thirst our souls from Thee to fill.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Our restless spirits yearn for Thee,
Wherever our changeful lot is cast;
Glad when Thy gracious smile we see,
Blessed when our faith can hold Thee fast.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Jesus, ever with us stay,
Make all our moments calm and bright;
Chase the dark night of sin away,
Shed over the world Thy holy light.

title: King of Glory, King of Peace

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
King of glory, King of peace,
I will love Thee;
And that love may never cease
I will move Thee.
Thou hast granted my request,
Thou hast heard me;
Thou didst note my working breast,
Thou hast spared me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Wherefore with my utmost art
I will sing Thee,
And the cream of all my heart
I will bring Thee.
Though my sins against me cried,
Thou didst clear me;
And alone when they replied,
Thou didst hear me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Seven whole days, not one in seven,
I will praise Thee;
In my heart, though not in heav’n,
I can raise Thee.
Small it is, in this poor sort
To enroll Thee:
Ev’n eternity's too short
To extol me.

title: My Song Shall Be of Jesus

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
My song shall be of Jesus,
While pressing on my way
To where my home shines glorious
In pure and perfect day.
And when my soul shall enter
The many mansions fair,
A song of praise to Jesus
I’ll sing forever there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
More about Jesus I would know,
More of His grace to others show;
More of His saving fullness see,
More of His love who died for me.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
More, more about Jesus,
More, more about Jesus;
More of His saving fullness see,
More of His love who died for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
More about Jesus let me learn,
More of His holy will discern;
Spirit of God, my teacher be,
Showing the things of Christ to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
More about Jesus; in His Word,
Holding communion with my Lord;
Hearing
His voice in every line,
Making each faithful saying mine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4

title: Worthy, Worthy Is the LambGlory, hallelujah!Praise Him, hallelujah!Glory, hallelujah!To the Lamb!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Worthy, worthy is the Lamb,
Worthy, worthy is the Lamb,
Worthy, worthy is the Lamb,
That was slain.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Glory, hallelujah!
Praise Him, hallelujah!
Glory, hallelujah!
To the Lamb!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Savior, let Thy kingdom come!
Now the power of sin consume;
Bring
Thy blest millennium,
Holy
Lamb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thus may we each moment feel,
Love
Him, serve Him, praise Him still,
Till we all on Zion's hill
See the Lamb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, my Way, my Truth, my Life:
Such a Way as gives us breath;
Such a Truth as ends all strife,
Such a Life as killeth death.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Come, my Light, my Feast, my Strength:
Such a Light as shows a feast,
Such a Feast as mends in length,
Such a Strength as makes his guest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Come, my Joy, my Love, my Heart:
Such a Joy as none can move,
Such a Love as none can part,
Such a Heart as joys in love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There is a Name I love to hear,
I love to sing its worth;
It sounds like music in my ear,
The sweetest name on earth.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O how I love Jesus,
O how I love Jesus,
O how I love Jesus,
Because
He first loved me!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
It tells me of a Savior’s love,
Who died to set me free;
It tells me of His precious blood,
The sinner’s perfect plea.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
It tells of one whose loving heart
Can feel my deepest woe;
Who in each sorrow bears
A part that none can bear below.

title: Praise Him! Praise Him!Praise Him! Praise Him!  Tell of His excellent greatness.Praise Him! Praise Him!  Ever in joyful song!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Praise Him! praise Him!
Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
Sing,
O earth, His wonderful love proclaim!
Hail
Him! hail Him! highest archangels in glory;
Strength and honor give to His holy Name!
Like a shepherd, Jesus will guard
His children,
In
His arms He carries them all day long;

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Tell of His excellent greatness.
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Ever in joyful song!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Him! Praise Him!
Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
For our sins He suffered, and bled, and died.
He our Rock, our hope of eternal salvation,
Hail
Him! hail Him! Jesus the Crucified.
Sound
His praises! Jesus who bore our sorrows,
Love unbounded, wonderful, deep and strong.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Him! Praise Him!
Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
Heavenly portals loud with hosannas ring!
Jesus,
Savior, reigneth forever and ever.
Crown
Him! Crown Him!
Prophet, and Priest, and King!
Christ is coming! over the world victorious,
Power and glory unto the Lord belong.

title: O for a Thousand Tonguesto Sing

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O for a thousand tongues to sing
My great Redeemer's praise,
The glories of my God and King,
The triumphs of His grace!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
My gracious Master and my God,
Assist me to proclaim,
To spread through all the earth abroad
The honors of thy name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jesus! the name that charms our fears,
That bids our sorrows cease;
'Tis music in the sinner's ears,
'Tis life, and health, and peace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
He speaks, and listening to his voice,
New life the dead receive;
The mournful, broken hearts rejoice,
The humble poor believe.

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
Hear him, ye deaf; His praise, ye dumb,
Your loosened tongues employ;
Ye blind, behold your Savior come,
And leap, ye lame, for joy.

title: He LivesHe lives, He lives,Christ Jesus lives today!He walks with me and talks with me  Along life's narrow way.He lives, He lives, salvation to impart!You ask me how I know He lives?He lives within my heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
He lives, He lives,
Christ Jesus lives today!
He walks with me and talks with me
Along life's narrow way.
He lives, He lives, salvation to impart!
You ask me how I know He lives?
He lives within my heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
In all the world around me I see His loving care,
And tho' my heart grows weary I never will despair;
I know that He is leading thru all the stormy blast,
The day of His appearing will come at last.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, O Christian, lift up your voice and sing,
Eternal hallelujahs to Jesus Christ the King!
The hope of all who seek Him, the help of all who find,
None other is so loving, so good and kind.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, let us sing the song of songs–
The angels first began the strain–
The homage which to Christ belongs:
“Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!"

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Slain to redeem us by His blood,
To cleanse from every sinful stain,
And make us kings and priest to God:
“Worthy the Lamb, for he was slain!"

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Him who suffered on the tree,
Our souls, at His soul’s price, to gain,
Blessing and praise, and glory be:
“Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!"

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Him, enthroned by filial right
All power in heaven and earth proclaim,
Honor and majesty, and might:
“Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!"

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Long as we live, and when we die,
And while in heaven with Him we reign,
This song our song of songs shall be:
“Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!"

title: There’s No Other NameLike JesusSweet name, dear name,There’s no other name like Jesus;Sweet name, dear name,There’s no other name like Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There’s no other name like Jesus,
‘Tis the dearest name we know,
‘Tis the angel’s joy in heaven,
‘Tis the Christian’s joy below.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Sweet name, dear name,
There’s no other name like Jesus;
Sweet name, dear name,
There’s no other name like Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There’s no other name like Jesus
When the heart with grief is sad,
There’s no other name like Jesus
When the heart is free and glad.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
‘Tis the hope that I shall see Him
When in glory He appears,
‘Tis the hope to hear His welcome
That my fainting spirit cheers.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He wills that I should labor
In
His vineyard day by day,
Then
‘tis well if only Jesus
Blesses all I do or say.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
He wills that death’s cold finger
Touch my feeble, mortal clay,
Then
‘tis well if only Jesus
Is my dying trust and stay.

title: The Great Physician NowIs NearSweetest note in seraph song,Sweetest name on mortal tongue;Sweetest carol ever sung,Jesus, blessed Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The Great Physician now is near,
The sympathizing Jesus;
He speaks the drooping heart to cheer,
O hear the voice of Jesus!

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Sweetest note in seraph song,
Sweetest name on mortal tongue;
Sweetest carol ever sung,
Jesus, blessed Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
All glory to the dying Lamb!
I now believe in Jesus;
I love the blessed Savior's name,
I love the name of Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
His name dispels my guilt and fear,
No other name but Jesus;
Oh! how my soul delights to hear
The precious name of Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And when He comes to bring the crown---
The crown of life and glory
Then by His side we will sit down,
And tell redemption's story.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I cannot tell why He Whom angels worship,
Should set His love upon the souls of men,
Or why, as Shepherd He should seek the wanderers,
To bring them back, they know not how or when.
But this I know, that He was born of Mary
When
Bethlehem’s manger was His only home,
And that He lived at Nazareth and labored,
And so the Savior,
Savior of the world is come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I cannot tell how silently He suffered,
As with His peace He graced this place of tears,
Nor how His heart upon the cross was broken,
The crown of pain to three and thirty years.
But this I know, He heals the brokenhearted,
And stays our sin, and calms our lurking fear,
And lifts the burden from the heavy laden,
For still the Savior,
Savior of the world is here.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I cannot tell how He will win the nations,
How
He will claim His earthly heritage,
How satisfy the needs and aspirations
Of east and west, of sinner and of sage.
But this I know, all flesh shall see
His glory,
And
He shall reap the harvest He has sown,
And some glad day His sun will shine in splendor
When
He the Savior,
Savior of the world is known.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
I cannot tell how all the lands shall worship,
When, at His bidding, every storm is stilled,
Or who can say how great the jubilation
When all our hearts with love for Him are filled.
But this I know, the skies shall sound His praises,
Ten thousand thousand human voices sing,
And earth to heaven, and heaven to earth will answer:
At last the Savior,
Savior of the world is King!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Ye servants of God, your Master proclaim,
And publish abroad His wonderful name;
The name all victorious of Jesus extol,
His kingdom is glorious,
He rules over all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God ruleth on high, almighty to save,
And still he is nigh, His presence we have;
The great congregation His triumph shall sing,
Ascribing salvation to Jesus, our King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
"Salvation to God, Who sits on the throne!"
Let all cry aloud and honor the Son;
The praises of Jesus the angels proclaim,
Fall down on their faces and worship the
Lamb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Then let us adore and give Him
His right,
All glory and power, all wisdom and might;
All honor and blessing with angels above,
And thanks never ceasing for infinite love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come down, O Love divine,
Seek
Thou this soul of mine,
And visit it with Thine own ardor glowing;
O
Comforter, draw near,
Within my heart appear,
And kindle it, Thy holy flame bestowing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O let it freely burn,
Till earthly passions turn
To dust and ashes in its heat consuming;
And let thy glorious light
Shine ever on my sight,
And clothe me round, the while my path illuming.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Mine outward vesture be,
And lowliness become my inner clothing;
True lowliness of heart
Which takes the humbler part,
And o'er its own shortcomings weeps with loathing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And so the yearning strong,
With which the soul will long,
Shall far outpass the power of human telling;
For none can guess its grace,
Till he become the place
Where in the Holy Spirit makes His dwelling.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
With power from on high,
With love, O refresh us!
Dear
Savior, draw nigh.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
We humbly beseesch Thee, Lord Jesus, we pray,
With love and the Spririt baptize us today.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Unworthy we cry, unholy, unclean,
O wash us and cleanse us
From sin’s guilty stain.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O heavenly Dove,
Descend from on high!
We pleas Thy rich blessing;
In mercy draw nigh.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O list the glad voice!
From heaven it came
Thou art My beloved,
Well pleased I am
Refrain  (last vs.)
We praise Thee, we bless Thee, dear lamb that was slain,
We laud and adore Thee,
Amen and Amen.

title: Draw us in the Spirit’s Tether

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Draw us in the Spirit’s tether,
For when humbly in Thy name,
Two or three are met together,
Thou art in the midst of them;
Alleluia!
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Touch we now Thy garment’s hem.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
As the brethren used to gather
In the name of Christ to sup,
Then with thanks to God the Father
Break the bread and bless the cup,
Alleluia!
Alleluia! Alleluia!
So knit Thou our friendship up.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
All our meals and all our living,
Make as sacraments of Thee,
That by caring helping, giving,
We may true disciples be.
Alleluia!
Alleluia! Alleluia!
We will serve Thee faithfully.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Hover o’er me, Holy Spirit,
Bathe my trembling heart and brow;
Fill me with Thy hallowed presence,
Come,
O come and fill me now.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Fill me now, fill me now,
Jesus, come and fill me now;
Fill me with Thy hallowed presence,
Come,
O come, and fill me now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thou canst fill me, gracious Spirit,
Though
I cannot tell Thee how;
But
I need Thee, greatly need Thee,
Come,
O come and fill me now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I am weakness, full of weakness,
At
Thy sacred feet I bow;
Blest, divine, eternal Spirit,
Fill with power and fill me now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Cleanse and comfort, bless and save me,
Bathe,
O bathe my heart and brow;
Thou art comforting and saving,
Thou at sweetly filling now.

title: The Spirit of the Lord Revealed

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The Sprit of the Lord revealed
His will to saints of old;
Their heart and mind and lips unsealed
His glory to unfold.
Amid the gloom of ancient night
They hailed the dawning Word,
And in the coming of the light
Proclaimed the coming Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The prophets passed; at length there came
To sojourn and abide,
The
Word incarnate, to whose name
The prophets testified;
And
He, the twilight over past,
Himself, the Light of light,
As man with man, revealed at last
The
Father to our sight.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Spirit, who dost speak
To mind and conscience still,
That we in this our day, may seek
To do our Father’s will,
To us the word of life impart,
Of
Christ, the living way;
Give us the quiet, humble heart
To hear and to obey.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Holy Spirit,
Sweet
Heavenly Dove
Stay right here with us
Filling with Your love,
And for these blessings
We lift our hearts in praise,
Without a doubt we’ll know
That we have been revived
When we shall leave this place.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There are sweet expression on each face,
And
I know they feel the presence of the
Lord

title: Fire of God, Thou Sacred Flame

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Fire of God, Thou sacred flames,
Spirit who in splendor came,
Let
Thy heat my soul refine
Till it glows with love divine

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Breath of God, that swept in power
In the Pentecostal hour,
Holy
Breath, be Thou in me
Source of vital energy.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Strength of God, Thy might within
Conquers sorrow, pain, and sin:
Fortify from evil’s art
All the gateways of my heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Truth of God, Thy piercing rays
Penetrate my secret ways.
May the light, that shames my sin
Guide me holier paths to win.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Love of God, Thy grace profound
Knoweth neither age nor bound:
Come, my heart’s own guest to be,
Dwell forever more in me.

title: O for That Flame of Living Fire

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O for that flame of living fire
Which shone so bright in saints of old:
Which bade their souls to heaven aspire
Calm in distress in danger bold!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Where is that spirit, Lord which dwelt
In
Abraham’s breast, and sealed him Thine?
Which made Paul’s heart with sorrow melt,
And glow with energy divine?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
That spirit which from age to age
Proclaim
Thy love, and taught Thy ways?
Brightened
Isaiah’s vivid page,
And breathed in David’s hallowed lays?

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Is not Thy grace as mighty now
As when Elijah felt its power?
When glory beamed from Moses’ brow,
Or
Job endured the trying hour?

stanzas.label: Stanza 5

title: Breathe on Me, Breath of God

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Breathe on me,
Breath of God,
Fill me with life anew,
That
I may love what Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Breathe on me,
Breath of God,
Until my heart is pure,
Until with Thee I will one will,
To do and to endure.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Breathe on me,
Breath of God,
Till
I am wholly Thine,
Until this earthly part of me
Glows with Thy fire divine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Breathe on me,
Breath of God,
So shall I constant be,
And live with Thee the perfect life
Of
Thine eternity.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I ask no dream, no prophet ecstasies,
No sudden rending of the veil of clay,
No angel visitant, no open'ng skies;
But take the dimness of my soul away.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thou not bid us love Thee,
God and King?
All, all Thine own, soul, heart and strength and mind.
I see Thy cross; there teach my heart to cling:
O let me seek Thee, and O let me find!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Teach me to feel that Thou art always nigh;
Teach me the struggles of the soul to bear.
To check the rising doubt, the rebel sigh,
Teach me the patience of unanswered prayer.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Teach me to love Thee as Thine angels love,
One holy passion filling all my frame;
The baptism of the heav'n descended dove,
My heart an altar, and Thy love the flame.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Come as the light; to us reveal
Our emptiness and woe,
And lead us in those paths of light,
Whereon the righteous go.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Come as the fire and purge our hearts
Like sacrificial flame,
Let our whole soul an off’ring be
To our Redeemer’s name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Come as the dove and spread Thy wings,
The wings of peaceful love;
And let Thy church on earth become
Blest as the church above.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Spirit divine, attend our prayers,
Make a lost world Thy home;
Descend with all Thy gracious power,
O come, great Spirit, come!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Holy Spirit, light divine,
Shine upon this heart of mine,
Chase the shades of night away,
Turn my darkness into day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Spirit, power divine,
Cleanse this guilty heart of mine;
Long has sin, without control,
Held dominion o'er my soul.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Ghost, with joy divine,
Cheer this saddened heart of mine,
Bid my many woes depart,
Heal my wounded, bleeding heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Spirit, all divine,
Dwell within this heart of mine,
Cast down every idol throne,
Reign supreme, and reign alone.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove,
With all Thy quickening powers;
Kindle a flame of sacred love
In these cold hearts of ours.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O raise our thoughts from things below,
From vanities and toys;
Then shall we with fresh courage go
To reach eternal joys.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Father, we would no longer live
At this poor dying rate;
To
Thee our thankful love we give,
For
Thine to us is great!

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Come,
Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove,
With all Thy quickening powers;
Come, shed abroad the Savior’s love
And that shall kindle ours.

title: O Holy Dove of God Descending

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O holy Dove of God descending,
You are the love that knows no ending.
All of our shattered dreams You're mending:
Spirit, now live in me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O holy Wind of God now blowing,
You are the seed that God is sowing.
You are the life that starts us growing:
Spirit, now live in me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O holy Rain of God now falling,
You make the Word of God enthralling,
You are that inner voice now calling:
Spirit, now live in me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O holy Flame of God now burning,
You are the power of Christ returning.
You are the answer to our yearning:
Spirit, now live in me.

title: Break Thou the Bread of Life

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Break Thou the bread of life,
Dear
Lord, to me,
As thou didst break the loaves
Beside the sea;
Beyond the sacred page
I seek Thee, Lord;
My spirit pants for Thee,
O
Living Word!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thou the truth, dear Lord,
To me, to me,
As
Thou didst bless the bread
By
Galilee;
Then shall all bondage cease,
All fetters fall;
And
I shall find my peace,
My all in all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thou art the bread of life,
O
Lord, to me;
Thy holy Word the truth
That saveth me;
Give me to eat and live
With
Thee above;
Teach me to love Thy truth,
For
Thou art love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Spirit and life are they,
Words
Thou dost speak;
I hasten to obey,
But
I am weak;
Thou art my only help,
Thou art my life;
Heeding
Thy holy Word
I win the strife.

title: Give Me the BibleGive me the Bible, holy message shining,Thy light shall guide me in the narrow way.Precept and promise, law and love combining,'Til night shall vanish in eternal day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Give me the Bible, star of gladness gleaming,
To cheer the wanderer lone and tempest tossed,
No storm can hide that peaceful radiance beaming
Since
Jesus came to seek and save the lost.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Give me the Bible, holy message shining,
Thy light shall guide me in the narrow way.
Precept and promise, law and love combining,
'Til night shall vanish in eternal day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Give me the Bible when my heart is broken,
When sin and grief have filled my soul with fear,
Give me the precious words by Jesus spoken,
Hold up faith's lamp to show my Savior near.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Give me the Bible, all my steps enlighten,
Teach me the danger of these realms below,
That lamp of safety, o'er the gloom shall brighten,
That light alone the path of peace can show.

title: Lord, I have Made Thy Word My Choice

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord, I have made Thy Word my choice
My lasting heritage;
There shall my no blest pow’rs rejoice,
My warmest thoughts engage.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I’ll read the histories of Thy love,
And keep Thy laws in sight;
While through Thy promise I rove,
With ever fresh delight.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
In this broad land of wealth unknown,
Where springs of life arise,
Seeds of immortal bliss are sown,
And hidden glory lies.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
The best relief that mourners have,
It makes our sorrows blest
Our fairest hope beyond the grave,
And our eternal rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Word of God Incarnate,
O
Wisdom from on high,
O
Truth unchanged, unchanging,
O
Light of our dark sky:
We praise Thee for the radiance
That from the hallowed page,
A lantern to our footsteps,
Shines on from age to age.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The church from her dear Master
Received the gift divine,
And still that light she lifteth
O'er all the earth to shine.
It is the golden casket
Where gems of truth are stored;
It is the heaven-drawn picture
Of
Christ, the living Word.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
It floateth like a banner
Before
God's host unfurled;
It shineth like a beacon
Above the darkling world.
It is the chart and compass
That o'er life's surging sea,
'Mid mists and rocks and quicksands,
Still guides, O Christ, to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O make Thy church, dear Savior,
A lamp of purest gold,
To bear before the nations
Thy true light as of old.
O teach Thy wandering pilgrims
By this their path to trace,
Till, clouds and darkness ended,
They see Thee face to face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O God of light, Your Word, a lamp unfailing,
Shall pierce the darkness of our earth bound way
And show your grace, Your plan for us unveiling,
And guide our footsteps to the perfect day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
From days of old, through blind and willful ages,
Though we rebelled, You gently sought again,
And spoke through saints, apostles, prophets, sages,
Who wrote with eager or reluctant pen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Undimmed by time, those words are still revealing
To sinful hearts Your justice and Your grace;
And questing mortals longing for Your healing,
See
Your compassion in the Savior’s face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
To all the world Your summons You are sending,
Through all the earth, to every land and race,
That myriad tongues, in one great anthem blending
May praise and celebrate Your gift of grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Thanks to God whose Word was spoken
In the dead that made the earth.
His the voice that called a nation;
His the fires that tried her worth.
God has spoken;
Praise
Him for His open Word.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thanks to God whose Word incarnate
Glorified the flesh of man.
Deeds and words and death and rising
Tell the grace in heaven’s plan.
God has spoken;
Praise
Him for His open Word.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thanks to God whose Word is answered
By the Spirit’s voice within.
Here we drink of joy unmeasured,
Life redeemed from death and sin.
God is speaking;
Praise
Him for His open Word.

title: For Your Holy BookWe Thank You

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
For Your holy book we thank You,
And for all who served You well,
Writing, guarding, and translating
That its pages might forth tell
Your strong love and tender care
For
Your people everywhere.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Your holy book we thank You,
And for those who work today,
That the people of all nations,
Reading it and foll’wing, may
Know
Your love and tender care
For
Your people everywhere.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Your holy book we thank You,
May its message be our guide,
May we understand the wisdom
Of the laws it will provide:
And
Your love and tender care
For
Your people everywhere.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Your holy book we thank You,
May its message in our hearts
Lead us now to see in Jesus
All the grace Your word imparts:
All
Your love and tender care
For
Your people everywhere.

title: Lord Jesus, Once you Spoketo Men

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord Jesus, once You spoke to men
Upon the mountain and the plain,
O help us listen now as then
And wonder at Your words again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
We all have secret fears to face,
Our minds and motives to amend.
We seek Your truth, we need Your grace,
Our living Lord and present friend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The gospel speaks, and we received
Your light, Your love, Your own command.
O help us live what we believe,
In daily word of heart and hand.

title: Only Trust HimOnly trust Him, only trust Him,Only trust Him now;He will save you, He will sve you,He will save you now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, every soul by sin oppressed,
There’s mercy with the Lord,
And
He will surely give you rest,
By trusting in His word.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Only trust Him, only trust Him,
Only trust Him now;
He will save you, He will sve you,
He will save you now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Jesus shed His precious blood
Rich blessings to bestow;
Plunge now into the crimson flood
That washes white as snow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Yes,
Jesus is the truth, the way,
That leads you into rest;
Believe in Him without delay
And you are fully blest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Come, then, and join this holy band,
And on to glory go,
To dwell in that celestial land,
Where joys immortal flow.

title: Come, Ye SinnersI will arise and go to Jesus,He will embrace me in His arms;In the arms of my dear Savior,O there are ten thousand charms.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, ye sinners poor and needy,
Weak and wounded, sick and sore;
Jesus ready stands to save you,
Full of pity, love, and power.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I will arise and go to Jesus,
He will embrace me in His arms;
In the arms of my dear Savior,
O there are ten thousand charms.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Come, ye thirsty, come, and welcome,
God's free bounty glorify;
True belief and true repentance,
Every grace that brings you nigh.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Let not conscience make you linger,
Nor of fitness fondly dream;
All the fitness He requireth
Is to feel your need of Him.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lo! th'incarnate God, ascended,
Pleads the merit of His blood;
Venture on Him, venture wholly,
Let no other trust intrude.

title: I Gave My Life for Thee

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I gave My life for thee,
My precious blood I shed,
That thou might'st ransom be,
And quickened from the dead;
I gave, I gave My life for thee,
What hast thou given for Me?
I gave, I gave My life for thee,
What hast thou given for Me?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Fathers house of light,
My glory circled throne,
I left for earthly night,
For wanderings sad and lone;
I left, I left it all for thee,
Hast thou left aught for Me?
I left, I left it all for thee,
Hast thou left aught for Me?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I suffered much for thee,
More than thy tongue can tell,
Of bitterest agony,
To rescue thee from hell;
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee,
What hast thou borne for Me?
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee,
What hast thou borne for Me?

title: I Hear Thy Welcome VoiceI am coming Lord!Coming now to Thee!Wash me, cleanse me in the bloodThat flowed on Calvary!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I hear Thy welcome voice
That calls me, Lord, to Thee,
For cleansing in Thy precious blood
That flowed on Calvary.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I am coming Lord!
Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me in the blood
That flowed on Calvary!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Though coming weak and vile,
Thou dost my strength assure;
Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse,
Till spotless all, and pure.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
’Tis
Jesus calls me on
To perfect faith and love,
To perfect hope and peace and trust,
For earth and heaven above.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
All hail! atoning blood!
All hail! redeeming grace!
All hail! the gift of Christ our Lord,
Our
Strength and Righteousness.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Jesus, Thou art standing,
Outside the fast closed door,
In lowly patience waiting
To pass the threshold o’er:
O shame, professing Christian,
His
Name and sign who bear,
O shame, thrice shame upon us,
To keep Him standing there!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Jesus, Thou art knocking;
And lo, that hand is scarred,
And thorns Thy brow encircle,
And tears Thy face have marred:
O love that passeth knowledge,
So patiently to wait!
O sin that hath no equal,
So fast to bar the gate!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jesus, Thou art pleading
In accents meek and low,
“I died for you, My children,
And will ye treat Me so?”
O
Lord, with shame and sorrow
We open now the door;
Dear
Savior, enter, enter,
And leave us nevermore.

title: For You I Am PrayingFor you I am praying,For you I am praying,For you I am praying,I'm praying for you.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I have a Savior, He's pleading in glory,
A dear, loving Savior, though earth friends be few;
And now He is watching in tenderness o'er me,
But oh that my Savior were your Savior, too.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
I'm praying for you.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I have a Father; to me He has given
A hope for eternity, blessed and true;
And soon He will call to meet Him in heaven,
But oh that He'd let me bring you with me, too!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I have a robe; 'tis resplendent in whiteness,
Awaiting in glory my wondering view;
Oh, when I receive it, all shining in brightness,
Dear friend, could I see you receiving one, too!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Jesus has found you, tell others the story,
That my loving Savior is your Savior, too;
Then pray that your Savior will bring them to glory,
And prayer will be answered 'twas answered for you!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus calls us o'er the tumult
Of our life's wild, restless sea;
Day by day his sweet voice soundeth,
Saying,
"Christian, follow me!"

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Jesus calls us from the worship
Of the vain world's golden store,
From each idol that would keep us,
Saying,
"Christian, love me more!"

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still he calls, in cares and pleasures,
"Christian, love Me more than these!"

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Jesus calls us! By thy mercies,
Savior, may we hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thy obedience,
Serve and love Thee best of all.

title: Wonderful Words of LifeBeautiful words, wonderful words,Wonderful words of life.Beautiful words, wonderful words,Wonderful words of life.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life.
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3

title: Softly and TenderlyCome home, come home;Ye who are weary come home;Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,Calling, O sinner, come home!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling for you and for me;
At the heart's portals He's waiting and watching,
Watching for you and for me.

stanzas.label: Chorus
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Why should we tary when Jesus is pleading,
Pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not his mercies,
Mercies for you and for me?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Think of the wonderful love He has promised,
Promised for you and for me;
Though we have sinned, He has mercy and pardon,
Pardon for you and for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I am going to Calvary.
Would you like to come with Me
All the way and back again?
You must follow the Leader then.
You must follow the Leader,
You must follow the Leader,
All the way and back again,
You must follow the Leader.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I wear a thorny crown,
If the soldiers knock me down
Can
I really be a king?
Love will answer everything
If you follow the Leader,
If you follow the Leader,
Love will answer everything
If you follow the Leader.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I go along the road,
I shall lift a heavy load
I will carry a cross for you.
You will learn to carry it too
When you follow the Leader,
When you follow the Leader,
You will learn to carry it too
If you follow the Leader.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
I am going to stretch My hands,
Reaching to all the lands.
Can
I really be a king?
Love’s the lord of everything,
When you follow the Leader,
When you follow the Leader,
Love’s the lord of everything
When you follow the Leader.

title: The Savior Is WaitingTime after time He has waited before,And now He is waiting againTo see if you’re willing to open the door:O how He wants to come in.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The Savior is waiting to enter your heart,
Why don’t you let Him come in?
There’s nothing in this world to keep you apart,
What is your answer to Him?

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Time after time He has waited before,
And now He is waiting again
To see if you’re willing to open the door:
O how He wants to come in.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
If you’ll take one step towards the Savior, my friend,
You’ll find His arms open wide;
Receive
Him, and all of your darkness will end,
Within your heart He’ll abide.

title: Turn Your Eyes Upon JesusTurn your eyes upon Jesus,Look full in His wonderful face,And the things of earth will grow strangely dim,In the light of His glory and grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O soul, are you weary and troubled?
No light in the darkness you see?
There’s light for a look at the Savior,
And life more abundant and free!

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Turn your eyes upon Jesus,
Look full in His wonderful face,
And the things of earth will grow strangely dim,
In the light of His glory and grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Through death into life everlasting
He passed, and we follow Him there;
Over us sin no more hath dominion—
For more than conquerors we are!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Word shall not fail you He promised;
Believe
Him, and all will be well:
Then go to a world that is dying,
His perfect salvation to tell!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
We have not known Thee as we ought,
Nor learned Thy wisdom, grace and power;
The things of earth have filled our thought,
And trifles of the passing hour.
Lord, give us light Thy truth to see,
And make us wise in knowing Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
We have not feared Thee as we ought,
Nor bowed beneath Thine awful eye,
Nor guarded deed and word and thought,
Remembering that God was nigh.
Lord, give us faith to know Thee near,
And grant the grace of holy fear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We have not loved Thee as we ought,
Nor cared that we are loved by Thee;
Thy presence we have coldly sought,
And feebly longed Thy face to see.
Lord, give a pure and loving heart
To feel and own the love Thou art.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
We have not served Thee as we ought,
Alas! the duties left undone,
The work with little fervor wrought,
The battles lost or scarcely won!
Lord, give the zeal, and give the might,
For
Thee to toil, for Thee to fight.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
When shall we know Thee as we ought,
And fear and love and serve aright?
When shall we, out of trial brought,
Be perfect in the land of light?
Lord, may we day by day prepare
To see Thy face and serve Thee there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Out of my bondage, sorrow, and night,
Jesus,
I come, Jesus, I come;
Into
Thy freedom, gladness, and light,
Jesus,
I come to Thee;
Out of my sickness, into Thy health,
Out of my want and into Thy wealth,
Out of my sin and into Thyself,
Jesus,
I come to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Out of my shameful failure and loss,
Jesus,
I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the glorious gain of Thy cross,
Jesus,
I come to Thee.
Out of earth’s sorrows into Thy balm,
Out of life’s storms and into Thy calm,
Out of distress to jubilant psalm,
Jesus,
I come to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Out of unrest and arrogant pride,
Jesus,
I come, Jesus, I come;
Into
Thy blessed will to abide,
Jesus,
I come to Thee.
Out of myself to dwell in Thy love,
Out of despair into raptures above,
Upward for aye on wings like a dove,
Jesus,
I come to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Out of the fear and dread of the tomb,
Jesus,
I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the joy and light of Thy home,
Jesus,
I come to Thee.
Out of the depths of ruin untold,
Into the peace of Thy sheltering fold,
Ever
Thy glorious face to behold,
Jesus,
I come to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Now,
O Lord, this very hour,
Send
Thy grace show Thy power;
While we rest upon Thy word,
Come, and bless us now, O Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thou loving blessed One,
Rising o’er us like the sun,
Light and life art Thou within:
Savior,
Thou, from every sin!

title: Power in the BloodThere is pow'r, pow'r, wonder working pow'rIn the blood of the Lamb;There is pow'r, pow'r, wonder working pow'rIn the precious blood of the Lamb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Would you be free from the burden of sin?
There's pow'r in the blood, pow'r in the blood;
Would you o'er evil a victory win?
There's wonderful power in the blood.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
There is pow'r, pow'r, wonder working pow'r
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is pow'r, pow'r, wonder working pow'r
In the precious blood of the Lamb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Would you be free from your passion and pride?
There's pow'r in the blood, pow'r in the blood;
Come for a cleansing to Calvary's tide?
There's wonderful power in the blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Would you do service for Jesus your King?
There's pow'r in the blood, pow'r in the blood;
Would you live daily His praises to sing?
There's wonderful power in the blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O the height of Jesus' love!
Higher than the heaven above,
Deeper than the deepest sea,
Lasting as eternity;
Love that found me-wondrous thought!
Found me when I sought Him not!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I’ve wandered far away from God,
Now
I’m coming home;
The paths of sin too long I’ve trod,
Lord,
I’m coming home.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Coming home, coming home,
Nevermore to roam,
Open wide Thine arms of love,
Lord,
I’m coming home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I’ve wasted many precious years,
Now
I’m coming home;
I now repent with bitter tears,
Lord,
I’m coming home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I’m tired of sin and straying, Lord,
Now
I’m coming home;
I’ll trust Thy love, believe Thy Word,
Lord,
I’m coming home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
My only hope, my only plea,
Now
I’m coming home;
That
Jesus died, and died for me;
Lord,
I’m coming home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God, be merciful to me,
On
Thy grace I rest my plea;
Plenteous in compassion Thou,
Blot out my transgressions now;
Wash me, make me pure within,
Cleanse,
O cleanse me from my sin,
Wash me, make me pure within,
Cleanse,
O cleanse me from my sin.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I am evil, born in sin;
Thou desirest truth within.
Thou alone my Savior art,
Teach
Thy wisdom to my heart;
Make me pure, Thy grace bestow,
Wash me whiter that the snow,
Make me pure, Thy grace bestow,
Wash me whiter than the snow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God, my heart renew
Make my spirit right and true;
Cast me not away from Thee,
Let
Thy Spirit dwell in me;
Thy salvation’s joy impart,
Steadfast make my willing heart,
Thy salvation’s joy impart,
Steadfast make my willing heart,

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Sinners then shall learn from me
And return, O God, to Thee;
Savior, all my guilt remove,
And my tongue shall sing Thy love
Touch my silent lips, O Lord,
And my mouth shall praise accord
Touch my silent lips, O Lord,
And my mouth shall praise accord.

title: I Lay My Sins on Jesus

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I bring my guilt to Jesus,
To wash my crimson stains
White in His blood most precious,
Till not a stain remains.
Till not a stain remains.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
I long to be with Jesus,
Meek, loving, lowly, mild
I long to be like Jesus,
The
Father’s holy child,
The
Father’s holy child.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
I long to be with Jesus,
Amid the heav’nly Throng
To sing with them His praises,
And learn the angels’ song,
And learn the angels’ song.

title: Forgive Our Sins as We Forgive

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
"Forgive our sins as we forgive,"
You taught us, Lord, to pray;
But
You alone can grant us grace
To live the words we say.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
How can Your pardon reach and bless
The unforgiving heart
That broods on wrongs and will not let
Old bitterness depart?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
In blazing light Your cross reveals
The truth we dimly knew:
How trifling others' debts to us;
How great our debt to You!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord cleanse the depths within our souls
And bid resentment cease;
Then, by Your mercy reconciled,
Our lives will spread Your peace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From
Thy riven side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure;
Cleanse me from its guilt and power.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
When my pilgrimage I close,
Victor o'er the last of foes,
When
I soar to worlds unknown,
And behold Thee on Thy throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Nearer, still nearer, close Thy heart,
Draw me, my Saviour, so precious Thou art;
Fold me, O fold me close to Thy breast,
Shelter me safe in that haven of rest,
Shelter me safe in that haven of rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Nearer, still nearer, nothing I bring,
Nought as an offering to Jesus my King–
Only my sinful now contrite heart;
Grant me the cleaning Thy blood doth impart,
Grant me the cleansing Thy blood doth impart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4

title: Deeper YetDeeper yet, deeper yet,Into the crimson flood;Deeper yet, deeper yet,Under the precious blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
In the blood from the cross
I have been washed from sin;
But to be free from dross,
Still
I would enter in.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Deeper yet, deeper yet,
Into the crimson flood;
Deeper yet, deeper yet,
Under the precious blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Day by day, hour by hour,
Blessings are sent to me
But for more of His power
Ever my prayer shall be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
I have peace, sweet peace,
While in this world of sin;
But to pray I'll not cease
Till
I am pure within.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Beneath the cross of Jesus
I fain would take my stand,
The shadow of a mighty rock
Within a weary land;
A home within the wilderness,
A rest upon the way,
From the burning of the noontide heat,
And the burden of the day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Upon that cross of Jesus
Mine eye at times can see
The very dying form of One
Who suffered there for me;
And from my smitten heart with tears
Two wonders I confess:
The wonders of redeeming love
And my unworthiness.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I take, O cross, thy shadow
For my abiding place;
I ask no other sunshine than
The sunshine of His face;
Content to let the world go by,
To know no gain nor loss,
My sinful self my only shame,
My glory all the cross.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Faith of our fathers, living still,
In spite of dungeon, fire and sword;
O how our hearts beat high with joy
Whenever we hear that glorious Word.
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Our fathers, chained in prisons dark,
Were still in heart and conscience free;
How sweet would be their children’s fate,
If they, like them, could die for thee!
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Faith of our fathers, we will love
Both friend and foe in all our strife;
And preach Thee, too, as love knows how
By kindly words and virtuous life.
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

title: Give Me JesusGive me Jesus,Give me Jesus,You may have all this world,Give me Jesus

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
In the morning when I rise,
In the morning when I rise,
In the morning when I rise,
Give me Jesus.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Give me Jesus,
Give me Jesus,
You may have all this world,
Give me Jesus

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Dark midnight was my cry,
Dark midnight was my cry,
Dark midnight was my cry,
Give me Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Just about the break of day,
Just about the break of day,
Just about the break of day,
Give me Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Oh, when I come to die,
Oh, when I come to die,
Oh, when I come to die,
Give me Jesus.

title: Draw Me NearerDraw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,To the cross where Thou hast died.Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,To Thy precious, bleeding side.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I am thine, O Lord, I have heard
Thy voice,
And it told Thy love to me;
But
I long to rise in the arms of faith
And be closer drawn to thee.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died.
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Consecrate me now to Thy service, Lord,
By the power of grace divine;
May my soul look up with a steadfast hope,
And my will be lost in Thine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O the pure delight of a single hour
That before Thy throne I spend,
When
I kneel in prayer, and with Thee, my God,
I commune as friend with friend!

title: I Am Coming to the CrossI am trusting, Lord, in Thee.O Thou Lamb of Calvary;Humbly at Thy cross I bow.Save me, Jesus, save me now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
I am trusting, Lord, in Thee.
O Thou Lamb of Calvary;
Humbly at Thy cross I bow.
Save me, Jesus, save me now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I give my all to Thee:
Friends and time and earthly store;
Soul and body Thine to be,
Wholly
Thine forevermore.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Jesus comes! He fills my soul!
Perfected in Him I am;
I am every whit made whole:
Glory, glory to the Lamb!

title: Wholly ThineWholly Thine, wholly Thine,Wholly Thine, this is my vow;Wholly Thine, wholly Thine,Wholly Thine, O Lord, just now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Wholly Thine, wholly Thine,
Wholly Thine, this is my vow;
Wholly Thine, wholly Thine,
Wholly Thine, O Lord, just now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
What is worldly pleasure, wealth, or fame,
Without
Thee, without Thee?
I will leave them all for They dear name,
This my wealth shall be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I cast earth's transient joys behind,
Come
Thou near, come Thou near;
In
Thy presence all in all I find,
'Tis my comfort here.

title: I Surrender AllI surrender all, I surrender all,All to Thee, my blessed Savior,I surrender all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessed Savior,
I surrender all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
All to Jesus I surrender;
Now
I feel the sacred flame.
O the joy of full salvation!
Glory, glory, to His Name!

title: I Would Draw Nearer to JesusI would draw nearer to Jesus,I would draw nearer to Him;Fully surrendered each moment,I would draw nearer to Him

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I would draw nearer to Jesus,
In
His sweet presence abide,
Constantly trying to serve Him,
Safe and secure at His side.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I would draw nearer to Jesus,
I would draw nearer to Him;
Fully surrendered each moment,
I would draw nearer to Him

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I would draw nearer to Jesus,
Nothing withholding from Him
Knowing
He loves to be gracious,
I would draw nearer to Him.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I would draw nearer to Jesus,
Seeking
His strength to be true,
Willing to tell of His goodness,
Gladly
His blest will to do.

title: I Would Be Like JesusBe like Jesus, this my song,In the home and in the throng;Be like Jesus, all day long!I would be like Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Be like Jesus, this my song,
In the home and in the throng;
Be like Jesus, all day long!
I would be like Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He has broken every fetter,
I would be like Jesus;
That my soul may serve Him better,
I would be like Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
All the way from earth to glory,
I would be like Jesus;
Telling o'er and o'er the story,
I would be like Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
That in heaven He may meet me,
I would be like Jesus;
That
His words “Well done” may greet me,
I would be like Jesus.

title: Near the CrossIn the cross, in the cross,Be my glory ever,Till my raptured soul shall findRest beyond the river.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus, keep me near the cross;
There a precious fountain,
Free to all, a healing stream,
Flows from Calvary's mountain.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever,
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Near the cross, a trembling soul,
Love and mercy found me;
There the bright and Morning star
Sheds its beams around me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Near the cross! O Lamb of God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day
With its shadow o'er me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Near the cross I'll watch and wait,
Hoping, trusting ever,
Till
I reach the golden strand
Just beyond the river.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Just as I am, without one plea,
But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bid’st me come to Thee,
O
Lamb of God, I come, I come.
