stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Just as I am, and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark blot,
To
Thee whose blood can cleanse each spot,
O
Lamb of God, I come, I come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Just as I am, though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt;
“Fightings within, and fears without,”
O
Lamb of God, I come, I come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind,
Yea, all I need in Thee to find,
O
Lamb of God, I come, I come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Just as I am, Thou wilt receive,
Wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve;
Because
Thy promise I believe,
O
Lamb of God, I come, I come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
Jut as I am, Thy love I own
Has broken every barrier down;
Now, to be Thine, and, Thine alone,
O
Lamb of God, I come, I come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Just as I am, without one plea,
But that thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bidst me come to thee,
O
Lamb of God, I come, I come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O for a closer walk with God,
A calm and heavenly frame,
A light to shine upon the road
That leads me to the Lamb!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Return,
O holy Dove, return,
Sweet messenger of rest!
I hate the sins that made Thee mourn
And drove Thee from my breast.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
What peaceful hours I once enjoyed!
How sweet their memory still!
But they have left an aching void
The world can never fill.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
The dearest idol I have known,
Whate’er that idol be
Help me to tear it from Thy throne,
And worship only Thee.

title: Live Out Thy Life Within Me

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Live out Thy life within me,
O
Jesus King of kings!
Be
Thou Thyself the answer
To all my questionings;
Live out Thy life within me,
In all things have Thy way!
I, the transparent medium
Thy glory to display.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The temple has been yielded,
And purified of sin;
Let
Thy Shekinah glory
Now shine forth from within,
And all the earth keep silence,
The body hence forth be
Thy silent, gentle servant,
Moved only as by Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Its members every moment
Held subject to Thy call,
Ready to have Thee use them,
Or not be used at all
Held without restless longing,
Or strain, or stress or fret,
Or chafings at Thy dealings,
O thoughts of vain regret.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
But restful calm, and pliant,
From bend and bias free,
Awaiting
Thy decision,
When
Thou hast need of me.
Live out Thy life within me,
O
Jesus, King of kings!
Be
Thou the glorious answer
To all my questionings.

title: Lead Me to CalvaryLest I forget Gethsemane,Lest I forget Thine agony;Lest I forget Thy love for me,Lead me to Calvary.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
King of my life, I crown Thee now,
Thine shall the glory be;
Lest
I forget Thy thorn crowned brow,
Lead me to Calvary.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Lest I forget Gethsemane,
Lest I forget Thine agony;
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
Lead me to Calvary.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid,
Tenderly mourned and wept;
Angels in robes of light arrayed
Guarded
Thee whilst Thou slept.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Let me like Mary, through the gloom,
Come with a gift to Thee;
Show to me now the empty tomb,
Lead me to Calvary.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
I be willing, Lord, to bear
Daily my cross for Thee;
Even
Thy cup of grief to share,
Thou hast borne all for me.

title: Whiter Than SnowWhiter than snow, yes, whiterthan snow;Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Whiter than snow, yes, whiter than snow;
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4

title: Lord I Want to Be a Christian

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord, I want to be a Christian
In my heart, in my heart,
Lord,
I want to be a Christian
In my heart.
In my heart,
Lord,
I want to be a Christian
In my heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord,
I want to be more loving
In my heart, in my heart,
Lord,
I want to be more loving
In my heart
In my heart.
In my heart.
Lord,
I want to be more loving
In my heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord,
I want to be more holy
In my heart, in my heart,
Lord,
I want to be more holy
In my heart.
In my heart,
In my heart,
Lord,
I want to be more holy
In my heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord,
I want to be like Jesus
In my heart, in my heart,
Lord,
I want to be like Jesus
In my heart.
In my heart,
In my heart,
Lord,
I want to be like Jesus
In my heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord of creation, to You be all praise!
Most mighty Your working,
Most wondrous Your ways!
Your glory and might beyond us to tell,
And yet in the heart of the humble
You dwell.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord of all power, I give You may will,
In joyful obedience Your tasks to fulfill.
Your bondage is freedom; Your service is song;
And held in Your keeping, my weakness is strong.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord of all wisdom, I give You my mind,
Rich truth that surpasses man’s knowledge to find;
What eye has not seen and what ear has not heard
Is taught by Your Spirit and shines from Your Word.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I'll love Thee in life, I will love Thee
'til death,
And praise Thee as long as Thou lendest me breath;
And say when the death dew lies cold on my brow,
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
In mansions of glory and endless delight,
I'll ever adore Thee in heaven so bright;
I'll sing with the glittering crown on my brow,
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

title: Nothing BetweenNothing between my soul and the Saviour,So that His blessed face may be seen;Nothing preventing the least ofHis favor:Keep the way clear!Let nothing between.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
Naught of this world’s delusive dream:
I have renounced all sinful pleasure;
Jesus is mine!
There’s nothing between.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Nothing between my soul and the Saviour,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of
His favor:
Keep the way clear!
Let nothing between.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Nothing between, e'en many hard trials,
Though the whole world against me convene;
Watching with prayer and much self denial,
Triumph at last,
With nothing between!

title: O for a Heart to PraiseMy God!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
My God!
O for a heart to praise my God!
A heart from sin set free,
A heart that always feels Thy blood,
So freely shed for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
A heart resigned, submissive, meek,
My dear Redeemer’s throne,
Where only Christ is heard to speak,
Where
Jesus reigns alone.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
A heart in every thought renewed
And full of love divine,
Perfect and right and pure and good,
A copy, Lord, of Thine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4

title: Just as I Am, Thine Own to Be

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Just as I am, Thine own to be,
Friend of the young, who lovest me,
To consecrate myself to Thee,
O
Jesus Christ, I come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
In the glad morning of my day,
My life to give, my vows to pay,
With no reserve and no delay,
With all my heart I come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Just as I am, young, strong, and free,
To be the best that I can be
For truth, and righteousness, and Thee,
Lord of my life, I come.

title: Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus, I my cross have taken,
All to leave and follow Thee.
All things else I have forsaken;
Thou from hence my all shalt be.
Perish every fond ambition,
All
I’ve sought or hoped or known;
Yet how rich is my condition,
While
I prove the Lord my own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Let the world despise and leave me,
They have left my Savior, too.
Human hearts and looks deceive me;
Thou art faithful, Thou art true.
Oh,
’tis not in grief to harm me,
While
Thy love is left to me;
Oh,
’twere not in joy to charm me,
If that love be hid from me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Haste then on from grace to glory,
Armed by faith, and winged by prayer,
Heaven’s eternal day’s before thee,
God’s own hand shall guide thee there.
Soon shall close thy earthly mission,
Soon shall pass thy pilgrim days;
Hope shall change to glad fruition,
Faith to sight, and prayer to praise.

title: Open My Eyes That I May See

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Open my eyes, that I may see
Glimpses of truth Thou hast for me;
Place in my hands the wonderful key
That shall unclasp and set me free.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my eyes, Illumine me,
Spirit
Divine!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Open my ears that I may hear
Voices of truth Thou sendest clear;
And while the wavenotes fall on my ear,
Everything false will disappear.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my ears, illumine me,
Spirit
Divine!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Open my mouth, and let me bear
Gladly the warm truth everywhere;
Open my heart, and let me prepare
Love with Thy children thus to share.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my heart, illumine me,
Spirit
Divine!

title: I’d Rather Have JesusThan to be the king of a vast domainOr be held in sin’s dread sway;I’d rather have Jesus than anythingThis world affords today.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I’d rather have Jesus than silver or gold,
I’d rather be His than have riches untold;
Id rather have Jesus than houses or lands,
I’d rather led by His nail pierced hand.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Than to be the king of a vast domain
Or be held in sin’s dread sway;
I’d rather have Jesus than anything
This world affords today.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I’d rather have Jesus than men’s applause,
I’d rather be faithful to His dear cause;
I’d rather have Jesus than world wide fame,
I’d rather be true to His Holy name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
He’s fairer that lilies of rarest bloom,
He’s sweeter than honey from out the comb;
He’s all that my hungering spirit needs,
I’d rather have Jesus and let Him lead.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Must Jesus bear the cross alone,
And all the world go free?
No, there's a cross for everyone,
And there's a cross for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The consecrated cross I'll bear
Till
He shall set me free;
And then go home my crown to wear,
For there's a crown for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Upon the crystal pavement, down
At
Jesus' pierced feet,
With joy I'll cast my golden crown,
And
His dear name repeat.

title: Take the World, but Give Me JesusOh, the height and depth of mercy!Oh, the length and breadth of love!Oh, the fullness of redemption,Pledge of endless life above

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Take the wold, but give me Jesus;
All its joys are but a name,
But
His love abideth ever,
Through eternal years the same.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Oh, the height and depth of mercy!
Oh, the length and breadth of love!
Oh, the fullness of redemption,
Pledge of endless life above

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Take the world, but give me Jesus,
Sweetest comfort of my soul;
With my Savior watching o'er me,
I can sing, though billows roll.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Take the world, but give me Jesus;
In
His cross my trust shall be,
Till, with clearer, brighter vision
Face to face my Lord I see.

title: Take My Life and Let It Be

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Take my life, and let it be
Consecrated
Lord, to Thee;
Take my hands, and let them move
At the impulse of Thy love,
At the impulse of Thy love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Take my feet and let them be
Swift and beautiful from Thee;
Take my voice, and let me sing
Always, only, for my King,
Always, only, for my King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Take my lips, and let them be
Filled with messages from Thee;
Take my silver and my gold!
Not a mite would I with hold,
Not a mite would I with hold.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Take my love; my Lord I pour
At
Thy feet its treasure store;
Take myself, and I will be,
Ever, only, all for Thee,
Ever, only, all for Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end;
Be
Thou forever near me,
My
Master and my Friend.
I shall not fear the battle
If thou art by my side,
Nor wander from the pathway
If thou wilt be my guide.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Jesus, Thou hast promised
To all who follow Thee
That where thou art in glory
There shall Thy servant be.
And
Jesus, I have promised
To serve thee to the end;
O give me grace to follow,
My
Master and my Friend.

title: The Cleansing WaveThe cleansing stream I see, I see,I plunge, and O, it cleanseth me!O praise the Lord! it cleanseth me,It cleanseth me, yes, cleanseth me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O now I see the crimson wave,
The fountain deep and wide
Jesus, my Lord, mighty to save,
Points to His wounded side.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
The cleansing stream I see, I see,
I plunge, and O, it cleanseth me!
O praise the Lord! it cleanseth me,
It cleanseth me, yes, cleanseth me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I see the new creation rise,
I hear the speaking blood;
It speaks–polluted nature dies,
Sinks
‘neath the cleansing flood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I rise to walk in heaven’s own light,
Above the world and sin;
With heart made pure and garments white,
And
Christ enthroned within.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Amazing grace! ‘tis heaven below
To feel the blood applied,
And
Jesus, only Jesus, know,
My
Jesus crucified.

title: On Jordan’s banks the Baptist’s Cry

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
On Jordan’s bank the Baptist’s cry
Announces that the Lord is nigh;
Awake and hearken, for he brings
Glad tidings of the King of kings!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Then cleansed be every life from sin;
Make straight the way for God within
And let us all our hearts prepare
For
Christ to come and enter there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We hail You as our Savior, Lord,
Our refuge and our great reward;
Without
Your grace we waste away
Like flow’rs that wither and decay.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Stretch forth Your hand, our health restore,
And make us rise to fall no more;
Oh, let Your face upon us shine
And fill the world with love divine.

title: Come, Thou Fount of Every Blessing

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, Thou Fount of every blessing,
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace;
Streams of mercy, never ceasing,
Call for songs of loudest praise.
Teach me ever to adore Thee,
May
I still Thy goodness prove,
While the hope of endless glory
Fills my heart with joy and love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I raise mine Ebenezer;
Hither by Thy help I've come,
And
I hope, by thy good pleasure,
Safely to arrive at home.
Jesus sought me when a stranger,
Wandering from the fold of God;
He to rescue me from danger,
Interposed
His precious blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O, to grace how great a debtor
Daily
I'm constrained to be!
Let thy goodness, like a fetter,
Bind me closer still to Thee.
Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it,
Prone to leave the God I love; here's my heart, O take and seal it,
Seal it for Thy courts above.

title: What a Wonderful SaviorWhat a wonderul Saviour is Jesus, my Jesus!What a wonderful Savior is Jesus,my Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ has for sin atonement made,
What a wonderful Savior!
We are redeemed! the price is paid!
What a wonderful Savior!

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
What a wonderul Saviour is Jesus, my Jesus!
What a wonderful Savior is Jesus, my Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I praise Him for the cleansing blood,
What a wonderful Savior!
That reconciled my soul to God;
What a wonderful Savior!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
He walks beside me all the way,
What a wonderful Savior!
And keeps me faithful day by day;
What a wonderful Savior!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He gives me overcoming power,
What a wonderful Savior!
And triumph in each trying hour;
What a wonderful Savior!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There is a fountain filled with blood
Drawn from Immanuel's veins;
And sinners plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains.
Lose all their guilty stains,
Lose all their guilty stains;
And sinners plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The dying thief rejoiced to see
That fountain in his day;
And there may I, though vile as he,
Wash all my sins away.
Wash all my sins away,
Wash all my sins away;
And there may I, though vile as he,
Wash all my sins away.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thou dying Lamb!, thy precious blood
Shall never lose its power
Till all the ransomed church of God
Are saved, to sin no more.
Are saved, to sin no more,
Are saved, to sin no more;
Till all the ransomed church of God
Ae saved, to sin no more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
E'er since, by faith, I saw the stream
Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die.
And shall be till I die,
And shall be till I die;
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Lord,
I believe Thou hast prepared,
Unworthy though I be,
For me a blood-bought, free reward
A golden harp for me!
A golden harp for me!
A golden harp for me!
For me a blood-bought, free reward
A golden harp for me!

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
There in a nobler, sweeter song,
I'll sing thy power to save,
When this poor lisping, stammering tongue
Is ransomed from the grave,
Is ransomed from the grave,
Is ransomed from the grave,
When this poor lisping, stammering tongue
Is ransomed from the grave.

title: Redeemed!Redeemed, redeemed,Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;Redeemed, redeemed,His child, and forever, I am.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Redeemed! How I love to proclaim it!
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed through His infinite mercy,
His child, and forever, I am.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Redeemed, redeemed,
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed, redeemed,
His child, and forever, I am.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Redeemed!
And so happy in Jesus!
No language my rapture can tell;
I know that the light of His presence
With me doth continually dwell.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I know therre’s a crown is waiting
In yonder bright mansion for me;
And soon, with the saints made perfect,
At home with the Lord I shall be.

title: RedeemedRedeemed, redeemed,Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;Redeemed, redeemed,His child, and forever, I am.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Redeemed, how I love to proclaim it!
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed thro' His infinite mercy,
His child, and forever, I am.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Redeemed, redeemed,
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed, redeemed,
His child, and forever, I am.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I know I shall see in His beauty
The
King in whose law I delight,
Who lovingly guardeth my footsteps,
And giveth me songs in the night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God is my strong salvation,
What foe have I to fear?
In darkness and temptation,
My
Light, my Help is near:
Though hosts encamp around me,
Firm in the fight I stand;
What terror can confound me,
With
God at my right hand?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
We have heard a joyful sound,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Spread the gladness all around,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Bear the news to every land,
Climb the steeps and cross the waves,
Onward,
‘tis our Lord’s comand
Jesus saves, Jesus saves.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Waft it on the rolling tide,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Tell to sinners, far and wide,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Sing, ye islands of the sea.
Echo back, ye ocean caves,
Earth shall keep her jubilee,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Sing above the battles strife,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
By
His death and endless life,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Sing it softly through the gloom,
When the heart for mercy craves,
Sing in triumph o’er the tomb,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Give the winds a mighty voice,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Let the nations now rejoice,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves;
Shout salvation full and free,
Highest hills and deepest caves,
This our song of victory,
Jesus saves, Jesus saves.

title: To God Be the GloryPraise the Lord, praise the Lord,Let the earth hear His voice!Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,Let the people rejoice!O come to the Father thru Jesusthe Son,And give Him the glory, great things He hath done!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
To God be the glory, great things He hath done!
So loved He the world that He gave us His Son,
Who yielded His life an atonement for sin,
And opened the lifegate that all may go in.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father thru Jesus the Son,
And give Him the glory, great things He hath done!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood,
To every believer the promise of God;
The vilest offender who truly believes,
That moment from Jesus a pardon receives.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Great things He hath taught us, great things He Hath done,
And great our rejoicing thru Jesus the Son;
But purer, and higher, and greater will be
Our wonder, our transport, when Jesus we see.

title: Is This a Day of New Beginnings?

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Is this a day of new beginnings,
Time to remember and move on,
Time to believe what love is bringing,
Laying to rest the pain that’s gone?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
How can the seasons of a planet
Mindlessly spining round its sun
With just a human name and number
Say that some new thing has begun?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Yet thro’ the life and death of Jesus
Love’s mighty Spirit, now as then,
Can make for us a world of difference
As faith and hope are born again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Then let us, with the Spirit’s daring,
Step from the past and leave behind
Its disappointment, guilt, and grieving,
Seeking new paths, and sure to find.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Christ is alive, and goes before us
To show and share what love can do.
This is a day of new beginnings;
Our
God is making all things new.

title: I Will Sing of My Redeemer

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I will sing of my Redeemer,
And wondrous love to me;
On the cruel cross He suffered
From the curse to set me free.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Sing,
Oh sing of my Redeemer,
With
His blood He purchased me;
On the cross He sealed my pardon,
Paid the debt and made me free.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I will tell the wondrous story,
How my lost estate to save,
In
His boundless love and mercy,
He the ransom freely gave.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I will sing of my Redeemer,
And
His heav’nly love to me;
He from death to life  hath brought me,
Son of God, with Him to be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I love Your kingdom, Lord,
The house of Your abode,
The
Church our blest Redeemer saved
With
His own precious blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I love Your church, O God!
Her walls before Thee stand
Dear as the apple of Thine eye,
And graven on Thy hand.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Beyond my highest joy
I prize its heavenly ways,
Its sweet communion, solemn vows,
Its hymns of love and praise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Sure as Your truth shall last,
To
Zion shall be given
The brightest glories earth can yield,
And brighter bliss of heaven.

title: Christ Is the World’s True Light

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ is the world’s true light,
Its captain of salvation,
The day star clear and bright
Of every man and nation;
New life, new hope awakes
Where e’er men own His sway:
Freedom her bondage breaks,
And night is turned to day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Christ all races meet,
Their ancient feuds forgetting,
The whole round world complete,
From sunrise to its setting:
When
Christ is throned as Lord
Men shall forsake their fear,
To plow share beat the sword,
To pruning hook the spear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord, in one great name
Unite us all who own Thee,
Cast out our pride and shame
That hinder to enthrone Thee;
The world has waited long
Has travailed long in pain,
To heal its ancient wrong,
Come,
Prince of Peace, and reign.

title: Lord, Who Dost Give to Thy Church

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord, who dost give to Thy church for its healing
Gifts, and the grace to sustain and renew,
Hear as we pray that today and each morrow
We to Thy purpose may show ourselves true.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Clear be the voices of preachers and prophets
Fearlessly speaksing the word of the Lord,
Word of redemption thro’ God’s Son incarnate,
Blessing for cursing, and peace for the sword.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Tender and wise be the hearts of the pastors,
Guiding and guarding the sus in their care,
Firm with he wayward, a strength to the doubting
Helping the needy their burdens to bear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
May those who teach grow in knowledge and patience
Guiding to wisdom the young and the old
Training for worship and witness and service
Foes to all falsehood in truthfulness bold

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Lord, ever give to us gifts in due measure,
Each needing other and all having worth
So to the Father, the Son, and the Spirit,
Glory be shown by the church here on earth.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Built on the Rock the Church shall stand,
Even when steeples are falling;
Crumbled have spires in every land,
Bells still are chimming and calling--
Call the young and old to rest,
Calling the soul of those distressed,
Longing for life ever lasting.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Not in our temples made with hands
God,the almighty is dwelling;
High in the heav’ns, His temple stands,
All earthly temples excelling.
Yet
He who dwells in hea’vn above
Deigns to abide with us in love,
Making our bodies His temple.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We are God’s house of living stones,
Built for His own habitation;
He fills our heart, His humble thrones,
Granting us life and salvation.
Were two or three to seek His face,
He in their midst would show His grace,
Blessings upon them bestowing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Yet in this house, an earthly frame,
Jesus
His children is blessing;
Hither we come to praise His name,
Faith in our Savior confessing.
Jesus to us His Spirit sent,
Making with us His covenent,
Granting
His children the kingdom.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Thro’ all the passing years, O Lord,
Grant that, when church bells are ringing,
Many may come to hear God’s Word
Where
He this promise is bringing:
I know My own, My own know Me:
You, not the world, My face shall see;
My peace I leave with you. Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The church has one foundation
'Tis
Jesus Christ her Lord;
She is His new creation
By water and the Word.
From heaven He came and sought her
To be His holy bride;
With
His own blood He bought her,
And for her life He died.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Elect from every nation,
Yet one o'er all the earth;
Her charter of salvation,
One
Lord, one faith, one birth;
One holy name she blesses,
Partakes one holy food,
And to one hope she presses,
With every grace endued.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Though with a scornful wonder
Men see her sore oppressed,
Though foes would rend asunder,
The
Rock where she doth rest,
Yet saints their faith are keeping;
Their cry goes up, "How long?"
And soon the night of weeping
Shall be the morn of song.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
'Mid toil and tribulation,
And tumult of her war,
She waits the consummation
Of peace forevermore;
Till with the vision glorious,
Her longing eyes are blest,
And the great church victorious
Shall be the church at rest.

title: God Is LoveGod is love, and where true love isGod Himself is there.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
God is love, and where true love is
God Himself is there.
Here in Christ we gather, love of Christ our calling.
Christ, our love, is with us, gladness be His greeting.
Let us fear him, yes and love Him,
God eternal
Loving
Him, let each love Christ in all his brethren.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
When we Christians gather, members of one body,
Let there be in us no discord but one spirit.
Banished now be anger, strife, and every quarrel.
Christ, our God, be always present here among us.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Grant us love’s fulfillment, joy with all the blessed,
When we see Your face, O Savior, in its glory.
Shine on us, O purest Light of all creation,
Be our bliss while endless ages sing Your praises.

title: Blest Be the Tie That Binds

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Blest be the tie that binds
Our hearts in Christian love;
The fellowship of kindred minds
Is like to that above.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Before our Father's throne
We pour our ardent prayers;
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one,
Our comforts and our cares.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We share our mutual woes,
Our mutual burdens bear;
And often for each other flows
The sympathizing tear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
When we asunder part,
It gives us inward pain;
But we shall still be joined in heart,
And hope to meet again.

title: Thy Hand, O God Has Guided

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thy heralds brought glad tidings
To greatest as to least;
They bade men rise and hasten
To share the great King’s feast:
And this was all their teaching,
In every deed and word,
To all alike proclaiming
One church, one faith, one Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
When shadows thick were falling,
And all seemed sunk in night,
Thou,
Lord, did send Thy servants,
Thy chosen sons of light.
On them and on Thy people
Thy plenteous grace was poured,
And this was still their message:
One church, one faith, one Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thy mercy cry will not fail us,
Nor leave Thy work undone;
With
Thy right hand to help us,
The vict’ry shall be won;
And then by men and angels
Thy name shall be adored,
And this shall be their anthem:
One church, one faith, one Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
This is My will, My one command,
That love should dwell among you all.
This is My will that you should love
As
I have shown that I love you.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
No greater love a man can have
Than that he die to save his friends.
You are My friends if you obey
What
I command that you should do.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
You chose not Me, but I chose you
That you should go and bear much fruit.
I chose you out that you in Me
Should bear much fruit that will abide.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
All that I ask My Father, dear,
For
My name’s sake you shall receive.
This is My will, My one command,
That love should dwell in each, in all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Father, help Your people in this world to build
Something of Your kingdom and to do Your will,
Lead us to discover partnership in love;
Bless our ways of sharing and our pride remove.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord of desk and altar, bind our lives in one
That in works and worship love may set the tone.
Give us grace to listen, clarity of speech;
Make us trully thankful for the gifts of each.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Holy is the setting of each room and yard,
Lecture hall and kitchen, office, shop, and ward.
Holy is the rhythm of our working hours;
Hallow then our purpose, energy, and pow’rs.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Strengthen,
Lord, for service hand and heart brain;
Help us good relations daily to maintain.
Let the living presence of the servant Christ
Heighten out devotion, make our life a feast.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
From out the darkness of our hope’s frustration,
From all the broken idols of our pride,
We turn to seek Thy truth’s illumination,
And find Thy mercy waiting at our side.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
In pity look upon Thy children’s striving
For life and freedom, peace and brotherhood,
Till at the fullness of Thy truth arriving,
We find in Christ the crown of every good.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thy church earth’s discordant voices,
To preach gospel of her Lord above,
Until the day this warring world rejoices
To hear the mighty harmonies of love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Where cross the crowded ways of life,
Where sound the cries of race and clan,
Above the noise of selfish strife,
We hear
Your voice, O Son of Man.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
From tender childhood's helplessness,
From human grief and burdened toil,
From famished souls, from sorrow's stress,
Your heart has never known recoil.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The cup of water given for You
Still holds the freshness of Your grace;
Yet long these multitudes to view
The strong compassion in Your face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Till all the world shall learn Your love
And follow where Your feet have trod,
Till, glorious from Your heav'n above,
Shall come the city of our God.

title: All Who Love and ServeYour City

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
All who love and serve your city,
All who bear its daily stress,
All who cry for peace and justice,
All who curse and all who bless,

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
In your day of loss and sorrow,
In your day of helpless strife,
Honor, peace, and love retreating,
Seek the Lord, who is your life.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
For all days are days of judgment,
And the Lord is waiting still,
Drawing near His friend who spurn Him,
Off’ring peace form Calvary’s hill.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord, shall yet the city
Be the city of despair?
Come today, our judge, our glory;
Be its name “The Lord is there!”

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, labor on.
Who dares stand idle on the harvest plain
While all around him waves the golden grain?
And to each servant does the Master say,
“Go work today”

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Come, labor on.
No time for rest, till glows the western sky,
Till the long shadows o’er our pathway lie,
And a glad sound comes with the setting sun,
“Well done, well done!”

title: Far and Near the Fields Are TeemingLord of harvest, send forth reapers!Hear us, Lord, to Thee we cry;Send them now the sheaves to gather,Ere the harvest time pass by.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Far and near the fields are teeming
With the sheaves of ripened grain;
Far and near their gold is gleaming
O’er the sunny slope and plain.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Lord of harvest, send forth reapers!
Hear us, Lord, to Thee we cry;
Send them now the sheaves to gather,
Ere the harvest time pass by.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Send them forth with morn’s first beaming,
Send them in the noontide’s glare;
When the sun’s last rays are streaming,
Bid them gather everywhere.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O thou, whom thy Lord is sending,
Gather now the sheaves of gold
Heavenward then at evening wending
Thou shalt come with joy untold.

title: Hark! the Voice of Jesus Calling

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Hark! the voice of Jesus calling,
“Who will go and work today?
Fields are white, the harvest waiting,
Who will bear the sheaves away?”
Loud and long the Master calleth,
Rich reward He offers free;
Who will answer, gladly saying,
“Here am I, Lord, send me”?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
If you cannot cross the ocean
And the heathen lands explore
You can find the heathen nearer,
You can help them at your door;
If you cannot speak like angels,
If you cannot preach like Paul,
You can tell the love of God Jesus,
You can say He died for all.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
If you cannot be the watchman,
Standing high on Zion’s wall,
Pointing out the path to heaven,
Offering life and peace to all;
With your prayer and with your bounties
You can do what Heaven demands,
You can be like faithful Aaron,
Holding up the prophet’s hands.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
While the souls of men are dying,
And the Master calls for you.
Let none hear you idly saying,
“There is nothing I can do!”
Gladly take the task He gives you,
Let
His work your pleasure be;
Answer quickly when He calleth,
“Here am I, O Lord, send me.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
From the eastern mountains
Pressing on they come,
Wise men in their wisdom,
To
His humble home;
Stirred by deep devotion,
Hasting from afar,
Every journey onward,
Guided by a star.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There their Lord and Saviour,
Meek and lowly lay
Wondrous light that led them
Onward on their way,
Ever now to lighten
Nations from afar,
As they journey homeward,
By that guiding star.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Gather in the outcasts
All who’ve gone astray,
Throw
Thy radiance o’er them,
Guide them on their way;
Those who never knew Thee,
Those who’ve wandered far,
Guide them by the brightness,
Of
Thy guiding star.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Until every nation,
Whether bond or free,
‘Neath
Thy starlit banner,
Jesus follows thee.
O’er the distant mountains,
To that heavenly home,
Where no sin nor sorrow,
Ever more shall come.

title: Hark! ‘Tis the Shepherd’s Voice I HearBring them in, Bring them in,Bring them in from the fields of sin;Bring them in, Bring them in,Bring then wanderers to Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Hark! ‘tis the Shepherd’s voice I hear,
Out in the desert dark and drear,
Calling the sheep who’ve gone astray,
Far from the Shepherd’s fold away.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Bring them in, Bring them in,
Bring them in from the fields of sin;
Bring them in, Bring them in,
Bring then wanderers to Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Who’ll go and help the Shepherd kind,
Help
Him the wandering ones to find?
Who’‘l bring them back into the fold,
Where they’ll be shelter from the cold?

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Out in the desert hear their cry,
Out on the mountain wild and high,
Hark!
‘tis the Master speaks to thee,
“Go, find My sheep where’er they be.”

title: Lift High the CrossLift high the cross, the love of Christ proclaim,Till all the world adore His sacred Name.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Lift high the cross, the love of Christ proclaim,
Till all the world adore His sacred Name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come,
Christian, follow where our Captain trod,
Our
King victorious, Christ, the Son of God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Led on their way by this triumphant sign,
The hosts of God in conqu’ring ranks combine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
All newborn soldiers of the Crucified
Bears on the brow the seal of Him Who died.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord, once lifted on the glorious tree,
As
Thou hast promised, draw us all to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
So shall our song of triumph ever be:
Praise to the Crucified for victory!

title: Lord, Whose Love in Humble Service

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord, whose love in humble service
Bore the weight human need,
Who upon the cross, forsaken,
Worked
Your mercy’s perfect deed:
We,
Your servants, bring the worship
Not of voice alone, but heart;
Consecrating to Your purpose
Every gift which You impart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
As we worship, grant us vision,
Till your love’s revealing light
In its height and depth and greatness
Dawns upon our quickened sight,
Making known the needs and burdens
Your compassion bids us bear,
Stirring us to ardent service,
Your abundant life to share.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Jesus Crist, to You my hymns be rising
In every city for Your love and care;
Inspire our worship, grant the glad surprising
That
Your blest Spirit brings men everywhere.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Grant us new courage, sacrificial, humble,
Strong in Your strength to venture and to dare,
To lift the fallen, guide the feet that stumble,
Seek out the lonely and God’s mercy share.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Show us Your Spirit, brooding o’er each city,
As
You did weep above Jerusalem,
Seeking to gather all in love and pity,
And healing those who touch Your garment’s hem.

title: O Zion, HastePublish glad tidings, tidings of peace;Tidings of Jesus, redemption and release.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O Zion, haste, thy mission high fulfilling,
To tell to all the world that God is light;
That
He who made all nations is not willing
One soul should perish, lost in shades of night.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Publish glad tidings, tidings of peace;
Tidings of Jesus, redemption and release.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Proclaim to every people, tongue, and nation
That
God, in whom they live and move, is love;
Tell how He stooped to save His lost creation,
And died on earth that we might live above.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He comes again! O Zion, ere thou meet Him,
Make known to every heart His saving grace;
Let none whom He Hath ransomed fail to greet Him,
Through thy neglect, unfit to see His face.

title: O Where Are the Reapers?Where are the reapers? O who will comeAnd share in the glory of the “harvest home’?O who will help us to garner inThe sheaves of good from the fields of sin?

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O where are the reapers that garner in
The sheaves of the good from the fields of sin?
With sickles of truth must the work be done,
And no one may rest till the “harvest home.”

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Where are the reapers? O who will come
And share in the glory of the “harvest home’?
O who will help us to garner in
The sheaves of good from the fields of sin?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The fields all are ripening, and far and wide
The world now is waiting the harvest tide:
But reapers are few, and the work is great,
And much will be losst should the harvest wait.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
So come with your sickles, ye sons of men,
And gather together the golden gain;
Toil on till the Lord of the harvest come,
Then share ye His joy in the “harvest home.”

title: Rescue the PerishingRescue the perishing, Care for the dying;Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Rescue the perishing, Care for the dying;
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Though they are the slighting Him,
Still
He is waiting,
Waiting the penitent child to receive
Plead with them earnestly
Plead with them gently;
He will forgive if they only believe.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3

title: Watchman, Blow the Gospel TrumpetBlow the trumpet, trusty watchman,Blow it loud o’er land and sea;God comissions, sound the message!Every captive maybe free.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Watchman, blow the gospel trumpet,
Every soul a warning give
Whosoever hears the message
May repent, and turn and live.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Blow the trumpet, trusty watchman,
Blow it loud o’er land and sea;
God comissions, sound the message!
Every captive maybe free.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Sound it loud o’er every hilltop,
Gloomy shade and sunny plain;
Ocean depths repeat the message,
Full salvation’s glad refrain.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Sound it in the hedge and highway,
Earth’s dark spots where exiles roam;
Let it tell all things are ready,
Father waits to welcome home

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Sound it for the heavy laden,
Weary, longing to be free;
Sound a Saviour's invitation,
Sweetly saying, “Come to me.”

title: Bringing in the SheavesBringing in the sheaves,  Bringing in the sheavesWe shall come rejoicing,  Bringing in the sheaves;Bringing in the sheaves,  Bringing in the sheaves,We shall come rejoicing, Bringing in the sheaves.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Sowing in the morning,
Sowing seeds of kindness,
Sowing in the noontide
And the dewy eve;
Waiting for the harvest,
And the time of reaping,
We shall come rejoicing
Bringing in the sheaves.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Bringing in the sheaves,
Bringing in the sheaves
We shall come rejoicing,
Bringing in the sheaves;
Bringing in the sheaves,
Bringing in the sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing,
Bringing in the sheaves.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Sowing in the sunshine, sowing in the shadows,
Fearing neither clouds
Nor winter’s chilling breeze;
By and by the harvest
And the labor ended,
We shall come rejoicing,
Bringing in the sheaves.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Going forth with weeping,
Sowing for the Master,
Though the loss sustained
Our spirit often grieves;
When our weeping’s over
He will bid us welcome,
We shall come rejoicing,
Bringing in the sheaves.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ for the world we sing,
The world to Christ we bring,
With loving zeal;
The poor, and them that mourn,
The faint and overborne,
Sinsick and sorrow-worn,
Whom
Christ doth heal.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Christ for the world we sing,
The world to Christ we bring,
With fervent prayer;
The wayward and the lost,
By restless passions tossed,
Redeemed at countless cost,
From dark despair.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Christ for the world we sing,
The world to Christ we bring,
With joyful song;
The newborn souls, whose days,
Reclaimed from error's ways,
Inspired with hope and praise,
To
Christ belong.

title: Lift Him UpLift Him up, the risen Savior,High amid the waiting throng;Lift Him up, ‘tis He that speaketh,Now He bids you flee from wrong.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Lift Him up, the risen Savior,
High amid the waiting throng;
Lift Him up, ‘tis He that speaketh,
Now He bids you flee from wrong.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Him up, this precious Savior,
Let the multitude behold;
They with willing hearts shall seek Him,
He will draw them to His fold;
They shall gather from the wayside,
Hastening on with joyuos feet,
They shall bear the cross of Jesus,
And shall find salvation sweet.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O then lift Him up in singing,
Lift the Savior up in prayer
He, the glorious Redeemer,
All the sins of men did bear;
Yes, the young shall bow before Him,
And the old their voices raise,
All the deaf shall hear hosanah;
And the dumb shall shout His praise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
How beauteous are their feet
Who stand on Zion’s hill;
Who bring salvation on their tongues,
And words of peace reveal!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
How charming is their voice,
So sweet the tidings are:
“Zion, behold thy Savior King;
He reigns and triumphs here!”

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
How happy are our ears,
That hear the joyful sound
Which kings and prophets waited for,
And sought, but never found!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
How blessed are our eyes,
That see this heavenly light;
Prophets and kings desired it long,
But died without the sight!

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
The watchmen join their voice,
And tuneful notes employ;
Jerusalem breaks forth in songs,
And deserts learn the joy.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Seeing the Lost-yes, kindly entreating
Wanderers  on the mountain astray
"Come unto Me," His message repeating,
Words of the Master speaking today.
Refrian
Going afar, upon the mountain
Bringing the waderer back again
Into the fold of my Redeemer
Jesus the Lamb for sinners slain

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Seeking the lost and pointing to Jesus
Souls that are weak and hearts that are sore,
Leading them forth in ways of salvation,
Showing the path to life evermore.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thus I would go on missions of mercy
Following Christ from day unto day,
Cheering the faint and raising the fallen,
Pointing to the lost to Jesus, the Way

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus, with Thy church abide;
Be her Savior, Lord, and Guide,
While on earth her faith is tried:
We beseech Thee, hear us.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
May her voice be ever clear,
Warming of a judgment near,
Telling of a Savior dear:
We beseech Thee, hear us.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
May she guide the poor and blind,
Seek the lost until she find,
And the broken hearted bind:
We beseech Thee, hear us.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
May she holy triumphs win,
Over throw the hosts of sin,
Gather all the nations in:
We beseech Thee, hear us.

title: Work, for the Night Is Coming

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
All things are Thine; no gift have we,
Lord of all gifts, to offer Thee;
And hence with grateful hearts today,
Thine own before Thy feet we lay.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
No lack Thy perfect fullness knew;
For human needs and longings grew
This house of prayer-- this home of rest.
Here may Thy saints be often blessed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
In weakness and in want we call
On
Thee, for whom the heav’ns are small;
Thy glory is Thy children's good,
Thy joy Thy tender Fatherhood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Father! Deign these walls to bless;
Make this the abode of righteousness,
And let these doors a gateway be
To lead us from ourselves to Thee!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Go forth, go forth with Christ,
Who called you to this day,
He who has led, will lead
And keep you in His way:
His word is fast, His promise sure
To all who serve Him and endure.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Go forth, go forth with Christ,
With purpose not your own,
Each vict’ry you shall gain
Through
Him your Lord alone:
To guard you in fidelity
His
Spirit shall your strength’ner be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Go forth, go forth with Christ,
His
Priesthood you shall share,
Who bought us by His blood
To be His servants here:
Walk in the way your Savior trod,
Go forth with Him, go forth with God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
“I’ll make your great commission known,
And ye shall prove My gospel true
By all the works that I have done,
By all the wonders ye shall do.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4

title: We Give This Child to You

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
We give the child to You,
Our precious gift of love.
Help us to lead each step aright
With guidance from above.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O bless each child of Yours,
And grant when they are grown,
They will have learned to love Your way,
And choose it for their own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We give ourselves to You,
And may Your Spirit fill
Our hearts and home, that all we do
Be subject to Your will.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Welcome, day of sweet repose!
Blessed be thy sacred hours!
We would trust the One who knows
All our weak and failing powers.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Welcome, day in Eden born!
Holy rest for sinless man!
Like the dawning of fair morn
Come thy hours to us again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Welcome, day blessed by our Lord!
Toil shall cease and anxious care
Day commanded by His word,
Day for song and praise and prayer.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Welcome, day our Savior kept!
Keeping, wrought our righteousness,
Day
God bids us ne’er forget,
Day of days His name to bless.

title: Holy Sabbath Day of RestYes, the holy Sabbath rest,By our God divinely blest,It to us a sign shall beThroughout all eternity.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Holy Sabbath day of rest,
By our Master richly blest
God created and divine,
Set aside for holy time

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Yes, the holy Sabbath rest,
By our God divinely blest,
It to us a sign shall be
Throughout all eternity.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Seek not pleasures by this earth
With its folly, noise, and mirth
There are better things in store,
Over on the other shore.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
As the Sabbath draweth on
Friday eve at set of sun
Christian household then should meet,
Sing and pray at Jesus’ feet,

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Him for saving grace,
Also vict’ry in the race,
And to help us by His pow’r,
To keep holy every hour.

title: O Day of Rest and Gladness

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O day of rest and gladness,
O day of joy and light
O balm of care sadness,
Most beautiful, most bright
On thee, the high and lowly,
Who bend before the throne,
Sing, holy, holy, holy,
To the Eternal One.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thou art a port protected
From storms that round us rise,
A garden intersected
With streams of paradise;
Thou art a cooling fountain
In life’s dry, dreary sand;
From thee, like Pisgah’s mountain,
We view our promised land.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
A day of sweet reflection
Thou art,a day of love;
A day to raise affection
From earth to things above.
New graces ever gaining
From this our day of rest
We seek the rest remaining
In mansions of the blest.

title: O Day of Rest and Gladness

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O day of rest and gladness,
O day of joy and light
O balm of care and sadness,
Most beautiful, most bright;
On thee, the high and lowly,
Who bend before the throne,
Sing,
Holy, holy, holy,
To the Eternal One.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thou art a port protected
From storms that round us rise,
A garden intersected
With streams of Paradise;
Thou art a cooling fountain
In life’s dry dreary sand;
From thee, like Pisgah’s mountain,
We view our promised land.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
A day of sweet reflection
Thou art, a day of love;
A day to raise affection
From earth to things above.
New graces ever gaining
From this our day of rest,
We seek the rest remaining,
In mansions of the blest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
While we seek supplies of grace
Throughthe dear Redeemer’s name,
Show
Thy reconciling face,
Ttake away our sin and shame;
From our worldly cares set free
May we rest this day in Thee.
From our worldy cares set free
May we rest this day in Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
When the morn shall bid us rise,
May we feel Thy presence near
May
Thy glory meet our eyes
When we in Thy house appear;
Here afford us, Lord, a taste
Of our everlasting feast.
Here afford us, Lord, a taste
Of our everlasting feast.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
May the gospel’s joyful sound
Conquer sinners, comfort saints;
Make the fruits of grace abound,
Bring relief to all complaints;
Thus may all our Sabbaths be
Till we rise to reign with Thee.
Thus may all our Sabbaths be
Till we rise to reign with Thee.

title: Crowning Jewel of CreationBlessed Sabbath made for man,Gift from the Creator’s hand.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Crowning jewel of creation,
Blest and hallowed, sanctified;
Time and changes all transcending,
Shared for ever, glorified.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Blessed Sabbath made for man,
Gift from the Creator’s hand.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Sin and sickness, rayer and weeping
Cease at close of earthly days;
But
Thy Sabbath is eternal,
Joyful thanks to Thee we raise!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Teach us, Lord, in storm or sunshine
How to truly rest in Thee,
May
Thy Sabbath peace enfold us
And our shelter ever be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The sacred anthem slowly rang
Across the fields of praise,
When earth’s first Sabbath made complete
All creatures and all days.
Wlaking with God, there,
Woman and man together share
The blessed Sabbath mood;
And in that green and golden world
Know all God’s works are good.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
But now in our diminished lives
We sing a blemished song;
The earth is worn and disarrayed
And all our work goes wrong.
Still in our worship,
Joining in praise and fellowhip,
By
Sabbath radiance blessed,
We put our doubt and fear away
And rest within God’s rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And arching over time and space
The
Lord of Sabbath wills
Renewal for the weary earth
And healing for our ills.
Hearts will rejoice then;
There will be no more weeping, when
We know and shall be known.
With host of the redeemed we’ll sing
Around
God’s shining throne.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, O Sabbath day, and bring
Peace and healing on thy wing;
And to every troubled breast
Speak of the divine behest:
Thou shalt rest, Thou shalt rest!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Earthly longings bid retire,
Quench the passions’ hurtful fire;
To the wayward, sin oppressed,
Bring thou thy divine behest:
Thou shalt rest, Thou shalt rest!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Wipe from evey cheek the tear,
Banish care and silence fear;
All things working for the best,
Teach us the divine behest:
Thou shalt rest, Thou shalt rest!

title: Don’t Forget the SabbathWelcome, welcome,Ever welcome,Blessed Sabbath day,Welcome, welcome,Ever welcome,Blessed Sabbath day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Don’t forget the Sabbath,
The
Lord our God hath blest,
Of all the week the brightest,
Of all the week the best;
It brings repose from labor,
It tells of joy divine,
Its beam of light descending,
With heavenly beauty shine.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Welcome, welcome,
Ever welcome,
Blessed Sabbath day,
Welcome, welcome,
Ever welcome,
Blessed Sabbath day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Keep the Sabbath holy,
And worship Him today,
Who said to His desciple,
“I am the living way;”
And if we meekly follow
Sour
Sevior here below,
He’ll give us of the fountain
Whose streams eternal flow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Day of sacred pleasure!
It golden hours we’ll spend
In thankful hymns to Jesus,
The children’s dear Friend;
O gentle loving, Savior,
How good and kind Thou art,
How precious is Thy promise
To dwell in every heart!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Let me with my heart today,
Holy, holy, holy, singing,
Rapt awhile from earth away,
All my soul to Thee up springing,
Have a foretaste inward given
How they worship Thee in heaven.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Hence all care, all vanity!
For the day to God is Holy;
Come,
Thou glorious Majesty,
Deign to fill this temple lowly
Nought today my soul shall move,
Simply resting in Thy love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
We love Thy Sabbath, Lord,
And worship at Thy will;
Oh may these hours sweet peace afford
And deeper faith in still.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thine angels sang for joy
Creation’s work to see;
We too, this day, would raise our hearts,
In grateful praise to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Praise for Thy wondrous love,
That sealed this sacred day,
A sign that all may understand
We own Thy sovereign sway.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O great Creator King,
Through
Thy redeeming grace,
Renew and sanctify our hearts
That we may see Thy face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
And with the white robed throng,
Upon
Mount Sion be,
And joyful sing our Sabbath song
Through all eternity.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Welcome, welcome day of rest,
To the world in kindness given;
Welcome to this humble breast,
As the beaming light from heaven.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Day of calm and sweet repose,
Gently now thy moments run;
Balm to soothe our cares and woes,
Till our labor here is done.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Holy day that most we prize,
Day of solemn praise and prayer,
Day to make the simple wise,
O, how great thy blessings are!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Welcome, welcome, day of rest
With thy influence all divine;
May thy hallowed hours be blessed
To this waiting heart of mine.

title: Dear Lord, We Come at Setof Sun

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Dear Lord, we come at set of sun,
And at Your feet we kneel
To worship You, Creator, King,
This day, Your sign and seal.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Our earthly tasks we lay aside,
According to Your Word,
To enter now Your holy rest,
The
Sabbath of the Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Sabbath rest, your sacred hours
Are as a golden chain
That reaches back to Eden’s gate
And points us home again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And when this earth shall be renewed,
And sin and death destroyed,
Shall all redeemed each Sabbath day
Still meet to praise their God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord of the Sabbath and its light,
I hail Thy hallowed day of rest;
It is my weary soul’s delight,
The solace of my care worn breast,
The solace of my care worn breast.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O sacred day of peace and joy,
Thy hours are ever dear to me;
Ne’er may a sinful thought destroy
The holy calm I find in thee,
The holy calm I find in thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
How sweetly now they glide along!
How hallowed is the calm they yield!
Transporting is their rapturous song,
And heavenly visions seem revealed,
And heavenly visions seem revealed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Jesus, let me ever hail
Thy presence with the day of rest;
Then will Thy servant never fail
To deem Thy Sabbath doubly blest,
To deem Thy Sabbath doubly blest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Far from all care we hail the Sabbath morning;
O’er waving fields and from the distant sea
Swell notes of praise in harmony resounding
As all creation turns her heart to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Though man alone, Lord, of Thy great creation
Fails now to laud Thee for Thy love and power,
Yet still a remnant love Thee and remember
Thy holy law and each sweet Sabbath hour.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord of the Sabbath, Savior and Creator,
Calm now the throbbings of each troubled breast.
Speak to our hearts the peace of Thy commaments,
Breath on each soul fair Eden’s hallowed rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Strong in Thy might and quiet in Thy meekness,
May we Thine image bear from day today.
Then may we enter pearly gates eternal
And sing redemption’s song each Sabbath day.

title: As Birds Unto the Genial Homeland

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
As birds unto the genial homeland fly,
The winter’s cold and low’ring skies to flee,
So seek my soul Thy gracious presence here
And finds, O God its rest and peace in Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Here at Thy shrine we leave all vexing care,
Forget the disappointment, grief and tear,
And on the wings of hopeful song and prayer
We rise and rising feel Thy Spirit here.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Bless all who spend this night in pain and woe,
The burdened heart, the fainting, and distressed,
Thy comfort send to darkened homes bereaved,
Thy saving help to those by want oppressed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Come,
Sabbath joy, each trusting heart now fill,
And blissful peace within our homes abide,
May thankful praise each grateful heart now thrill,
And to God’s loving care their lives confide.

title: Lord God, Your Love Has Called Us Here

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord God, Your love has called us here,
As we, by love, for love were made.
Your living likeness still we bear
Tho’ marred, dishonored, disobeyed.
We come, with all our heart and mind
Your call to hear, Your love to find.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
We come with self inflicted pains
Of broken trust and chosen wrong,
Half-free, half-bound by inner chains,
By social forces swept along,
By powers and systems close confined,
Yet seeking hope for human kind.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God, in Christ You call our name,
And then receive us as Your own,
Not thro' some merit, right, or claim,
But by Your gracious love alone.
We strain to glimpse Your mercy seat,
And find You kneeling at our feet.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Then take the towel, and break the bread,
And humble us, and call us friends.
Suffer and serve till all are fed
And show how grandly love intends
To work till all creation sings,
To fill all worlds, to crown all things.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
God, in Christ You set us free
Your life to live, Your joy to share.
Give us Your Spirit’s liberty
To turn from guilt and dull despair
And offer all that faith can do,
While love is making all things new.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
An upper room did our Lord prepare
For those He loved until the end:
And
His dicsiples still gather there,
To celebrate their risen Friend.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
And after supper He washed their feet,
For service too, is sacrament.
In
Him our joy shall be made complete
Sent out to serve, as He was sent.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
A lasting gift Jesus gave His own:
To share His bread, His loving cup.
Whatever burdens may bow us down,
He by His cross shall lift us up.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
No end there is! we depart in peace.
He loves beyond our utter most:
In every room in our Father’s house,
He will be there, as Lord and host.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Bread of the world in mercy broken,
Wine of the soul in mercy shed,
By whom the worlds of life are spoken,
And in whose death our sins are dead;
Amen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Look on the heart by sorrow broken,
Look on the tears by sinners shed;
And be Thy feast to us the token
That by Thy grace our souls are fed.

title: Beneath the Forms of Outward Rite

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Beneath the forms of outward rite
Thy supper, Lord, is spread
In every quiet upper room
Where fainting souls are fed.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The bread is always conscreate
Which men divide with men;
And every act of brotherhood
Repeats
Thy feast again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The blessed cup is only passed
True memory of Thee,
When life a new pours out its wine
With rich sufficiency.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Master, through these symbols shared,
Thine own dear self impart,
That in our daily life may flame
The passionof Thy heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I Come with joy to meet my Lord,
Forgiven, loved and free,
In awe and wonder to recall
His life laid down for me,
His life laid down for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I come with Christians far and near
To find, as all are fed,
Our true community of love
In
Christ's communion bread,
In
Christ’s communion bread.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Christ breaks bread for us to share
Each proud division ends.
That love that made us makes us one,
And strangers now are friends,
And strangers now are friends.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And thus with joy we meet our Lord.
His presence always near,
Is in such friendship better known:
We see and praise Him here,
We see and praise Him here.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Together met, together bound,
We’ll go our diff’rent ways,
And as His people in the world,
We’ll live and speak His praise,
We’ll live and speak His praise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
In imitation, Lord, of Thee,
This solemn service we repeat;
For
Thine example full of grace,
Has made this humble duty sweet.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Renew each sacred spark of love,
And vitalize the holy flame;
May union strong our hearts unite
While this we do in Jesus' name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Our great example Thou shalt be,
In washing Thy disciples feet;
And as we follow Thy command,
Make
Thou our fellowship complete.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
By Christ redeemed, in Christ restored,
We keep the memory adored,
And show the death of our dear Lord,
Until
He come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
His broken body in our stead
Is here, in this memorial bread;
And so our feeble love is fed,
Until
He come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
His fearful drops of agony,
His life blood shed for us we see;
The wine shall tell the mystery,
Until
He come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And thus that dark betrayal night,
With the last advent we unite
The shame, the glory, by this rite,
Until
He come.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text: 403 Let Us Break Bread Together

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Let us break bread together on our knees, let us break bread together on our knees.
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Let us drink wine together on our knees, let us drink wine together on our knees.
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Let us praise God together on our knees, let us praise God together on our knees.
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.

title: Now Let Us From This Table Rise

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Now let us from this table rise
Renewed in body, mind, and soul;
With
Christ we die and live again,
His selfless love has made us whole.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
With minds alert, upheld by grace,
To spread the word in speech and deed,
We follow in the steps of Christ,
At one with all in hope and need.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
To fill each human house with love,
It is the sacrament of care;
The work that Christ began to do
We humbly pledge ourselves to share.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Then grant us courage, Father God,
To choose again the pilgrim way
And help us to accept with joy
The challenge of tomorrow's day.

title: O God, Unseen, Yet Ever Near

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O God, unseen, yet ever near,
Reveal
Thy presence now
While in love that hath no fear,
Before
Thy glory bow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Here may Thy faithful people know
The blessings of Thy love,
The streams that thro’ the desert flow,
The manna from above.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We come, obedient to Thy Word
To feast on heav’nly food
Our meat, the body of our Lord,
Our drink, His precious blood.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thus may we all Thy words obey,
For we, O God, are Thine,
And go rejoicing on our way,
Renewed by strength divine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Love consecrates the humblest act
And haloes mercy’s deeds;
It sheds a benediction sweet
And hallows human needs.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
When in the shadow of the cross
Christ knelt and washed the feet
Of
His disciples, He gave us
A sign of love complete.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Love serves and willing, stoops to serve;
What
Christ in love so true
Has freely done for one and all,
Let us now gladly do!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Sent forth by God’s blessing,
Our true faith confessing,
The people of God from His dwelling take leave.
The supper is ended.
Oh, now be extended
The fruits of this service in all who believe.
The seed of His teaching,
Receptive souls reaching,
Shall blossom in action for God and for all.
His grace did invite us,
His love shall unite us
To work for God’s kingdom and answer His call.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
With praise and thanks giving
To
God ever living,
The task of our everyday life we will face.
Our faith ever sharing,
In love ever caring,
Embracing
His children of each tribe and race.
With
Your feast feed us,
With
Your light now lead us;
Unite us as one in this life that we share.
Then may all the living
With praise and thanksgiving.
Give honor to Christ His name that we bear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord, enthroned in heavenly splendor,
First begotten from the dead,
You alone, our strong defender,
Lifting up Your people’s head.
Alleluia,
Jesus, true and living Bread!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Tho’ the lowliest form now veil You
As of old in Bethlehem,
Here as there Your angels hail
You
Branch and flow’r of Jesse’s stem.
Alleluia,
We worship join with them.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lamb Your off’ring finished
Once for all when You were slain,
In its fullness undiminished
Shall forevermore remain.
Alleluia,
Cleansing from every stain.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Life imparting heav’nly manna,
Stricken rock with streaming side,
Heav’n and earth with loud hosanna
Worship
You the Lamb who died.
Alleluia,
Ris’n ascended, glorified!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus invites His saints
To meet around His board,
And sup in memory of the death
And sufferings of their Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
We take the bread and wine
As emblems of Thy death;
Lord, raise our souls above the sign,
To feast on Thee by faith.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Faith eats the bread of life,
And drinks the living wine;
It looks beyond this scene of strife
Unites us to the Vine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Soon shall the night be gone,
Our
Lord will come again;
The marriage supper of the Lamb
Will usher in His reign.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Thy broken body, gracious Lord,
Is shadowed by this broken bread;
The wine which in this cup is poured,
Point to the blood which Thou hast shed

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
And while we meet together thus,
We show that we are one in Thee;
Thy precious blood was shed for us,
Thy death, O Lord, hast set us free!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We have one hope that Thou wilt come,
Thee in the air we wait to see;
When Thou wilt give Thy saints a home,
And we shall ever reign with Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The Son of God proclaim,
The
Lord of time and space;
The
God who bade the light break forth
Now shines in Jesus’ face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
His out-stretched hands,
Thou all was in His power
He took the towel and basin then,
And serves us in this hour.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
He,
God’s creative word,
The church’s Lord and head,
Here bids us together as His friends,
And share His wine and bread.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord of life and death
With wondering praise we sing;
We break the bread at His command,
And name Him God and King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
We take this cup in hope:
For
He, who gladly bored
The shameful cross, is ris’n again,
And reign forevermore.

title: Cover With His LifeCover with His life, whiter than snow;Fullness of His life then shall I know;My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,Cover with His life, whiter than snow.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Look upon Jesus, sinless is He;
Father, impute His life unto me.
My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whiter than snow.

stanzas.label: Chorus
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Deep are the wounds transgression has made;
Red are the stains, my soul is afraid.
O to be covered, Jesus, with Thee
Safe from the law that now judgeth me!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Reconciled by His death for my sin,
Justified by His life pure and clean,
Sanctified by obeying His word,
Glorified when returneth my Lord.

title: God Has Spoken by His Prophets

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
God has spoken by His prophets,
Spoken
His unchanging Word,
Each from age to age proclaiming
God, the one, the righteous Lord.
Mid the world's despair and turmoil,
One firm anchor holding fast;
God is King, His throne eternal,
God the first, and God the last.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
God has spoken by Christ Jesus,
Christ, the everlasting Son,
Brightness of the Father's glory,
With the Father ever one;
Spoken by the Word incarnate,
God of God, ere time began,
Light of light, to earth descending,
Man, revealing God to man.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
God yet speaks by His own Spirit
Speaking to the hearts of men,
In the age long Word expounding
God's own message, now as then;
Through the rise and fall of nations
One sure faith yet standing fast,
God is King, His Word unchanging,
God the first, and God the last.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Fruitful trees, the Spirit it’s sowing,
May we ripen and increase,
Fruit to life eternal growing,
Rich in love and joy and peace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Laden branches freely bearing
Gifts the Giver loves to bless;
Here is fruit that grows by sharing,
Patience, kindness, gentleness.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Rooted deep in Christ, our Master,
Christ, our pattern and our goal,
Teach us, as the years fly faster,
Goodness, faiht, and self-control.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Fruitful trees, the Spirit’s tending,
May we grow till harvests cease;
Till we taste, in life unending,
Heaven’s love and joy and peace.

title: Christ the Lord, All Power Processing

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Christ the Lord, all power possessing,
Parting, mounted heaven’s height,
Gracious hands outstreached in blessing,
Clouds received Him from their sight.
Christ ascended, Christ ascended,
Christ ascended on the clouds.
Christ ascended on the clouds.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Daniel views earth’s judgment hour,
Angels gathering, open books.
God enthroned in flaming power
For
His Son’s arrival looks.
Christ approaches, Christ approaches,
Christ approaches on the clouds.
Christ approaches on the clouds.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Revelation’s word fulfilling,
Trumphet, voices pierce the air.
Saint and sinner fainting, thrilling,
Eveery eye behold him there.
Christ is coming, Christ is coming,
Christ is coming on the clouds.
Christ is coming on the clouds.

title: The Judgment Has SetHow shall we stand in the great day?How shall we stand in that great day?Shall we be found before Him wanting?Or with our sins all washed away?

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The judgment has set, the books have been opened;
How shall we stand in that great day
When every thought, and word and action,
God, the righteous Judge, shall weigh?

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
How shall we stand in the great day?
How shall we stand in that great day?
Shall we be found before Him wanting?
Or with our sins all washed away?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The work is begun with those who are sleeping,
Soon will the living here be tried,
Out of the books of God’s remembrance,
His decision to abide.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O, how shall we stand that moment of searching,
When all our sins those books reveal?
When from that court, each case decided,
Shall be granted no appeal?

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
417   O Solemn Thought
O solemn thought and can it be
The hour of judgment now is come;
Which soon must fix our destiny,
And seal the sinner’s fearful doom?
