Yes, it is so; the judgment hour
Is swiftly hastening to its close;
Then will the Judge, in mighty power,
Descend in vengeance on His foes.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He who came down to earth to die
An offerring for the sins of men,
And then ascended up on high,
And will e’er long return again,
Is standing now before the ark,
And mercy seat and cherubim,
To plead His blood for saints, and make
The last remembrance of their sin.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The solemn moment is at hand
When we who have His name confessed,
Each in his lot must singly stand,
And pass the final, searching test.
Jesus! 
We hope in Thee alone;
In mercy now upon us look,
Confess our names before the throne,
And blot our sins from out Thy book.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O blessed Savior! may we feel
The full importance of this hour.
Inspire our hearts with holy zeal,
And aid us by Thy Spirit’s power,
That we may in Thy strength be strong,
And brave the conflict valiantly;
Then, on Mount Zion, join the song,
And swell the notes of victory.

title: Day of Judgement, Day of Wonders!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Day of judgment,day of wonders!
Hark trumpet’s awful sound,
Louder than a thousand thunders,
Shakes the vast creation round!
How the summons, How the summons
Will the sinner’s heart confound!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
See the Lord in glory nearing,
Clothed in majesty divine.
You who long for His appearng
Then shall say, “This God is mine!”
Gracious
Savior, Gracious Savior,
Own me in that day as Thine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
His call the dead awaken,
Rise to life from earth and sea!
All the powers of nature shaken
By
His looks prepare to flee.
Careless sinner, Carless sinner,
What will then become of thee?

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
But to those who have confessed
Loved and serve the Lord below,
He will say, “Come near, ye blessed,
See the kingdom I bestow;
You forever, You forever
Shall my love and glory know.”

title: Soon shall the trump of God  				1 Soon shall the trump of God Give out the welcome sound, That shakes death's silent chamber walls, And breaks the turf sealed ground. 2 You dwellers in the dust, Awake, come forth, and sing; Sharp has your frost of winter been, But bright shall be your spring. 3 'Twas sown in weakness here; 'Twill then be raised in power; That which was sown in earthly seed Shall rise a heav'nly flower.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Soon shall the trump of God
Give out the welcome sound,
That shakes death's silent chamber walls,
And breaks the turf sealed ground.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
You dwellers in the dust,
Awake, come forth, and sing;
Sharp has your frost of winter been,
But bright shall be your spring.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jerusalem, my happy home,
O how I long for thee!
When will my sorrow have an end,
Thy joys when shall I see?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thy walls are all of precious stone,
Most glorious to behold;
Thy gates are richly set with pearl,
Thy streets are paved with gold.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thy garden and thy pleasant walks
My study long have been;
Such dazzling views by human sight
Have never yet been seen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord, help us by Thy mighty grace,
To keep in view the prize,
Till
Thou dost come to take us home
To that blest paradise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
For all the saints who from their labors rest,
Who thee by faith before the world confessed.
Thy name, O Jesus, be forever blest.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O may Thy soldiers, faithful, true, and bold,
Fight as the saints who nobly fought of old,
And win with them the victor's crown of gold.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
And when the strife is fierce, the warfare long,
Steals on the ear the distant triumph song,
And hearts are brave again, and arms are strong.
Alleluia!
Alleluia!

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
From earth's wide bounds, from ocean's farthest coast,
Thro' gates of pearl streams in the countless host,
Singing to Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,
Alleluia!
Alleluia!

title: Marching to ZionWe're marching to Zion,Beautiful, beautiful Zion;We're marching upward to Zion,The beautiful city of God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, we that love the Lord,
And let our joys be known;
Join in a song with sweet accord,
Join in a song with sweet accord,
And thus surround the throne,
And thus surround the throne.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
We're marching to Zion,
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Let those refuse to sing,
Who never knew our God;
But children of the heavenly King,
But children of the heavenly King,
May speak their joys abroad,
May speak their joys abroad.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The hill of Zion yields
A thousand sacred sweets,
Before we reach the heavenly fields,
Before we reach the heavenly fields,
Or walk the golden streets,
Or walk the golden streets.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Then let our songs abound,
And every tear be dry;
We're marching through Immanuel's ground
We're marching through Immanuel's ground
To fairer worlds on high,
To fairer worlds on high.

title: Glorious Things of Thee Are Spoken

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Glorious things of thee are spoken,
Zion, city of our God;
He whose word cannot be broken
Formed thee for His own abode;
On the Rock of Ages founded,
What can shake thy sure repose?
With salvation's wall surrounded,
Thou mayst smile at all thy foes.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
See the streams of living waters
Springing from eternal love,
Well supply thy sons and daughters,
And all fear and want remove;
Who can faint when such a river
Ever flows their thirst to assuage?
Grace, which, like the Lord, the Giver,
Never fails from age to age.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Round each habitation hovering,
See the cloud and fire appear
For a glory and a covering,
Showing that the Lord is near;
Blest inhabitants of Zion,
Washed in the Redeemer's blood;
Jesus, whom their souls rely on,
Makes them kings and priests to God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Savior, if of Zion's city
I, through grace, a member am,
Let the world deride or pity,
I will glory in Thy name;
Fading is the worldling's pleasure,
All his boasted pomp and show;
Solid joys and lasting treasure
None but Zion's children know.

title: For Thee, O Dear, Dear Country

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
For thee, O dear, dear country,
Mine eyes their vigils keep;
For every love beholding
Thy holy name, they weep.
The mention of thy glory
Is unction to the breast,
And medicine in sickness,
And love, and life, and rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O one, O only mansion!
O
Paradise of joy!
Where tears are ever banish'd
And smiles have no alloy;
Thy loveliness oppresses
All human thought and heart,
And none, O Peace, O Sion,
Can sing thee as thou art.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
O sweet and blessed country,
The home of God’s elect!
O sweet and blessed country
That eager hearts expect!
Jesus, in mercy bring us
To that dear land of rest,
Who art, with God the Father,
And
Spirit, ever blest.

title: Holy, Holy, Is What the Angels SingHoly, Holy, is what the angels sing,And I expect to help them make the courts of heaven ring;But when I sing redemption’s story, they will fold their wings,For angels never felt the joys that our salvation brings.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There is singing up in the heaven such as we have never known,
Where the angels sing the praises of the Lamb upon the throne;
Their sweet harps are ever tuneful and their voices always clear,
O that we might be more like them while we serve the Master here!

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Holy, Holy, is what the angels sing,
And I expect to help them make the courts of heaven ring;
But when I sing redemption’s story, they will fold their wings,
For angels never felt the joys that our salvation brings.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I hear another anthem, blending voices clear and strong,
“Unto
Him who hath redeemed us and hath bought us,” is the song;
We have come thro’ tribulations to this land so fair and bright,
In the fountain freely flowing He hath made our garments white.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Then the angels stand and listen for they cannot join that song,
Like the sound of many waters, by that happy, blood washed throng;
For they sing about great trials, battles fought and vict’ries won,
And they praise their great Reddemer, who hath said to them,
“Well done.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
So, although I’m not an angel, yet I know that over there
I will join a blessed chorus that the angel cannot share;
I will sing about my Savior, who upon dark Calvary
Freely pardoned my transgressions, died to set a sinner free

title: I Shall See the KingIn His glory, I shall see the King,And forever endless praises sing;'Twas on Calvary Jesus died for me;I shall see the King soneday.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I shall see the King where the angels sing,
I shall see the King someday,
In the better land,
On the golden strand
And with Him shall ever stay.

stanzas.label: Chorus
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
In the land of song, In the glory throng,
Where there never comes a night,
With my Lord once slain I shall ever reign
In the glory land of light.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I shall see the King, All my tributes bring,
And shall look upon His face;
Then my song shall be How He ransomed me
And has kept me by His grace.

title: No Night ThereGod shall “wipe away all tears;”There’s no death, no pain, nor fears;And they count not time by years,For there is “no night there.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
In the land of fadeless day
Lies
“the city four-square,”
It shall never pass away,
And there is “no night there.”

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
God shall “wipe away all tears;”
There’s no death, no pain, nor fears;
And they count not time by years,
For there is “no night there.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
All the gates of pearl are made,
In
“the city four-square;”
All the streets with gold are laid,
And there is “no night there.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And the gates shall never close
To
“the city four-square;”
There life’s crystal river flows,
And there is “no night there.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
There they need to sunshine bright.
In
“that city four-square,”
For the Lamb is all the light,
And there is “no night there.”

title: Sweet By and ByIn the sweet by and by,We shall meet on that beautiful shore;In the sweet by and by,We shall meet on that beautiful shore.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There's a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar;
For the Father waits over the way,
To prepare us a dwelling place there.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs of the blest,
And our spirits shall sorrow no more,
Not a sigh for the blessing of rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
To our bountiful Father above,
We will offer a tribute of praise,
For the glorious gift of His love,
And the blessings that hallow our days.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jerusalem the golden,
With milk and honey blest,
Beneath thy contemplation
Sink heart and voice oppressed.
I know not, O I know not
What holy joys are there;
What radiancy of glory,
What bliss beyond compare.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
They stand, those hills of Zion,
All jubilant with song,
And bright with many an angel,
And all the martyr throng.
The
Prince is ever in them,
The daylight is serene;
The pastures of the blessed
Are decked in glorious sheen.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
There is the throne of David,
And there, from care released,
The shout of them that triumph,
The song of them that feast;
And they who, with their Leader,
Have conquered in the fight,
Forever and forever
Are clad in robes of white.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
O sweet and blessed country,
The home of God’s elect!
O sweet and blessed country,
That eager hearts expect!
Jesus, in mercy bring us
To that dear of rest;
Who art with God the Father,
And
Spirit, ever blest.

title: Joy By and ByJoy, joy, there’ll be joy by and by,Joy, joy, where the joys never die;Joy, joy for the day draweth nightWhen the workers gather home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O there’ll be joy when the work is done,
Joy when reapers gather home,
Bringing the sheaves at set of sun
To the New Jeruslaem

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Joy, joy, there’ll be joy by and by,
Joy, joy, where the joys never die;
Joy, joy for the day draweth night
When the workers gather home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Sweet are the songs that we hope to sing,
Grateful the thanks our hearts shall bring,
Praising forever Christ our King
In the new Jerusalem.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Pure are the joys that await us there,
Many the golden mansions fair;
Jesus
Himself doth them prepare,
In the New Jerusalem.

title: Over YonderOver yonder, down by the crystal sea,Over yonder,There’s where I long to be,No more sorrow, toil, grief, nor care,In the homeland bright fair,Over, over there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, let us sing of homeland,
Down by the crystal sea;
Wonderful land where Jesus
Buildeth a mansion for me

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Over yonder, down by the crystal sea,
Over yonder,
There’s where I long to be,
No more sorrow, toil, grief, nor care,
In the homeland bright fair,
Over, over there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Water of life there floweth,
Fruit in abundant store;
Citizens of that country
Hunger and thirst never more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Come go with me to homeland,
Jesus invites you there;
Help spread the invitation,
Tell to men everywhere

title: Shall We Gather at the RiverYes, we'll gather at the river,The beautiful, the beautiful river;Gather with the saints at the riverThat flows by the throne of God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Shall we gather at the river,
Where bright angel feet have trod,
With its crystal tide forever
Flowing by the throne of God?

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
On the margin of the river
Washing up its silver spray,
We will walk and worship ever,
All the happy golden day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Ere we reach the shining river,
Lay we ev'ry burden down;
Grace our spirits will deliver,
And provide a robe and crown.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Soon we'll reach the shining river,
Soon our pilgrimage will cease;
Soon our happy hearts will quiver
With the melody of peace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Ten thousand times ten thousand,
In sparkling raiment bright
The armies f the ransomed saints
Throng up the steeps of light.
‘Tis finished, all is finished,
Their fight with death and sin.
Fling open wide the golden gates,
And let the victors in.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
What rush of hallelujahs
Fills all the earth and sky!
The ringing of a thousand harps
Proclaims the triumph high.
O day for which creation
And all its tribes were made!
O joy, for all its former woes
A thousand fold repaid!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O then what raptured greetings
On
Canaan’s happy shore!
What knitting served friendship where
Death partings are no more!
Then eyes with joy shall sparkle,
That brimmed with tears of late;
Orphans no longer fatherless,
Nor widows desolate.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Bring near Thy great salvation,
Thou
Lamb for sinners slain,
Fill up the roll of Thine elect,
Then take Thy power and reign
Appear,
Desire of nations,
Thine exiles long for home;
Show in the heavens Thy promised sign;
Thou
Prince and Savior, come!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
We speak of the realms of the blest,
That country so bright and so fair,
And oft are its glories confessed--
But what must it be to be there!
We speaks of its pathway of gold--
Its walls decked with jewels so rare,
Its wonders and pleasure untold--
But what must it be to be there!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
We speaks of its freedom from sin,
From sorrow, temptation and care,
From trials without and within--
But what must it be to be there!
We speak of its service of love,
Of the robes which the glorified wear,
Of the church of the First born above
But what it be to be there!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Our mourning is all at an end,
When, raised by the life giving word,
We see the new city descend,
Adored as a bride for her Lord;
The city so holy and clean,
No sorros can breathe in the air;
No gloom of affliction or sin,
No shadow of evil, is there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Do thou, midst temptation and woe,
For heaven my spirit prepare;
And shortly I also shall know
And feel what it is to be there.
Then o’er the bright fields we shall roam,
In glory celestial and fair,
With saints and with angels at home,
And
Jesus Himself will be there.

title: The Glory SongO that will be glory for me,Glory for me, glory for me;When by His graceI shall look on His face,That will be glory,Be glory for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When all my labors and trials are o’er,
And
I am safe on that beautiful shore,
Just to be near the dear Lord I adore,
Will through the ages be glory for me.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O that will be glory for me,
Glory for me, glory for me;
When by His grace
I shall look on His face,
That will be glory,
Be glory for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
When, by the gift of His infinite grace,
I am accorded in heaven a place
Just to be there and to look on His face,
Will through the ages be glory for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Friends will be there I have loved long ago;
Joy like a river a round me will flow,
Yet, just a smile from my Savior, I know,
Will through the ages be glory for me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
The homeland! O the homeland!
The land of the free born!
There’s no night in the homeland,
But aye the fadeless morn;
I’m sighing for the homeland,
My heart is aching here;
There is no pain in the homeland
To which I’m drawing near
There is no pain in the homeland
To which I’m drawing near.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
The dwellers in the homeland
Are beckoning me to come,
Where neither death nor sorrow
Invades their holy home;
O dear, dear native country!
O rest and peace above!
Christ bring us all to the homeland
Of
Thy redeeming love;
Christ bring us all to the homeland
Of
Thy redeeming love.

title: I’m Going HomeI’ going home, I’m going home,I’m going home to die no more;To die no more, to die no moreI’m going home to die no more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
My heav’nly home is bright and fair,
Nor pain nor death can enter there;
Its glitt’ring tow’rs the sun outshine,
That heav’nly mansion shall be mine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Father’s house is built on high,
Far, far above the starry sky;
When from this earthly prison free,
That heav’nly mansion mine shall be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Let others seek a home below,
Which flames devour or waves o’er flow;
Be mine a happier lot to own
A heav’nly mansion near the throne.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I’ going home, I’m going home,
I’m going home to die no more;
To die no more, to die no more
I’m going home to die no more.

title: You will See Your Lord A-ComingHear the band of music,Hear the band of music,Hear the band of musicWhich is sounding thro’ the air.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
You will see your Lord a coming,
You will see your Lord a coming,
You will see your Lord a coming
In a few more days.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Hear the band of music,
Hear the band of music,
Hear the band of music
Which is sounding thro’ the air.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Gabriel sounds his mighty trumpet,
Gabriel sounds his mighty trumpet,
Gabriel sounds his mighty trumpet
In a few more days.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
You will see the saints arising,
You will see the saints arising,
You will see the saints arising,
In a few more days.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Angels bear them to the Savior
Angels bear them to the Savior
Angels bear them to the Savior
In a few more days.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Then we’ll shout, our suff’rings over,
Then we’ll shout, our suff’rings over,
Then we’ll shout, our suff’rings over,
In a few more days.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
How far from home? I asked, as on
I bent my steps---the watchman spake;
“The long, dark might is almost gone,
The morning soon will break.
Then weep no more, but speed thy flight,
With
Hope’s bright star thy guiding ray,
Till thou shalt reach the realms of light
In everlasting day.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I asked the warrior on the field;
This was his soul inspiring song:
“With courage, bold, the sword I’ll wield,
The battle is not long.
Then weep no more, but well endure
The conflict, till thy work is done;
For this we know, the prize is sure,
When victory is won.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I asked again, earth, sea, and sun
Seemed, with one voice, to make reply:
“Times’s wasting sands are nearly run,
Eternity is nigh.
Then weep no more-- with warning tones,
Portentous signs are thickening round,
The whole creation, waiting, groans,
To hear the trumpet sound.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Not far from home! O blessed thought!
The traveler’s lonely heart to cheer;
Which oft a healing balm has brought,
And dried the mourner’s tear.
Then weep no more, since we shall meet
Where weary footsteps never roam
Our trials past, our joys complete,
Safe in our Father’s home.

title: How Cheering Is the Christian’s Hope

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
How cheering is the Christian’s hope,
While toiling here below!
It bouys us up while passing through
This wilderness of woe,
It bouys us up while passing through
This wilderness of woe.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
It points us to a land of rest,
Where saints with Christ will reign;
Where we shall meet the loved of earth,
And never part again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Fly, lingering moments, fly, O, fly,
Dear
Savior, quickly come!
We long to see Thee as Thou art,
And reach that blissful home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I saw one weary, sad, and torn,
With eager steps press on the way,
Who long the hallowed cross had borne,
Still looking for the promised day;
While many aline of grief and care,
Upon his brow was furrowed there;
I asked what buoyed his spirits up,
“O this!” said he– “the blessed hope.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
And one I saw, with sword and shield,
Who boldly braved the world’s cold frown,
And fought, unyielding on the field,
To win an everlasting crown.
Though worn with toil, oppressed by foes,
No murmur from his heart arose;
I asked what buoyed spirits up,
“O this!” said he– “the blessed hope.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And there was one who left behind
The cherished friends of early years,
And honor, pleasure, wealth resigned,
To tread the path bedewed with tears.
Through trials deep and conflicts sore,
Yet still a smile of joy he wore;
I asked what buoyed spirits up,
“O this!” said he– “the blessed hope.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
While pilgrims here we journey on
In this dark vale of sin and gloom,
Through tribulation, hate, and scorn,
Or through the portals of the tomb,
Till our returning King shall come
To take His exile captives home,
O!
What can buoy the spirits up?
‘Tis this alone– “the blessed hope.

title: How Sweet Are the TidingsHe’s coming, coming, coming soon,I know,Coming back to this earth again;And the weary pilgrims will to glory goWhen the Savior comes to reign.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
How sweet are the tidings that greet the pilgrim’s ear,
As he wanders in exile from home!
Soon, soon will Savior in glory appear,
And soon will the kingdom come.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
He’s coming, coming, coming soon,
I know,
Coming back to this earth again;
And the weary pilgrims will to glory go
When the Savior comes to reign.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
The mossy old graves where the pilgrims sleep
Shall be open as wide as before,
And the millions that sleep in the mighty deep
Shall live on this earth once more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
There we’ll meet ne’er to part in our happy Eden home,
Sweet songs of redemption we’ll sing;
From the north, from the south, all the ransomed shall come,
And worship our heavenly King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Hallelujah,
Amen! hallelujah again!
Soon, if faithful, we all shall be there,
O, be watchful, be hopeful, be joyful till then,
And a crown of bright glory we’ll wear.

title: There’ll Be No Sorrow ThereThere’ll be no sorrow there,There’ll be no sorrow there;In heaven above, where all is love,There’ll be no sorrow there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There’ll be no grief in heaven;
For life is one glad day,
And tears are those of former things
Which all have passed away.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
There’ll be no sin in heaven;
Behold that blessed throng,
All holy in their spotless robes,
All holy in their song.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
There’ll be no sorrow there,
There’ll be no sorrow there;
In heaven above, where all is love,
There’ll be no sorrow there.

title: I’m a PilgrimI’m a pilgrim, and I’m a stranger;I can tarry, I can tarry but a night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
I’m a pilgrim, and I’m a stranger;
I can tarry, I can tarry but a night.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There the glory is ever shining!
O, my longing heart, my longing heart is there;
Here in this country so dark and dreary,
I long have wandered forlorn and weary.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
There’s the city to which I journey;
My
Redeemer, my Redeemer is its light!
There is no sorrow, nor any sighing,
Nor any tears there, or any dying.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
There at my Savior’s side,
Heaven is my home;
I shall be glorified,
Heaven is my home.
There’ll be the good and blest,
Those
I love most and best.
There, too, I soon shall rest;
Heaven is my home.

title: Lo, What a Glorious Sight AppearsO that will be joyful, joyful, joyful!O that will be joyfulWhen we meet to part no more!When we meet to part no more onCanaan’s happy shore;‘Tis there we’ll meet at Jesus’ feet,When we meet to part no more

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lo, what glorious sight appears
To our believing eyes!
The earth and seas are passed away,
And the old rolling skies.
And the old rolling skies,
And the old rolling skies;
The earth and seas are passed away,
And the old rolling skies.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O that will be joyful, joyful, joyful!
O that will be joyful
When we meet to part no more!
When we meet to part no more on
Canaan’s happy shore;
‘Tis there we’ll meet at Jesus’ feet,
When we meet to part no more

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Attending angels shout for joy
And the bright armies sing–
Mortals! behold the sacred seat
Of your descending King.
Of your descending King,
Of your descending King;
Mortals! behold the sacred seat
Of your descending King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
His own soft hand shall wipe the tears
From every weeping eye;
And pains, and groans, and griefs, and fears,
And death itself shall die!
And death itself shall die,
And death itself shall die;
And pains, and groans, and grief, and fears,
And death itself shall die

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
How long, dear Savior! oh, how long
Shall this bright hour delay?
Fly swifter round, ye wheels of time!
And bring the welcome day.
And bring the welcome day,
And bring the welcome day;
Fly swifter round, ye wheels of time!
And bring the welcome day.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Now the light of truth they’re seeking,
In its onward track pursue;
All the ten commandments keeping,
They are the holy, just, and true.
On the words of life they’re feeding,
Precious to their taste so sweet;
All their Master’s precepts heeding,
Bowing humbly at His feet.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
In that light of light and beauty,
In that golden city fair,
Soon its pearly gates they’ll enter,
And of all its glories share.
There, divine the soul’s expansions;
Free from sin, death, and pain;
Tears will never dim those mansions
Where the saints immortal reign.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He comes! with clouds descending;
All
His saints, entombed arise;
The redeemed, in anthems blending,
Shout their vict’ry thro’ the skies.
O, we long for Thine appearing;
Come,
O Savior, quickly come!
Blessed hope! our spirits cheering,
Take
Thy ransomed children home.

title: O, When Shall I See JesusO, shout, glory!For I shall mount above the skies,When I hear the trumpet sound in that morning.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O, when shall I see Jesus and reign with Him above,
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning?
And from the flowing fountain drink everlasting love,
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O, shout, glory!
For I shall mount above the skies,
When I hear the trumpet sound in that morning.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Gird on the gospel armor of faith and hope and love,
And you’ll hear the trumpet sound in that morning.
And when the combat’s ended He’ll carry you above,
And you’ll hear the trumpet sound in that morning.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Our ears shall hear with transport the host of heaven sing,
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning.
Our tongues shall chant the glories of our immortal King,
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning.

title: Never Part AgainWe’re trav’ling to Immanuel’s land,We soon shall hear the trumpet sound,And soon we shall with Jesus reign,And never, never part again.What! Never part again?No, never part again,What ! Never part again?No, never part again,And soon we shall with Jesus reign,And, never, never part again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There is land of pure delight,
Where bliss eternal reigns,
Infinite day excludes the night
And pleasure banish pain

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
We’re trav’ling to Immanuel’s land,
We soon shall hear the trumpet sound,
And soon we shall with Jesus reign,
And never, never part again.
What! Never part again?
No, never part again,
What ! Never part again?
No, never part again,
And soon we shall with Jesus reign,
And, never, never part again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There everlasting spring abides,
And never with’ring flowers
And but a little space divides
This heav’nly land from ours.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Could we but stand where Moses stood,
And view the landscape o’er,
Not all this world’s pretended good
Could ever charm us more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Beautiful Zion, built above,
Beautiful city that I love,
Beautiful gates of pearly white,
Beautiful temple, God its light.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Beautiful trees forever there,
Beautiful fruit they always bear,
Beautiful rivers gliding by,
Beautiful fountains never dry.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Beautiful crowns on every brow,
Beautiful palms the conquerors show,
Beautiful robes the ransomed wear,
Beautiful all who enter there.

title: Together Let Us Sweetly LiveO Canaan, bright Canaan,I am bound for the land of Canaan.O Canaan, it is my happy home,I am bound for the land of Canaan.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Together let us sweetly live,
I am bound for the land of Canaan.
Together love to Jesus give;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O Canaan, bright Canaan,
I am bound for the land of Canaan.
O Canaan, it is my happy home,
I am bound for the land of Canaan.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
What heavenly music steals over the sea!
Entrancing the senses like sweet melody!
'Tis the voice of the angels borne soft on the air;
For me they are singing; their welcome I hear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
On the banks of old Jordan, here gazing I stand,
And earnestly longing, I stretch forth my hand;
Send a convoy of angels, dear Jesus, I pray!
Let me join that sweet music; come, take me away.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Though dark are the waters and rough is the wave,
If
Jesus permit, the wild surges I'll brave;
For that heavenly music hath ravished me so,
I must join in that chorus! I'll go! let me go!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
They say green fields are waving there,
That never a blight shall know;
And the desert wild are blooming fair,
And the roses of Sharon grow.
There are lovely birds in the bowers green,
Their songs are blithe and sweet;
And their warblings gushing ever new,
The angels’ harpings greet.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
We have heard of the palms, the robes, the crowns,
And the silvery band in white;
Of the city fair, with pearly gates,
All radiant with light.
We have heard of the angels therre, and saints,
With their harps of gold, how they sing;
Of the mount with the fruitful tree of life,
Of the leaves that healing bring.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
King of that country He is fair,
He’s the joy and light of the place;
In
His beauty we shall behold Him there,
And bask in His smiling face.
We’ll be there, we'll be there in a little while,
We’ll join the pure and the blest;
We’ll have the palm, the robe, the crown,
And forever be at rest.

title: Don’t You See My Jesus Coming?I am bound for the kingdom,Will you go to glory with me?Hallelujah! O praise ye the Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Don’t you see my Jesus coming,
See
Him come in yonder cloud?
With ten thousand angels round Him,
How they do my Jesus crowd!

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I am bound for the kingdom,
Will you go to glory with me?
Hallelujah! O praise ye the Lord!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Don't you see the saints ascending,
Hear them shouting thro' the air
Jesus smiling, trumpets sounding,
Now glory they shall share.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Immortal Love, forever full,
Forever flowing free,
Forever shared forever whole,
A never ebbing sea!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
We may not climb the heavenly steeps
To bring the Lord Christ down;
In vain we search the lowest deeps,
For
Him no depths can drown.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
But warm, sweet, tender, even yet
A present help is He;
And faith has still it's Olivet,
And love its Galilee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
The healing of His seamless dress
Is by our bed of pain;
We touch Him in life’s throng and press,
And we are whole again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Him the first fond prayers are said,
Our lips of childhood frame;
The last low whispers of our dead
Are burdened with His name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
Lord and Master of us all:
What e’er our name or sign
We own Thy sway, we hear Thy call,
We test our lives by Thine!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I have a Friend so precious,
So very dear to me,
He loves me with such tender love,
He loves so faithfully;
I could not live apart from Him,
I love to feel Him nigh,
And so we dwell together,
My
Lord and I.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I'm faint and weary,
He knows that I am weak,
And as He bids me lean on Him,
His help I gladly seek;
He leads me in the paths of light,
Beneath a sunny sky,
And so we walk together,
My
Lord and I.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I tell Him all my sorrows,
I tell Him all my joys,
I tell Him all that pleases me,
I tell Him what annoys;
He tells me what I ought to do,
He tells me how to try,
And so we talk together,
My
Lord and I.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
He knows that I am longing
Some weary soul to win,
And so He bids me go and speak
The loving word for Him;
He bids me tell His wondrous love,
And why He came to die,
And so we work together,
My
Lord and I.

title: I Love to Tell the StoryI love to tell the story,'Twill be my theme in glory,To tell the old, old storyOf Jesus and his love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I love to tell the story
Of unseen things above,
Of
Jesus and His glory,
Of
Jesus and his love.
I love to tell the story,
Because
I know 'tis true;
It satisfies my longings
As nothing else can do.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and his love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I love to tell the story;
More wonderful it seems
Than all the golden fancies
Of all our golden dreams.
I love to tell the story,
It did so much for me;
And that is just the reason
I tell it now to thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I love to tell the story;
'Tis pleasant to repeat
What seems, each time I tell it,
More wonderfully sweet.
I love to tell the story,
For some have never heard
The message of salvation
From
God's own holy Word.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
I love to tell the story,
For those who know it best
Seem hungering and thirsting
To hear it like the rest.
And when in scenes of glory,
I sing the new, new song,
'Twill be the old, old story
That
I have loved so long.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
More love to Thee, O Christ!
More love to Thee;
Hear thou the prayer I make
On bended knee.
This is my earnest plea,
More love, O Christ, to thee;
More love to thee!
More love to thee!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Once earthly joy I craved,
Sought peace and rest;
Now thee alone I seek,
Give what is best.
This all my prayer shall be,
More love, O Christ, to Thee;
More love to Thee!
More love to thee!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Let sorrow do its work;
Send grief and pain;
Sweet are Thy messengers,
Sweet their refrain,
When they can sing with me,
More love, O Christ, to Thee,
More love to Thee!
More love to Thee!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Then shall my latest breath
Whisper
Thy praise;
This be the parting cry
My heart shall raise;
This still its prayer shall be,
More love, O Christ, to Thee,
More love to Thee!
More love to thee!

title: As The Bridegroom to His Chosen

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
As the bridegroom to his chosen, as the king to his realm,
As the keep unto the castle, as the pilot to the helm,
So,
Lord, art Thou to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
As the fountain in the garden, as the candle in the dark,
As the treasure in the coffer, as the manna in the ark,
So,
Lord, art Thou to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
As the ruby in the setting, as the honey in the comb,
As the light within the lantern, as the father in home,
So,
Lord, art Thou to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
As the sunshine in the heavens, as the image in the glass,
As the fruits upon the fig tree, as the dew upon the grass,
So,
Lord, art Thou to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
As water to the thirsty,
As beauty to the eyes,
As strength that follows weakness,
As truth instead of lies;
As songtime and springtime and summertime to be
So is my Lord, my living Lord,
So is my Lord to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Like calm in place of clamor
Like peace that follows pain,
Like meeting after parting,
Like sunshine after the rain;
Like moonlight and starlight and sunlight on the sea,
So is my Lord, my living Lord,
So is my Lord to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
As sleep that follows fever,
As gold instead of grey,
As freedom after bondage,
As sunrise to the day;
As home to the trav’ler and all he longs to see,
So is my Lord, my living Lord,
So is my Lord to me.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Be still, my soul: thy God doth under take
To guide the future as He has the past.
Thy hope, thy confidence let nothing shake;
All now mysterious shall be bright at last.
Be still my soul: the waves and winds still know
His voice who ruled them while He dwelth below.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Be still, my soul: the hour is hastening on
When we shall be forever with the Lord,
When disappointment, grief, and fear are gone,
Sorrow forgot, loves purest joys restored.
Be still, my soul: when change and tears are part,
All safe and blessed we shall meet at last.

title: Blessed Assurance, JesusIs Mine!This is my story, this is my song,Praising my Savior, all the day long;This is my story, this is my song,Praising my Savior, all the day long.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Is Mine!
Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
O, what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
Born of His Spirit, washed in His blood.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Savior, all the day long;
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Savior, all the day long.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Perfect submission, perfect delight,
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight;
Angels descending bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Perfect submission, all is at rest,
I in my Savior am happy and blest,
Watching and waiting, looking above,
Filled with His goodness, lost in His love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus: this is rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?
In
Jesus' keeping we are safe, and they.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

title: When I Can Read My Title Clear

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
When I can read my title clear
To mansions in the skies
I’ll bid farewell to every fear,
And wipe my weeping eyes;
And wipe my weeping eyes,
And wipe my weeping eyes
I bid farewell to every fear,
And wipe my weeping eyes.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Should earth against my soul engage,
And fiery darts be hurled,
Then
I can smile at Satan’s rage,
And face a frowning world.
And face a frowning world,
And face a frowning world,
Then
I can smile at Satan’s rage,
And face a frowning world.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Let cares like a wild deluge come,
And storms of sorrow fall!
May
I but safely reach my home,
My
God, my heav’n, my all.
My
God, my heav’n, my all,
My
God, my heave’n, my all,
May
I but safely reach my home,
My
God, my heav’n, my all.

title: I Heard the Voice of Jesus

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
“Come unto Me and rest;
Lay down, thou weary one, lay down
Thy head upon My breast.”
I came to Jesus as I was,
Weary and worn and sad;
I found in Him a resting place,
And
He has made me glad.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
“Behold,
I freely give
The living water; thirsty one,
Stoop down, and drink, and live.”
I came to Jesus, and I drank
Of that life giving stream;
My thirst was quench'd, my soul revived,
And now I live in Him.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
“I am this dark world’s light;
Look unto Me, thy morn shall rise,
And all thy day be bright.”
I looked to Jesus, and I found
In
Him my star, my sun;
And in that light of life I’ll walk,
Till trav'ling days are done.

title: Wonderful PeacePeace, peace, wonderful peace,Coming down from the Father above!Sweep over my spirit forever, I prayIn fathomless billows of love!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Far away in the depths of my spirit tonight,
Rolls a melody sweeter than psalm;
In celestial like strains it unceasingly falls
O’er my soul like an infinite calm.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Peace, peace, wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above!
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray
In fathomless billows of love!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
What a treasure I have in this wonderful peace,
Buried deep in my innermost soul,
So secure that no power can mine it away,
While the years of eternity roll!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I believe when I rise to that city of peace,
Where the Author of peace I shall see,
That one strain of the song which the ransomed will sing,
In that heavenly kingdom will be.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Weary soul, without gladness or comfort or rest,
Passing down the rough pathway of time!
Make the Savior your friend ere the shadows grow dark;
O accept of this peace so sublime.

title: Life Is Great! So Sing About It

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Life is great! so sing about it,
As we can and as we should–
Shops and buses, towns and people,
Village, farmland, field and wood.
Life is great and life is given;
Life is lovely free and good.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Life is great!– what ever happens,
Snow or sunshine, joy or pain,
Hardship, grief or disillusion,
Suffering that I can’t explain–
Life is great if someone loves me,
Holds my hand and calls my name.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
God is great! In Christ He loved us,
As we should, but never can–
Love that suffered, hope and trusted
When disciples turned and ran,
Love that broke through death for ever.
Praise that loving, living Man!

title: A Child of the KingI’m a child of the King,A child of the King:With Jesus my Savior,I’m a child of the King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
My Father is rich in houses and lands,
He holdeth the wealth of the world in His hands!
Of rubies and diamonds, of silver and gold,
His coffers are full, He has riches untold.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I’m a child of the King,
A child of the King:
With Jesus my Savior,
I’m a child of the King.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Father’s own Son, the Savior of men,
Once wandered on earth as the poorest of them;
But now He is pleading for sinners on high,
And will give me a home when He comes by and by.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I once was an outcast stranger on earth,
A sinner by choice, an alien by birth!
But
I’ve been adopted, my name’s written down,
An heir to a mansion, a robe and a crown.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
A tent or a cottage, why should I care?
They’re building a palace for me over there!
Though exiled from home, yet still may I sing:
“All glory to God, I’m a child of the
King.”

title: Leaning on the Everlasting ArmsLeaning, leaning,Safe and secure from all alarms;Leaning, leaning,Leaning on the everlasting arms.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
What a fellowship, what a joy divine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
What a blessedness, what a peace is mine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
O how sweet to walk in this pilgrim way,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
O how bright the path grows from day to day,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
What have I to dread, what have I to fear,
Leaning on the everlasting arms?
I have blessed peace with my Lord so near,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

title: There's Sunshine in My Soul TodayO there’s sunshine, blessed sunshine,When the peaceful, happy moments rollWhen Jesus shows His smiling faceThere is sunshine in the soul.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There's sunshine in my soul today,
More glorious and bright
Than glows in any earthly sky,
For
Jesus is my light.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O there’s sunshine, blessed sunshine,
When the peaceful, happy moments roll
When Jesus shows His smiling face
There is sunshine in the soul.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There’s music in my soul today,
A carol to my King,
And
Jesus, listening, can hear
The songs I cannot sing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
There’s springtime in my soul today,
For when the Lord is near,
The dove of peace sings in my heart,
The flowers of grace appear.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
There's gladness in my soul today,
And hope, and praise, and love,
For blessings which He gives me now,
For joys "laid up" above.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2

title: A Song of Heaven and HomelandO sweet, celestial music,Heard from a land afar–the song of Heav’n and Homeland,Thro’ doors God leaves ajar!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Sometimes I hear strange music,
Like none e’er heard before,
Come floating softly earthward
As thro’ heav’ns open door:
It seems like an angel voices,
In strains of joy and love,
That swell the mighty chorus
Around the throne above.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O sweet, celestial music,
Heard from a land afar– the song of Heav’n and Homeland,
Thro’ doors God leaves ajar!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Now soft, and low, and restful,
It floods my soul with peace,
As if God’s benediction
Bade all earth’s troubles cease.
Then grander than the voices,
Of wind, and wave, and sea–
It fills the dome of heaven
With glorious harmony.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
This music haunts me ever,
Like something heard in dreams–
It seems catch the cadence
Of heav’nly wind and streams.
My heart is filled with rapture,
To think, someday to come,
I’ll sing it with the angles–
The song of heav’n and home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!
E'en though it be a cross
That raiseth me!
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Though like the wanderer,
Daylight all gone,
Darkness be over me,
My rest a stone;
Yet in my dreams I'd be
Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to thee!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Then, with my waking thoughts
Bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony griefs
Bethel
I'll raise;
So by my woes to be
Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Or if, on joyful wing
Cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon, and stars forgot,
Upward
I fly,
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer, my God, to thee,
Nearer to thee!

title: Take the Name of JesusWith YouPrecious Name, O how sweet!Hope of earth and joy of heav’n.Precious Name, O how sweet!Hope of earth and joy of heav’n.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Take the name of Jesus with you,
Child of sorrow and of woe,
It will joy and comfort give you;
Take it then, where’er you go.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Precious Name, O how sweet!
Hope of earth and joy of heav’n.
Precious Name, O how sweet!
Hope of earth and joy of heav’n.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Take the name of Jesus ever,
As a shield from every snare;
If temptations round you gather,
Breathe that holy name in prayer.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O the precious name of Jesus!
How it thrills our souls with joy,
When
His loving arms receive us,
And
His songs our tongues employ!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
At the name of Jesus bowing,
Falling prostrate at His feet,
King of kings in heaven we’ll crown Him,
When our journey is complete.
Lillian Baxter, 1870 (1809-1874)
8.78.7.
Ref.
William
H. Doane, 1871 (1832-1916)

title: Balm in GileadThere is a balm in Gilead to make the wounded whole;There is a balm in Gilead to heal the sin sick soul.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
There is a balm in Gilead to make the wounded whole;
There is a balm in Gilead to heal the sin sick soul.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I feel discouraged,
And think my work’s in vain,
But then the Holy Spirit
Revives my soul again.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
If you cannot preach like Peter,
If you cannot pray like Paul,
You can tell the love of Jesus,
And
He died for all.

title: Burden Are Lifted at CalvaryBurdens are lifted at Calvary,Calvary, Calvary;Burdens are lifted at Calvary,Jesus is very near.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Days are filled with sorrow and care,
Heart are lonely and drear;
Burdens are lifted at Calvary,
Jesus is very near.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Burdens are lifted at Calvary,
Calvary, Calvary;
Burdens are lifted at Calvary,
Jesus is very near.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Cast your care on Jesus today,
Leave your worry and fear;
Burdens are lifted at Calvary,
Jesus is very near.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Troubled soul, the Savior can see
Every heartache and tear;
Burdens are lifted at Calvary,
Jesus is very near.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Come, ye disconsolate, where'er ye languish.
Come to the mercy seat, fervently kneel.
Here bring your wounded hearts, here tell your anguish;
Earth has no sorrow that heaven cannot heal.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Joy of the comfortless, light of the straying, hope of the penitent, fadeless and pure!
Here speaks the Comforter, tenderly saying,
"Earth has no sorrow that heaven cannot cure."

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Here see the Bread of Life; see waters flowing
Forth from the throne of God, pure from above.
Come to the feast of love; come, ever knowing
Earth has no sorrow but heaven can remove.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
That calls me from a world of care,
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all my wants and wishes known.
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief,
And oft escaped the tempter's snare
By thy return, sweet hour of prayer!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
Thy wings shall my petition bear
To him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless.
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe
His word, and trust His grace,
I'll cast on Him my every care,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
May
I thy consolation share
Till from Mount Pisgah's lofty height
I view my home and take my flight.
In my immortal flesh I'll rise
To seize the everlasting prize.
And shout while passing through the air,
"Farewell, farewell, sweet hour of prayer!"

title: Tread softly, tread softly,The Master is here;Tread softly, tread softly,He bids us draw near

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Be silent, be silent,
A whisper is heard;
Be silent, and listen,
Oh, treasure each word.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Tread softly, tread softly,
The Master is here;
Tread softly, tread softly,
He bids us draw near

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Be silent, be silent,
For holy this place,
This altar that echoes
The message of grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Be silent, be silent,
Breath humbly our prayer;
A foretaste of Eden
This moment we share.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Be silent, be silent,
His mercy record;
Be silent, be silent,
And wait on the Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Dear Lord and Father of mankind,
Forgive our foolish ways;
Reclothe us in our rightful mind,
In purer lives Thy service find,
In deeper reverence, praise.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
In simple trust like theirs who heard,
Beside the Syrian sea,
The gracious calling of the Lord,
Let us, like them, without a word,
Rise up and follow Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Sabbath rest by Galilee,
O calm of hills above,
Where
Jesus knelt to share with Thee
The silence of eternity,
Interpreted by love!

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thy still dews of quietness,
Till all our strivings cease;
Take from our souls the strain and stress,
And let our ordered lives confess
The beauty of Thy peace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Dear Lord and Father of mankind, forgive our feverish ways;
Reclothe us in our rightful mind,
In purer lives Thy service find,
In deeper reverence, praise.

title: Father, Lead Me Day by Day

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I’m tempted to do wrong,
Make me steadfast, wise and strong;
And when all alone I stand,
Shield me with Thy mighty hand.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
I do the good I know,
Be
Thy loving child below,
Then at last go home to Thee,
Evermore
Thy child to be.

title: I Need Thee Every HourI need Thee, O I need Thee;Every hour I need Thee;O bless me now, my Savior,I come to Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I need Thee every hour,
Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice like Thine
Can peace afford.

stanzas.label: Chorus
Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I need Thee every hour,
In joy or pain;
Come quickly and abide,
Or life is vain.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I need Thee precious Jesus,
For
I am very poor;
A stranger and a pilgrim,
I have no earthly store.
I need the love of Jesus
To cheer me on my way,
To guide my doubting foot steps,
To be my strength and stay.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I need the heart of Jesus
To feel each anxious care,
To tell my every trial,
And all my sorrows share.
I need the Holy Spirit
To teach me what I am,
To show me more of Jesus,
To point me to the Lamb.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I need Thee precious Jesus,
I hope to see Thee soon,
Encircled with the rainbow,
And seated on Thy throne.
There with Thy blood-bought children,
My joy shall ever be
To sing Thy ceaseless praises,
To gaze, my Lord, on Thee!

title: I Must Tell JesusI must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!I cannot bear my burdens alone;I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!Jesus can help me, Jesus alone.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I must tell Jesus all of my trials,
I cannot bear these burden alone,
In my distress He kindly will help me,
He ever loves and cares for His own.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
I cannot bear my burdens alone;
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
Jesus can help me, Jesus alone.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I must tell Jesus of my troubles,
He is a kind compassionate Friend;
If
I but ask Him, He will deliver,
Makes od my troubles quickly an end.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
O how the world to evil allures me!
O how my heart is tempted to sin!
I must tell Jesus, and He will help me
Over the world the vict’ry to win.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thy dear Son I now believe,
O let me feel Thy power;
And all my varied wants relieve,
In this accepted hour.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
How would my fainting soul rejoice
Could
I but see Thy face!
Now let me hear Thy quickening voice,
And taste Thy pardoning grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
I do believe, I now believe
That
Jesus died for me,
And that He shed His precious blood
From sin to set me free.

title: In the GardenAnd He walks with me, and He talks with me,And He tells me I am His ownAnd the joy we share as we tarry there,None other has ever known.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I come to the garden alone,
While the dew is still on the roses;
And the voice I hear, falling on my ear,
The
Son of God discloses.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
And He walks with me, and He talks with me,
And He tells me I am His own
And the joy we share as we tarry there,
None other has ever known.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
He speaks, and the sound of His voice
Is so sweet the birds hush their singing,
And the melody that He gave to me
Within my heart is ringing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I’d stay in the garden with Him
Though the night around me be falling,
But
He bids me go; through the voice of woe,
His voice to me is calling.

title: At First I Prayed for Light

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
At first I prayed for light;
Could
I but see the way,
How gladly, swifty would I walk
To everlasting day!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
And next I prayed for strength:
That
I might tread the road
With firm, unfaltering feet, and win
The heaven’s serene abode.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And then I asked for faith:
Could
I but trust my God,
I’d live infolded in His peace,
Though foes were all abroad.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
But now I pray for love:
Deep love to God and man;
A living love that will not fail,
However dark His plan.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
And light and strength and faith
Are opening everywhere!
God waited patiently until
I prayed larger prayer.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus, lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high.
Hide me, O my Savior, hide!
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide,
O receive my soul at last.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Other refuge have I none,
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, ah! leave me not alone!
Still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenseless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thou,
O Christ, art all I want,
More than allin Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy name,
I am all unrighteousness;
Vile and full of sinI am,
Thou art full of truth and grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Jesus, lover of my soul, let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll, while the tempest still is high.
Hide me, O my Savior, hide, till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide; O receive my soul at last.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
Stanza 4
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
In the hour of trial,
Jesus, plead for me,
Lest by base denial
I depart from Thee;
When
Thou see'st me waver,
With a look recall,
Nor, for fear or favor,
Suffer me to fall.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Would this vain world charm;
Or its sordid treasures
Spread to work me harm;
Bring to my remembrance
Sad
Gethsemane,
Or, in darker semblance,
Cross-crowned
Calvary.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Thy mercy send me
Sorrow, toil, and woe,
Or should pain attend me
On my path below,
Grant that I may never fail
Thy hand to see;
Grant that I may ever
Cast my care on Thee.

title: Like JesusI would be like Jesus,I would be like Jesus!Help me, Lord to daily growMore and more like Jesus!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
I would be like Jesus,
I would be like Jesus!
Help me, Lord to daily grow
More and more like Jesus!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Teach me as the days go by,
Teach me not to reason why,
Teach me that to do and die,
Is to be like Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Teach me that the time is short,
Teach me how to live and work,
Teach me that to never shirk
Is to be like Jesus.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Teach me how we may be one,
Like the Father and the Son;
And when all is overcome,
I will be like Jesus.

title: Fill My Cup, LordFill my cup, Lord, I lift it up, Lord!Come and quench this thristing of my soul;Bread of heaven, feed me till I want no more--Fill my cup, fill it up and make me whole!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Like the woman at the well I was seeking
For things that could not satisfy;
And then I heard my Savior speaking:
Draw from My well that never shall run dry.”

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Fill my cup, Lord, I lift it up, Lord!
Come and quench this thristing of my soul;
Bread of heaven, feed me till I want no more--
Fill my cup, fill it up and make me whole!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There are millions in this world who are craving
The pleasure earthly things afford;
But none can match the wondrous treasure
That
I find in Jesus Christ my Lord.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
So, my children, if the things this world gave you
Leave hunger that won’t pass away,
My blessed Lord will come and save you,
If you kneel to Him and humbly pray:

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
"We would see Jesus;" for the shadows lengthen
Across the little landscape of our life;
We would see Jesus, our weak faith to strengthen
For the last conflict, in this mortal strife.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
"We would see Jesus," Rock of our salvation,
Where on our feet were set with sovereign grace;
Not life, nor death, with all agitation,
Can thence removed us, gazing on
His face.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
"We would see Jesus;" this is all we're needing
Strength, joy and willingness come with the sight;
We would see Jesus, dying, risen, pleading,
Soon to return and end this mortal night!

title: Near to the Heart of GodO Jesus, blest Redeemer,Sent from the heart of God,Hold us who wait before theeNear to the heart of God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There is a place of quiet rest,
Near to the heart of God;
A place where sin cannot molest,
Near to the heart of God.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
O Jesus, blest Redeemer,
Sent from the heart of God,
Hold us who wait before thee
Near to the heart of God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
There is a place of comfort sweet,
Near to the heart of God;
A place where we our Savior meet,
Near to the heart of God.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
There is place a place of full release,
Near to the heart of God;
A place where all is joy and peace,
Near to the heart of God.

title: Eternal Love, We have No Good

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Eternal Love, we have no good to bring Thee,
No single good of all our hands have wrought,
No worthly music have we found to sing Thee,
No jewelled word, no quick up souring thought.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
And yet we come and when our faith would fater
Show us, O Love, the quiet place of prayer,
The golden cense and the golden altar,
And the great angel waiting for us there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
O gracious Father of mankind,
Our spirits’ unseen friend,
High heaven’s Lord, our hearts’ dear guest,
To
Thee our prayer ascend.
Thou dost not wait till human speech
Thy gifts divine implore;
Our dream, our aims, our work, our lives
Are prayer Thou lovest more.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Thou hearest these, the good and ill,
Deep burried in each breast;
The secret thought, the hidden plan,
Wrought out or unexpressed.
O cleanse our prayers from human dross,
Attune our lives to Thee,
Until we labot for those gifts
We ask on bended knee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Our best is but Thyself in us,
Our highest thught Thy will;
To hear Thy voice we need but love,
And listen, and bestill
We would not bend Thy will to ours,
But blend our wills with Thine;
Not beat with cries on heaven’s doors,
But live Thy life divine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Thou seekest us in love and truth
More than our minds seek Thee,
Though open gates Thy power flows in
Like flood tides from the sea.
No more we seek Thee from afar,
Nor ask Thee for a sign,
Content to pray in life and love
And toil, till all are Thine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Still, still with Thee, when purple morning breaketh,
When the bird waketh, and the shadows flee;
Fairer than morning, lovelier than daylight,
Dawns the sweet consciousness, I am with Thee.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Alone with Thee, amid the mystic shadows,
The solemn hush of nature newly born;
Alone with Thee in breathless adoration,
In the calm dew and freshness of the morn.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
As in the dawning o’er the waveless ocean
The image of the morning star doth rest,
So in the stillness Thou beholdest only
Thine image in the waters of my breast.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Still, still with Thee, as to each newborn morning,
A fresh and solemn splendor still is given,
So does this bless?d consciousness, awaking,
Breathe each day nearness unto thee and heaven.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
When sinks the soul, subdued by toil, to slumber,
Its closing eye looks up to Thee in prayer;
Sweet the repose beneath the wings o’ershading,
But sweeter still to wake and find Thee there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
So shall it be at last, in that bright morning,
When the soul waketh and life’s shadows flee;
O in that hour, fairer than daylight dawning,
Shall rise the glorious thought, I am with Thee.

title: What a Friend We Havein Jesus

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
O what peace we often forfeit,
O what needless pain we bear,
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Are we weak and heavy laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious
Savior, still our refuge;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer!
In his arms He'll take and shield thee;
Thou wilt find a solace there.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Take time to be holy,
Speak oft with thy Lord;
Abide in Him always,
And feed on His word.
Make friends of God's children,
Help those who are weak,
Forgetting in nothing His blessing to seek.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Take time to be holy,
The world rushes on;
Spend much time in secret
With
Jesus alone.
By looking to Jesus,
Like
Him thou shalt be;
Thy friends in thy conduct
His likeness shall see.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Take time to be holy,
Let him be thy guide,
And run not before him,
Whatever betide.
In joy or in sorrow,
Still follow the Lord,
And, looking to Jesus,
Still trust in His word.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Take time to be holy,
Be calm in thy soul,
Each thought and each motive
Beneath
His control.
Thus led by His spirit
To fountains of love,
Thou soon shalt be fitted
For service above.

title: ‘Tis the Blessed Hourof PrayerBlessed hour of prayer,Blessed hour of prayer,What a balm for the weary!O how sweet to be there!

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
of Prayer
’Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when our hearts lowly bend,
And we gather to Jesus, our Savior and Friend;
If we come to Him in faith,
His protection to share,
What a balm for the weary!
O how sweet to be there!

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
Blessed hour of prayer,
Blessed hour of prayer,
What a balm for the weary!
O how sweet to be there!

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
’Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when the Savior draws near,
With a tender compassion His children to hear;
When
He tells us we may cast at His feet every care,
What a balm for the weary!
O how sweet to be there!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
Stanza 4
Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Sun of my soul, Thou Savior dear!
It is not night if Thou be near;
O may no earthborn cloud arise
To hide Thee from Thy servant’s eyes.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
When the soft dews of kindly sleep
My wearied eyelids gently steep,
Be my last thought, how sweet to rest
Forever on my Savior’s breast!

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Abide with me from morn till eve,
For without Thee I cannot live;
Abide with me when night is nigh,
For without Thee I dare not die.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Be near and bless us when I wake,
Ere through the world our way we take;
Till in the ocean of Thy love
We lose ourselves in heaven above.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
There is a quiet place,
Far from the rapid place where
God can soothe my troubled mind.
Sheltered by tree and flow’r,
There in my quiet hour with Him
My cares are left behind.
Whether a garden small,
Or on a mountain tall,
New strength and courage there I find;
Then from this quiet place
I go prepared to face a new day
With love for all mankind.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Lord Jesus, think on me
And purge away my sin;
From earthborn passions set me free,
And make me pure within.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Lord Jesus, think on me,
With many a care oppressed;
Let me Thy loving servant be
And taste Thy promised rest.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Lord Jesus, think on me
Amid the battle’s strife;
In all my pain and misery
Be Thou my Health and Life.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Lord Jesus, think on me
Nor let me go astray;
Through darkness and perplexity
Point Thou the heavenly way.

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
Lord Jesus, think on me
When floods the tempest high;
When on doth rush the enemy,
O Savior, be Thou nigh!

stanzas.label: Stanza 6
stanzas.text:
Lord Jesus, think on me
That, when the flood is past,
I may th’eternal brightness see
And share Thy joy at last.

stanzas.label: Stanza 7
stanzas.text:
Lord Jesus, think on me
That I may sing above
To Father, Spirit, and to Thee
The strains of praise and love.

title: I Need the PrayersI want my friends to pray for me,To bear my tempted soul above,And intercede with God for me;I need the prayer of those I love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I need a prayers of those I love,
While trav’ling o’er life rugged way,
That
I may true and faithful be,
And live for Jesus every day.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
I want my friends to pray for me,
To bear my tempted soul above,
And intercede with God for me;
I need the prayer of those I love.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I need the prayer of those I love,
To help me in each trying hour,
To bear my tempted soul to Him,
That
He may keep me by His pow’r.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
I want my friends to pray for me,
To hold me up on wings of faith,
That
I may walk the narrow way,
Kept by our Father’s glorious grace.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
A mighty fortress is our God,
A bulwark never failing;
Our helper He amid the flood
Of mortal ills prevaling.
For still our ancient foe
Doth seek to work us woe;
His craft and power are great,
And armed with cruel hate,
On earth is not his equal.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Did we in our own strength confide,
Our striving would be losing,
Were not the right man on our side,
The man of God's own choosing.
Dost ask who that may be?
Christ
Jesus, it is He;
Lord
Sabbaoth, His name,
From age to age the same,
And
He must win the battle.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
And though this world, with devils filled,
Should threaten to undo us,
We will not fear, for God hath willed
His truth to triumph through us.
The
Prince of Darkness grim,
We tremble not for him;
His rage we can endure,
For lo, his doom is sure;
One little word shall fell him.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4

title: Moment by MomentMoment by moment I’m kept inHis love;Moment by moment I’ve life from above;Looking to Jesus till glory doth shine;Moment by moment, O Lord, I am Thine.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
Dying with Jesus by death reckoned mine,
Loving with Jesus, a new life divine,
Looking to Jesus till glory doth shine,
Moment by moment, O Lord, I am Thine.

stanzas.label: Chorus
Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
Never a trial that He is not there,
Never a burden that He doth not bear,
Never a sorrow that He doth not share,
Moment by moment I’m under His care.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Never a heartache, and never a groan,
Never a teardrop and never a moan;
Never a danger but there on the throne,
Moment by moment He thinks of
His own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Never a weakness that He doth not feel,
Never a sickness that He cannot heal;
Moment by moment, in woe or in weal,
Jesus, my Savior, abides with me still.

title: Anywhere With JesusAnywhere! Anywhere!Fear I cannot know;Anywhere with JesusI can safely go.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
Chorus
stanzas.text:
Anywhere! Anywhere!
Fear I cannot know;
Anywhere with Jesus
I can safely go.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
Anywhere with Jesus I can go to sleep,
When the gloomy shadows round about me creep,
Knowing
I shall waken nevermore to roam;
Anywhere with Jesus will be home sweet home.

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
How firm a foundation, ye saint of the
Lord,
Is laid for your faith in His excellent Word!
What more can He say than to you He hath said,
To you who for refuge to Jesus hath fled?

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
“When thro’ the deep waters I call thee to go
The rivers of sorrow shall not over flow;
For
I will be with thee, thy troubles to bless,
And sanctify to thee thy deepest distress.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
“When thro’ fiery trials thy pathway shall lie,
My grace, all sufficient, shall be thy supply;
The flame shall not hurt thee; I only design
Thy dross to consume, and thy gold to refine.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 5
stanzas.text:
“The soul that on Jesus hath leaned for repose,
I will not, I will not desert to His foes;
That soul, though all hell should endeavor to shake,
I’ll never, no never, no never forsake!”

title: If You But Trust in God to Guide You

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
If you but trust in God to guide you
And place your confidence in Him,
You’ll find Him always there beside you,
To give you hope and strength within.
For those who trust God’s changeless love
Build on the rock that will not move.

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
What gain is there in futile weeping,
In helpless anger and distress?
If you are in His care and keeping,
In sorrow will He love you less?
For
He who took for you a cross
Will bring you safe through every loss.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
In patient trust await His leisure
In cheerful hope, with heart content
To take whate’er your Fathers’s pleasure
And all discerning love have sent;
Doubt not your inmost wants are known
To
Him chose you for His own.

stanzas.label: Stanza 4
stanzas.text:
Sing, pray and keep His ways unswerving,
Offer your service faithfully,
And trust His word; though undeserving,
You’ll find His promise true to be.
God never will forsake in need
The soul that trust in Him indeed.

title: I Know Whom I Have BelievedBut “I know whom I have believed,And am persuaded that He is ableTo keep that which I’ve committedUnto Him against that day.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 1
stanzas.text:
I know not why God’s wondrous grace
To me He hath made known,
Nor why, unworthy, Christ in love
Redeemed me for His own.

stanzas.label: Chorus
stanzas.text:
But “I know whom I have believed,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I’ve committed
Unto Him against that day.”

stanzas.label: Stanza 2
stanzas.text:
I know not how this saving faith
To me He did impart,
Nor how believing in His word
Wrought peace within my heart.

stanzas.label: Stanza 3
stanzas.text:
